1.1.1.s: uttarataupacāro vihāraḥ /
1.1.1.d: उत्तरतौपचारो विहारः /
1.1.1.m: The sacrificial enclosure has its entrance from the north.

1.1.1.s: antarāṇi yajñāṅgāni kartuḥ /
1.1.1.d: अन्तराणि यज्ञाङ्गानि कर्तुः /
1.1.1.m: The limbs of the sacrifice are within [the reach of] the performer.

1.1.1.s: catvāricatvāri karmāṇi prasaṃpaśyan kuryād ā caturthāt karmaṇaḥ /
1.1.1.d: चत्वारिचत्वारि कर्माणि प्रसंपश्यन् कुर्याद् आ चतुर्थात् कर्मणः /
1.1.1.m: He should perform four ritual acts at a time, looking ahead up to the fourth ritual act.

1.1.1.s: mantrāntena karmādim̐ saṃnipātayet /
1.1.1.d: मन्त्रान्तेन कर्मादिम्̐ संनिपातयेत् /
1.1.1.m: He should make the beginning of the ritual act coincide with the end of the sacred formula.

1.1.1.s: ādinottarasya pūrvasyāntam̐ vidyāt /
1.1.1.d: आदिनोत्तरस्य पूर्वस्यान्तम्̐ विद्यात् /
1.1.1.m: One should know the end of the preceding [sacred formula] by the beginning of the following one.

1.1.1.s: yajñopavītī dakṣiṇācāraḥ prāṅnyāyyaṃ karmopām̐śu yajurvedena kuryāt /
1.1.1.d: यज्ञोपवीती दक्षिणाचारः प्राङ्न्याय्यं कर्मोपाम्̐शु यजुर्वेदेन कुर्यात् /
1.1.1.m: Wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder, moving to the right, facing east as the standard rule, he should perform the ritual act in a whisper with the Yajurveda.

1.1.1.s: darśapaurṇamāsayor dharmāḥ sādhāraṇāḥ /
1.1.1.d: दर्शपौर्णमासयोर् धर्माः साधारणाः /
1.1.1.m: The rules for the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices are common [to all iṣṭis].

1.1.1.s: nirdeśād vyavatiṣṭheran /
1.1.1.d: निर्देशाद् व्यवतिष्ठेरन् /
1.1.1.m: They should be distinguished according to specific instruction.

1.1.1.s: catvāra ṛtvijo 'dhvaryur hotā brahmāgnīdhraḥ /
1.1.1.d: चत्वार ऋत्विजो ऽध्वर्युर् होता ब्रह्माग्नीध्रः /
1.1.1.m: There are four officiating priests: the adhvaryu, the hotṛ, the brahman, and the āgnīdhra.

1.1.1.s: anādeśe 'dhvaryuḥ kuryāt /
1.1.1.d: अनादेशे ऽध्वर्युः कुर्यात् /
1.1.1.m: In the absence of an explicit rule, the adhvaryu should perform [the act].

1.1.1.s: upavatsv aśane bhukte gārhapatyād āhavanīyaṃ jvalantaṃ praṇayati /
1.1.1.d: उपवत्स्व् अशने भुक्ते गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयं ज्वलन्तं प्रणयति /
1.1.1.m: When the [initiatory] meal has been eaten by those observing the fast, he brings forward the blazing [fire] from the gārhapatya fire as the āhavanīya fire.

1.1.1.s:
devā gātuvido gātum̐ vittvā gātum̐ yajñāya vindata /
manasaspatinā devena vātād yajñaḥ prayujyatām //
iti japitvā vratopetasya śākhām achaiti parṇaśākhām̐ śamīśākhām̐ vā prācīm udīcīm̐ vāhatāṃ bahuśākhāṃ bahuparṇām aśuṣkāgrām asuṣirām //
1.1.1.d:
देवा गातुविदो गातुम्̐ वित्त्वा गातुम्̐ यज्ञाय विन्दत /
मनसस्पतिना देवेन वाताद् यज्ञः प्रयुज्यताम् //
इति जपित्वा व्रतोपेतस्य शाखाम् अछैति पर्णशाखाम्̐ शमीशाखाम्̐ वा प्राचीम् उदीचीम्̐ वाहतां बहुशाखां बहुपर्णाम् अशुष्काग्राम् असुषिराम् //
1.1.1.m:
"O gods who know the path, having found the path, find the path for the sacrifice!

By the god who is the lord of the mind, may the sacrifice be joined through the wind!"

Having whispered this, he goes to [fetch] a branch of [a tree] suitable for the rite—a branch of a parṇa tree or a branch of a śamī tree—pointing east or north, unbroken, many-branched, dense with leaves, whose tip is not dried up, and which is not hollow.

1.1.1.s: iṣe tvā \\ iti chinatti //
1.1.1.d: इषे त्वा \\ इति छिनत्ति //

1.1.1.s: ūrje tvā \\ ity anumārṣṭi //
1.1.1.d: ऊर्जे त्वा \\ इत्य् अनुमार्ष्टि //

1.1.1.s: subhūtāya \\ iti saṃnamayati //
1.1.1.d: सुभूताय \\ इति संनमयति //
1.1.1.m: "For prosperity!"—saying this, he bends it.

1.1.1.s: vāvayaḥ stha \\ iti śākhayā vatsān apākaroti trīn yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ trīn //
1.1.1.d: वावयः स्थ \\ इति शाखया वत्सान् अपाकरोति त्रीन् यजुषा तूष्णीं त्रीन् //
1.1.1.m: "Ye are the calves [of the wind]!"—saying this, he drives away the calves with the branch: three with a yajus-formula, three silently.

1.1.1.s: apākṛtānām ekam̐ śakhayā tūṣṇīm upaspṛśati /
1.1.1.d: अपाकृतानाम् एकम्̐ शखया तूष्णीम् उपस्पृशति /
1.1.1.m: He silently touches one of the driven calves with the branch.

1.1.1.s: darbhapiñjūlaiḥ saha śākhayā devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatv iti gāḥ prārpayati //
1.1.1.d: दर्भपिञ्जूलैः सह शाखया देवो वः सविता प्रार्पयत्व् इति गाः प्रार्पयति //
1.1.1.m: With the branch along with tufts of darbha-grass, he drives out the cows, saying, "May the god Savitṛ impel you!"

1.1.1.s: āpyāyadhvam aghnyā devebhyā indrāya bhāgam itīndrayājino // mahendrāya \\ iti mahendrayājinaḥ /
1.1.1.d: आप्यायध्वम् अघ्न्या देवेभ्या इन्द्राय भागम् इतीन्द्रयाजिनो // महेन्द्राय \\ इति महेन्द्रयाजिनः /
1.1.1.m: "Swell, O inviolable ones, for the gods, as a portion for Indra!"—thus for one who offers to Indra; "for Mahendra!"—for one who offers to Mahendra.

1.1.1.s:
śuddhā apaḥ suprapāṇe pibantīḥ \ śatam indrāya śrado duhānāḥ /
rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu //
iti vrajantīr anumantrayate //
1.1.1.d:
शुद्धा अपः सुप्रपाणे पिबन्तीः \ शतम् इन्द्राय श्रदो दुहानाः /
रुद्रस्य हेतिः परि वो वृणक्तु //
इति व्रजन्तीर् अनुमन्त्रयते //
1.1.1.m:
"Drinking pure waters at a good drinking-place, / milking a hundred autumns for Indra,

May the missile of Rudra spare you!"

Saying this, he accompanies them with a mantra as they walk away.

1.1.1.s: dhruvā asmin gopatau syāta bahvīr iti yajamānasya gṛhān abhiparyāvartate / yajamānam̐ vā prekṣamāṇo japati /
1.1.1.d: ध्रुवा अस्मिन् गोपतौ स्यात बह्वीर् इति यजमानस्य गृहान् अभिपर्यावर्तते / यजमानम्̐ वा प्रेक्षमाणो जपति /
1.1.1.m: "Be steadfast in this cow-master, being many!"—saying this, he turns back toward the house of the sacrificer; or he whispers it looking at the sacrificer.

1.1.1.s: agniṣṭhe 'nasy agnyagāre vā yajamānasya paśūn pāhi \\ iti pratyagagrām̐ śākhām upakarṣati /
1.1.1.d: अग्निष्ठे ऽनस्य् अग्न्यगारे वा यजमानस्य पशून् पाहि \\ इति प्रत्यगग्राम्̐ शाखाम् उपकर्षति /
1.1.1.m: On the cart situated at the fire or in the fire-house, he draws the branch forward with its tip pointing west, saying, "Protect the animals of the sacrificer!"

1.1.1.s: uttarato gārhapatyasya devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ ity asilam ādatte //
1.1.1.d: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इत्य् असिलम् आदत्ते //
1.1.1.m: North of the gārhapatya fire, he takes up the sickle, saying, "At the impulse of the god Savitṛ..."

1.1.1.s: goṣad asi \\ iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate //
1.1.1.d: गोषद् असि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते //
1.1.1.m: "Thou art seated in cattle!"—saying this, he attends upon the gārhapatya fire.

1.1.1.s: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ iti vrajati //
1.1.1.d: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इति व्रजति //
1.1.1.m: "Traverse the wide mid-air!"—saying this, he goes.

1.1.1.s: pratyuṣṭam̐ rakṣas \\ ity āhavanīye niṣṭapati //
1.1.1.d: प्रत्युष्टम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये निष्टपति //
1.1.1.m: "Singed is the demon!"—saying this, he scorches [the sickle] in the āhavanīya fire.

1.1.1.s: preyam agāt \\ iti japati /
1.1.1.d: प्रेयम् अगात् \\ इति जपति /

1.1.1.s: prāg udag vābhipravrajya barhir achaiti //
1.1.1.d: प्राग् उदग् वाभिप्रव्रज्य बर्हिर् अछैति //
1.1.1.m: Having walked out towards the east or the north, he goes to [fetch] the sacrificial grass.

1.1.1.s: devānāṃ pariṣūtam asi \\ iti darbhān prastarāya pariṣuvati //
1.1.1.d: देवानां परिषूतम् असि \\ इति दर्भान् प्रस्तराय परिषुवति //
1.1.1.m: "Thou art impelled for the gods!"—saying this, he gathers the darbha-stalks for the sacred grass bundle.

1.1.1.s: viṣṇoḥ stupas \\ iti darbhastambam abhimṛśati //
1.1.1.d: विष्णोः स्तुपस् \\ इति दर्भस्तम्बम् अभिमृशति //
1.1.1.m: "The tuft of Viṣṇu!"—saying this, he touches the clump of darbha-grass.

1.1.1.s: atisṛṣṭo gavāṃ bhāgas \\ ity ekāntam atisṛjati /
1.1.1.d: अतिसृष्टो गवां भागस् \\ इत्य् एकान्तम् अतिसृजति /
1.1.1.m: "Cast off is the portion of the cows!"—saying this, he sets aside a single stalk.

1.1.1.s: śeṣaṃ prastarāya //
1.1.1.d: शेषं प्रस्तराय //

1.1.1.s: mādho mopari parus ta ṛdhyāsam iti japati //
1.1.1.d: माधो मोपरि परुस् त ऋध्यासम् इति जपति //
1.1.1.m: "Neither below nor above; may I succeed at your joint!" he whispers.

1.1.1.s: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ iti viśākhāni prati lunāti saṃnakhaṃ muṣṭim //
1.1.1.d: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति विशाखानि प्रति लुनाति संनखं मुष्टिम् //
1.1.1.m: "At the impulse of the god Savitṛ..."—saying this, he cuts across the fork [of the stalks] a fistful with nails touching.

1.1.1.s: pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcas pāhi \\ iti tṛṇam antardhāya prastaram̐ sādayati /
1.1.1.d: पृथिव्याः संपृचस् पाहि \\ इति तृणम् अन्तर्धाय प्रस्तरम्̐ सादयति /
1.1.1.m: "Protect [it] from contact with the earth!"—saying this, having interposed a blade of grass, he deposits the sacred grass bundle.

1.1.1.s: akalmāṣān darbhāṃl lunāti prabhūtān apradhūnayan //
1.1.1.d: अकल्माषान् दर्भांल् लुनाति प्रभूतान् अप्रधूनयन् //
1.1.1.m: He cuts spotless darbha-grass in abundance, without shaking [it].

1.1.1.s: āchettā te mā riṣam iti japati //
1.1.1.d: आछेत्ता ते मा रिषम् इति जपति //
1.1.1.m: "Cutting thee, may I not suffer harm!" he whispers.

1.1.1.s: atas tvaṃ barhiḥ śatavalśam̐ viroha \\ ity ālavān abhimṛśati //
1.1.1.d: अतस् त्वं बर्हिः शतवल्शम्̐ विरोह \\ इत्य् आलवान् अभिमृशति //
1.1.1.m: "From this, O sacrificial grass, sprout with a hundred shoots!"—saying this, he touches the cut stalks.

1.1.1.s: sahasravalśā vi vayam̐ ruhema \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati //
1.1.1.d: सहस्रवल्शा वि वयम्̐ रुहेम \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशति //
1.1.1.m: "With a thousand shoots may we sprout!"—saying this, he touches himself.

1.1.1.s: ayupitā yonir iti śulbaṃ pratidadhāty ayugdhātu pradakṣiṇam //
1.1.1.d: अयुपिता योनिर् इति शुल्बं प्रतिदधात्य् अयुग्धातु प्रदक्षिणम् //
1.1.1.m: "An unstumbled womb!"—saying this, he lays down the cord, with an odd number of strands, clockwise.

1.1.1.s: adityā rāsnāsi \\ iti śulbam anulomaṃ trir anumārṣṭi /
1.1.1.d: अदित्या रास्नासि \\ इति शुल्बम् अनुलोमं त्रिर् अनुमार्ष्टि /
1.1.1.m: "Thou art the girdle of Aditi!"—saying this, he wipes down the cord three times from root to tip.

1.1.1.s: yathālūnam amuto vā susaṃbhṛte tvā saṃbharāmi \\ iti śulbe barhis triḥ saṃbharati //
1.1.1.d: यथालूनम् अमुतो वा सुसंभृते त्वा संभरामि \\ इति शुल्बे बर्हिस् त्रिः संभरति //
1.1.1.m: According to the manner cut, or from that [direction], saying, "Into thee well gathered, I gather [the grass]," he gathers the sacrificial grass three times upon the cord.

1.1.1.s: ayupitā yonir iti prastaram //
1.1.1.d: अयुपिता योनिर् इति प्रस्तरम् //
1.1.1.m: "An unstumbled womb!"—saying this, [he lays down] the sacred grass bundle.

1.1.1.s: indrāṇyāḥ saṃnahanam ity antām̐ samāyamya pūṣā te granthim iti pradakṣiṇam āveṣṭayati //
1.1.1.d: इन्द्राण्याः संनहनम् इत्य् अन्ताम्̐ समायम्य पूषा ते ग्रन्थिम् इति प्रदक्षिणम् आवेष्टयति //
1.1.1.m: Saying, "The binding-band of Indrāṇī!" he pulls together the ends, and saying, "May Pūṣan [tie] thy knot!" he winds [the cord] around clockwise.

1.1.1.s: sa te māsthāt \\ iti paścātprāñcam upakarṣati /
1.1.1.d: स ते मास्थात् \\ इति पश्चात्प्राञ्चम् उपकर्षति /
1.1.1.m: "May it not stand against thee!"—saying this, he drags it from the west to the east.

1.1.1.s:
āpas tvām aśvinau tvām \ ṛṣayaḥ sapta mām ṛjuḥ /
barhiḥ sūryasya raśmibhir \ uṣasāṃ ketum ārabhe //
ity ārabhate //
1.1.1.d:
आपस् त्वाम् अश्विनौ त्वाम् \ ऋषयः सप्त माम् ऋजुः /
बर्हिः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर् \ उषसां केतुम् आरभे //
इत्य् आरभते //
1.1.1.m:
"The Waters [protect] thee; the two Aśvins [protect] thee; / the seven seers, straightforward, [protect] me.

With the rays of the sun, I take hold of / the sacrificial grass, the banner of the dawns!"

1.1.1.s: indrasya tvā bāhubhyām udyache \\ ity udyachate //
1.1.1.d: इन्द्रस्य त्वा बाहुभ्याम् उद्यछे \\ इत्य् उद्यछते //
1.1.1.m: "With the two arms of Indra I lift thee up!"—saying this, he lifts [it] up.

1.1.1.s: bṛhaspater mūrdhnā harāmi \\ iti mūrdhany ādadhāti //
1.1.1.d: बृहस्पतेर् मूर्ध्ना हरामि \\ इति मूर्धन्य् आदधाति //
1.1.1.m: "With the head of Bṛhaspati I carry [thee]!"—saying this, he places [it] upon his head.

1.1.1.s: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ ity eti //
1.1.1.d: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इत्य् एति //
1.1.1.m: "Traverse the wide mid-air!"—saying this, he walks.

1.1.1.s: adityās tvā pṛṣṭhe sādayāmi \\ iti paścād aparasya sādayaty ano 'dho vā //
1.1.1.d: अदित्यास् त्वा पृष्ठे सादयामि \\ इति पश्चाद् अपरस्य सादयत्य् अनो ऽधो वा //
1.1.1.m: "On the back of Aditi I place thee!"—saying this, he places it to the west of the rear [cart], or underneath the cart.

1.1.1.s: barhir asi devaṃgamam ity uparyādadhāti /
1.1.1.d: बर्हिर् असि देवंगमम् इत्य् उपर्यादधाति /
1.1.1.m: "Thou art sacrificial grass reaching the gods!"—saying this, he places it on top.

1.1.1.s: samūlair darbhaiḥ pālāśaṃ khādiram̐ rauhitakam̐ vāṣṭādaśadārvidhmam̐ saṃnahyati / trīm̐ś ca paridhīn yo yajñiyo vṛkṣas tasya sthaviṣṭho madhyamo drāghīyān dakṣiṇo 'ṇīyān hrasiṣṭha uttaraḥ /
1.1.1.d: समूलैर् दर्भैः पालाशं खादिरम्̐ रौहितकम्̐ वाष्टादशदार्विध्मम्̐ संनह्यति / त्रीम्̐श् च परिधीन् यो यज्ञियो वृक्षस् तस्य स्थविष्ठो मध्यमो द्राघीयान् दक्षिणो ऽणीयान् ह्रसिष्ठ उत्तरः /
1.1.1.m: With root-bearing darbha-grass he binds together the sacrificial fuel consisting of eighteen pieces of wood—of palāśa, khadira, or rohitaka wood—and three enclosing sticks of whichever tree is sacrificial: the thickest is the middle one, the longest is the southern one, the thinnest and shortest is the northern one.

1.1.1.s: uparīdhmam ādadhāti /
1.1.1.d: उपरीध्मम् आदधाति /

1.1.2.s: candrādarśane 'māvāsyāyām idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyāparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti prāgdakṣiṇācārāḥ /
1.1.2.d: चन्द्रादर्शने ऽमावास्यायाम् इध्माबर्हिः संनह्यापराह्णे पिण्डपितृयज्ञेन चरन्ति प्राग्दक्षिणाचाराः /
1.1.2.m: When the moon is not visible on the new-moon day, having bound the sacrificial fuel and grass, they perform the ancestral ball-offering in the afternoon, moving from east to south.

1.1.2.s: prācīnāvavīty uttarataḥpaścād dakṣiṇāgneḥ sam̐stīrya pātrāṇi prayunakti pavitraṃ kṛṣṇājinam ulūkhalaṃ musalam̐ śūrpam udaṅkīm āyavanaṃ darvīm̐ sphyam ekaikaṃ dakṣiṇaṃdakṣiṇam /
1.1.2.d: प्राचीनाववीत्य् उत्तरतःपश्चाद् दक्षिणाग्नेः सम्̐स्तीर्य पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति पवित्रं कृष्णाजिनम् उलूखलं मुसलम्̐ शूर्पम् उदङ्कीम् आयवनं दर्वीम्̐ स्फ्यम् एकैकं दक्षिणंदक्षिणम् /
1.1.2.m: Wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, having spread [sacrificial grass] to the north-west of the southern fire, he arranges the implements one by one, each to the south: the strainer, the black antelope skin, the mortar, the pestle, the winnowing basket, the small bucket, the stirring vessel, the ladle, [and] the wooden sword.

1.1.2.s: dakṣiṇato 'gniṣṭham āruhyodaṅkyām ekapavitram avadhāya pūrayitvā bilaṃ nimārṣṭi /
1.1.2.d: दक्षिणतो ऽग्निष्ठम् आरुह्योदङ्क्याम् एकपवित्रम् अवधाय पूरयित्वा बिलं निमार्ष्टि /
1.1.2.m: Having mounted [the cart] from the south by the axle, having placed a single strainer into the small bucket, and having filled it, he wipes the rim.

1.1.2.s: kṛṣṇājine patny avahanti / parāpāvam avivecayan sakṛt phalīkaroti /
1.1.2.d: कृष्णाजिने पत्न्य् अवहन्ति / परापावम् अविवेचयन् सकृत् फलीकरोति /
1.1.2.m: The wife pounds [the grains] on the black antelope skin. Without separating the winnowings, she husks [them] once.

1.1.2.s: dakṣiṇāgnāv udaṅkīm adhiśritya pavitrāntarhite 'pa ānīya taṇḍulān opya mekṣaṇena prasavyaṃ paryāyuvañjīvataṇḍulam̐ śrapayati /
1.1.2.d: दक्षिणाग्नाव् उदङ्कीम् अधिश्रित्य पवित्रान्तर्हिते ऽप आनीय तण्डुलान् ओप्य मेक्षणेन प्रसव्यं पर्यायुवञ्जीवतण्डुलम्̐ श्रपयति /
1.1.2.m: Having set the small bucket on the southern fire, having poured in water screened by a strainer, and having thrown in the rice grains, he cooks the living rice grains, stirring around counter-clockwise with the stirring stick.

1.1.2.s: ghṛtenānutpūtena navanītena votpūtena śṛtam abhighārya dakṣiṇata udvāsayati /
1.1.2.d: घृतेनानुत्पूतेन नवनीतेन वोत्पूतेन शृतम् अभिघार्य दक्षिणत उद्वासयति /
1.1.2.m: Having basted the cooked [oblation] with unpurified clarified butter or with purified fresh butter, he takes it off the fire to the south.

1.1.2.s: dakṣiṇataḥpurastād dakṣiṇāgnes triṣu prakrameṣv aparimite vāvakāśe sphena sakṛt param uddhatyāvasiñcati /
1.1.2.d: दक्षिणतःपुरस्ताद् दक्षिणाग्नेस् त्रिषु प्रक्रमेष्व् अपरिमिते वावकाशे स्फेन सकृत् परम् उद्धत्यावसिञ्चति /
1.1.2.m: To the south-east of the southern fire, at three paces or in an unmeasured space, having dug up [the ground] once beyond with the wooden sword, he sprinkles [it] with water.

1.1.2.s:
apayantv asurāḥ pitṛrūpās \ ye rūpāṇi pratimucyācaranti /
parāpuro nipuro ye haranti \ agniṣṭān asmāt praṇunottu lokāt //
ity agniṃ praṇayati /
1.1.2.d:
अपयन्त्व् असुराः पितृरूपास् \ ये रूपाणि प्रतिमुच्याचरन्ति /
परापुरो निपुरो ये हरन्ति \ अग्निष्टान् अस्मात् प्रणुनोत्तु लोकात् //
इत्य् अग्निं प्रणयति /
1.1.2.m:
"Let the Asuras depart, having the forms of the fathers, / who wander about having put on disguises;

who carry off the high cities and low cities; / let Agni expel them from this world!"

1.1.2.s: agreṇoddhatam avokṣite sādayati /
1.1.2.d: अग्रेणोद्धतम् अवोक्षिते सादयति /
1.1.2.m: In front of the dug-up [spot], he sets [the fire] down on [the place] sprinkled with water.

1.1.2.s: samūleṣv anyān upasam̐yamya triḥ karṣūm agniṃ ca prasavyam uddhāvaṃ triḥ paristīrya karṣvām uddhavān āstṛṇāti /
1.1.2.d: समूलेष्व् अन्यान् उपसम्̐यम्य त्रिः कर्षूम् अग्निं च प्रसव्यम् उद्धावं त्रिः परिस्तीर्य कर्ष्वाम् उद्धवान् आस्तृणाति /
1.1.2.m: Having gathered other [grasses] with their roots, having strewn three times counter-clockwise around the furrow and the fire, shaking [the grass] out three times, he spreads the shaken-out [grasses] in the furrow.

1.1.2.s: pratiparikramya savyam anvekaikam āharaty āyavanaṃ darvīm odanam āñjanam abhyañjanam ūrṇāstukam udakumbham //
1.1.2.d: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य सव्यम् अन्वेकैकम् आहरत्य् आयवनं दर्वीम् ओदनम् आञ्जनम् अभ्यञ्जनम् ऊर्णास्तुकम् उदकुम्भम् //
1.1.2.m: Going back counter-clockwise, he brings [the items] one by one: the stirring vessel, the ladle, the boiled rice, the eye-salve, the ointment, the tuft of wool, [and] the water pitcher.

1.1.2.s: eta pitaro manojavās \\ āganta pitaro manojavās \\ ity āvāhayati /
1.1.2.d: एत पितरो मनोजवास् \\ आगन्त पितरो मनोजवास् \\ इत्य् आवाहयति /
1.1.2.m: "Come, O fathers, swift as thought! / Arrive, O fathers, swift as thought!"—with [this] he invokes them.

1.1.2.s: pariśrayed yady ādityaḥ sakāśe syāt //
1.1.2.d: परिश्रयेद् यद्य् आदित्यः सकाशे स्यात् //
1.1.2.m: He should screen off [the place] if the sun should be in sight.

1.1.2.s: paretana pitaraḥ somyāsas \\ ity udakumbhenāgniṃ prasavyaṃ triḥ pariṣiñcan paryeti //
1.1.2.d: परेतन पितरः सोम्यासस् \\ इत्य् उदकुम्भेनाग्निं प्रसव्यं त्रिः परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति //
1.1.2.m: "Depart, O fathers, rich in Soma!"—with [this verse] he walks around the fire counter-clockwise three times, sprinkling [water] with the water pitcher.

1.1.2.s: ayā viṣṭhā \\ ity etayā nidhāya nidhāya trir apariṣiñcan pratiparyeti //
1.1.2.d: अया विष्ठा \\ इत्य् एतया निधाय निधाय त्रिर् अपरिषिञ्चन् प्रतिपर्येति //
1.1.2.m: With "By this abode…", setting [the pitcher] down each time, he goes back around three times without sprinkling.

1.1.2.s: śundhantāṃ pitaraḥ \ śundhantāṃ pitāmahāḥ \ śundhantāṃ prapitāmahās \\ iti mūladeśe barhiṣas trīn udakāñjalīn ninayati /
1.1.2.d: शुन्धन्तां पितरः \ शुन्धन्तां पितामहाः \ शुन्धन्तां प्रपितामहास् \\ इति मूलदेशे बर्हिषस् त्रीन् उदकाञ्जलीन् निनयति /
1.1.2.m: "May the fathers be cleansed! May the grandfathers be cleansed! May the great-grandfathers be cleansed!"—with [these words] he pours out three handfuls of water at the root-end of the sacrificial grass.

1.1.2.s: mekṣaṇenopahatya somāya pitṛmate svadhā namas \\ iti juhoti //
1.1.2.d: मेक्षणेनोपहत्य सोमाय पितृमते स्वधा नमस् \\ इति जुहोति //
1.1.2.m: Having scooped with the stirring stick, he offers with: "To Soma accompanied by the fathers, svadhā, homage!"

1.1.2.s: agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā namas \\ ity asam̐saktāṃ dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe dvitīyām̐ hutvā mekṣaṇam anvadhyasyati kañcukāni pavitraṃ ca /
1.1.2.d: अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वधा नमस् \\ इत्य् असम्̐सक्तां दक्षिणार्धपूर्वार्धे द्वितीयाम्̐ हुत्वा मेक्षणम् अन्वध्यस्यति कञ्चुकानि पवित्रं च /
1.1.2.m: Having offered the second [oblation] without touching [the first], in the south-eastern half, with: "To Agni, bearer of the funeral oblations, svadhā, homage!", he throws the stirring stick, the husks, and the strainer into the fire after it.

1.1.2.s: darvyoddhṛtyoddhaveṣu piṇḍān nidadhāti / pitur nāmnā \\ sāv etat te \ ye cātra tvānu tasmai te svadhā \\ iti prathamaṃ pitāmahasya nāmnā sthavīyām̐saṃ madhyamaṃ prapitāmahasya nāmnā sthaviṣṭhaṃ dakṣiṇam /
1.1.2.d: दर्व्योद्धृत्योद्धवेषु पिण्डान् निदधाति / पितुर् नाम्ना \\ साव् एतत् ते \ ये चात्र त्वानु तस्मै ते स्वधा \\ इति प्रथमं पितामहस्य नाम्ना स्थवीयाम्̐सं मध्यमं प्रपितामहस्य नाम्ना स्थविष्ठं दक्षिणम् /
1.1.2.m: Having taken up [the rice] with the ladle, he sets down the balls on the shaken-out [grasses]: the first with the father's name, [saying,] "N.N., this is yours, and whoever here follow you, to that [person] and to you, svadhā!"; the middle one, thicker, with the grandfather's name; the southernmost, thickest, with the great-grandfather's name.

1.1.2.s: dvayoḥ parayor nāmnī gṛhṇan mūladeśe lepaṃ nimārṣṭi /
1.1.2.d: द्वयोः परयोर् नाम्नी गृह्णन् मूलदेशे लेपं निमार्ष्टि /
1.1.2.m: Uttering the names of the next two, he wipes the residue at the root-end.

1.1.2.s: lupyate jīvatpituḥ piṇḍanidhānaṃ jīvatpitāmahasya vā / na jīvantam atidadyād yadi dadyād yebhya eva pitā dadyāt tebhyo dadyāt /
1.1.2.d: लुप्यते जीवत्पितुः पिण्डनिधानं जीवत्पितामहस्य वा / न जीवन्तम् अतिदद्याद् यदि दद्याद् येभ्य एव पिता दद्यात् तेभ्यो दद्यात् /
1.1.2.m: The setting down of the ball is omitted for one whose father is living, or for one whose grandfather is living. He should not offer past a living person; if he should offer, he should offer to those very ones to whom the father would offer.

1.1.2.s: yadi bandhunāma na viditam \\ svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhyas \\ iti tṛtīyam //
1.1.2.d: यदि बन्धुनाम न विदितम् \\ स्वधा पितृभ्यो दिविषद्भ्यस् \\ इति तृतीयम् //
1.1.2.m: If a relative's name is not known, [he offers] the third with: "Svadhā to the fathers dwelling in heaven!"

1.1.2.s: yātra pitaraḥ svadhā tayā yūyaṃ mādayadhvam iti dakṣiṇāṃ diśam anvīkṣamāṇo japati //
1.1.2.d: यात्र पितरः स्वधा तया यूयं मादयध्वम् इति दक्षिणां दिशम् अन्वीक्षमाणो जपति //
1.1.2.m: "Whatever svadhā is here, O fathers, with that exhilarate yourselves!"—[with this] he mutters, looking toward the southern direction.

1.1.2.s: yeha pitara ūrk tasyai vayaṃ jyogjīvanto bhūyāsma \\ ity uktvāvartate /
1.1.2.d: येह पितर ऊर्क् तस्यै वयं ज्योग्जीवन्तो भूयास्म \\ इत्य् उक्त्वावर्तते /
1.1.2.m: "Whatever refreshment is here, O fathers, may we, living long, enjoy that!"—having spoken [this], he turns around.

1.1.2.s: ā tamitor āste dakṣiṇāgnim anvīkṣamāṇaḥ /
1.1.2.d: आ तमितोर् आस्ते दक्षिणाग्निम् अन्वीक्षमाणः /
1.1.2.m: He sits until the cessation of his breath, looking toward the southern fire.

1.1.2.s: vyūṣmasu piṇḍeṣu \\ amīmadanta pitaras \\ iti pratiparyāvartate /
1.1.2.d: व्यूष्मसु पिण्डेषु \\ अमीमदन्त पितरस् \\ इति प्रतिपर्यावर्तते /
1.1.2.m: When the balls have lost their steam, he turns back with: "The fathers have exhilarated themselves!"

1.1.2.s: vāsasa ūrṇāṃ daśāṃ vābhyukṣya piṇḍadeśe nidadhāti /
1.1.2.d: वासस ऊर्णां दशां वाभ्युक्ष्य पिण्डदेशे निदधाति /
1.1.2.m: Having sprinkled wool or the fringe of a garment, he places it on the place of the balls.

1.1.2.s: lomottaravayasaś chittvā vāsaso vā daśām ato no 'nyat pitaro mā yoṣṭa \\ iti nidadhyāt //
1.1.2.d: लोमोत्तरवयसश् छित्त्वा वाससो वा दशाम् अतो नो ऽन्यत् पितरो मा योष्ट \\ इति निदध्यात् //
1.1.2.m: Having cut off hair from an older person, or a fringe of a garment, he should place it with: "From this, O fathers, do not separate us for another!"

1.1.2.s: āṅkṣv āsau \\ ity āñjanasya pratipiṇḍaṃ lepaṃ nimārṣṭi \\ abhyaṅkṣvāsau \\ ity abhyañjanasya //
1.1.2.d: आङ्क्ष्व् आसौ \\ इत्य् आञ्जनस्य प्रतिपिण्डं लेपं निमार्ष्टि \\ अभ्यङ्क्ष्वासौ \\ इत्य् अभ्यञ्जनस्य //
1.1.2.m: "Anoint your eyes, N.N.!"—with [this] he wipes a smear of eye-salve for each ball; with "Anoint your body, N.N.!", [a smear] of ointment.

1.1.2.s: mārjayantāṃ pitaras \\ mārjayantāṃ pitāmahās \\ mārjayantāṃ prapitāmahās \\ iti pratipiṇḍaṃ trīn udakāñjalīn ninayati /
1.1.2.d: मार्जयन्तां पितरस् \\ मार्जयन्तां पितामहास् \\ मार्जयन्तां प्रपितामहास् \\ इति प्रतिपिण्डं त्रीन् उदकाञ्जलीन् निनयति /
1.1.2.m: "May the fathers purify themselves! May the grandfathers purify themselves! May the great-grandfathers purify themselves!"—with [these words] he pours out three handfuls of water for each ball.

1.1.2.s:
ādhatta pitaro garbham \ kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajam /
yathā pumān bhaved iha \ tathā kṛṇutoṣmapāḥ //
iti madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ patnī prāśnīyāt /
1.1.2.d:
आधत्त पितरो गर्भम् \ कुमारं पुष्करस्रजम् /
यथा पुमान् भवेद् इह \ तथा कृणुतोष्मपाः //
इति मध्यमं पिण्डं पत्नी प्राश्नीयात् /

1.1.2.s: agnāv itarāv ādadhyād brāhmaṇo vā bhakṣayed apsu vā gamayet /
1.1.2.d: अग्नाव् इतराव् आदध्याद् ब्राह्मणो वा भक्षयेद् अप्सु वा गमयेत् /
1.1.2.m: He should put the other two into the fire, or a brāhmaṇa should eat [them], or he should cast [them] into water.

1.1.2.s: uddhavān anuprahṛtya vīraṃ no datta pitaras \\ ity udaṅkīm avajighret /
1.1.2.d: उद्धवान् अनुप्रहृत्य वीरं नो दत्त पितरस् \\ इत्य् उदङ्कीम् अवजिघ्रेत् /
1.1.2.m: Having thrown the shaken-out [grasses] into the fire, he should smell the small bucket with: "Give us a hero, O fathers!"

1.1.2.s: apa upaspṛśya namo vaḥ pitaras \\ iti namaskaroti //
1.1.2.d: अप उपस्पृश्य नमो वः पितरस् \\ इति नमस्करोति //
1.1.2.m: Having touched water, he pays homage with: "Homage to you, O fathers!"

1.1.2.s: eṣā yuṣmākaṃ pitaras \\ iti diśam anudiśati \\ imā asmākam itītarāḥ //
1.1.2.d: एषा युष्माकं पितरस् \\ इति दिशम् अनुदिशति \\ इमा अस्माकम् इतीतराः //
1.1.2.m: "This is yours, O fathers!"—with [this] he points to the [southern] direction; with "These are ours!", to the other [directions].

1.1.2.s: jīvā vo jīvanta iha santaḥ syāma \\ iti japati //
1.1.2.d: जीवा वो जीवन्त इह सन्तः स्याम \\ इति जपति //
1.1.2.m: "Living, may we be living here with you!"—[with this] he mutters.

1.1.2.s: paretana pitaraḥ somyāsas \\ iti pravāhayati //
1.1.2.d: परेतन पितरः सोम्यासस् \\ इति प्रवाहयति //
1.1.2.m: "Depart, O fathers, rich in Soma!"—with [this] he dismisses them.

1.1.2.s: prajāpate na tvat \\ ity etayopottiṣṭhati //
1.1.2.d: प्रजापते न त्वत् \\ इत्य् एतयोपोत्तिष्ठति //
1.1.2.m: With "O Prajāpati, none other than you…", he stands up nearby.

1.1.2.s: akṣann amīmadanta \\ iti punareti /
1.1.2.d: अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त \\ इति पुनरेति /
1.1.2.m: With "They have eaten, they have exhilarated themselves…", he returns.

1.1.2.s: manasvatīr japann agne tam adya \\ ity etayā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
1.1.2.d: मनस्वतीर् जपन्न् अग्ने तम् अद्य \\ इत्य् एतया गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते /
1.1.2.m: Muttering the [verses] containing the word 'manas', he attends upon the gārhapatya fire with: "O Agni, that today…"

1.1.2.s: abhyukṣya pātrāṇi dvedve pratipariharati /
1.1.2.d: अभ्युक्ष्य पात्राणि द्वेद्वे प्रतिपरिहरति /
1.1.2.m: Having sprinkled the utensils, he takes them away two by two.

1.1.2.s: apy anāhitāgninā kāryaḥ /
1.1.2.d: अप्य् अनाहिताग्निना कार्यः /
1.1.2.m: [This rite] is to be performed even by one who has not established the sacred fires.

1.1.3.s: vedaṃ karoti vatsajñuṃ prasavyam āveṣṭya tūlair dakṣiṇottariṇaṃ / tūleṣu śulbaṃ pratinidhāya trir āveṣṭya saṃnahyaty uttaramuttaraṃ pradakṣiṇam /
1.1.3.d: वेदं करोति वत्सज्ञुं प्रसव्यम् आवेष्ट्य तूलैर् दक्षिणोत्तरिणं / तूलेषु शुल्बं प्रतिनिधाय त्रिर् आवेष्ट्य संनह्यत्य् उत्तरमुत्तरं प्रदक्षिणम् /
1.1.3.m: He makes the broom, shaped like a calf's knee, wrapping it counter-clockwise, with the tips covering the base; having placed the cord on the tips, wrapping it three times, he binds it successively higher, clockwise.

1.1.3.s: prādeśamātre śulbāt parivāsyotkare mūlāni gamayati tūlāni nidadaḥti /
1.1.3.d: प्रादेशमात्रे शुल्बात् परिवास्योत्करे मूलानि गमयति तूलानि निददःति /
1.1.3.m: Having trimmed it at a span's measure from the cord, he throws the root-ends onto the rubbish heap and places the tips down.

1.1.3.s: vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti pūrvedyur amāvāsyāyām ottarasmāt parigrahāt /
1.1.3.d: वेदं कृत्वा वेदिं करोति पूर्वेद्युर् अमावास्यायाम् ओत्तरस्मात् परिग्रहात् /
1.1.3.m: Having made the broom, he prepares the altar on the previous day, on the new-moon day, up to the second enclosure.

1.1.3.s: antarvedi śākhāyāḥ palāśāni viśātya mūlataḥ parivāsya tasyāntarvedi nyasyet /
1.1.3.d: अन्तर्वेदि शाखायाः पलाशानि विशात्य मूलतः परिवास्य तस्यान्तर्वेदि न्यस्येत् /
1.1.3.m: Having stripped off the leaves of the branch inside the altar and having cut it off from the base, he should place it inside the altar.

1.1.3.s: upaveṣaṃ ca kuryāt tena ca kapālāny upadadhāti /
1.1.3.d: उपवेषं च कुर्यात् तेन च कपालान्य् उपदधाति /
1.1.3.m: He should also make the fire-stirrer, and with it he places the potsherds [on the fire].

1.1.3.s: darbhamayaṃ pavitraṃ triguṇarajju śākhāyām anulomam avasṛjed granthim akurvan /
1.1.3.d: दर्भमयं पवित्रं त्रिगुणरज्जु शाखायाम् अनुलोमम् अवसृजेद् ग्रन्थिम् अकुर्वन् /
1.1.3.m: He should attach a darbha-grass strainer [and] a threefold-twisted cord along the branch from the top downwards, without tying a knot.

1.1.3.s:
etā ācarantīr madhumad duhānāḥ \ prajāvarīr yaśase viśvarūpāḥ /
bahvīr bhavantīr upajāyamānās\ iha va indro ramayatu gāvaḥ //
iha vo mahendro ramayatu gāvas \\ ity āyatīr anumantrayate /
1.1.3.d:
एता आचरन्तीर् मधुमद् दुहानाः \ प्रजावरीर् यशसे विश्वरूपाः /
बह्वीर् भवन्तीर् उपजायमानास्\ इह व इन्द्रो रमयतु गावः //
इह वो महेन्द्रो रमयतु गावस् \\ इत्य् आयतीर् अनुमन्त्रयते /
1.1.3.m:
"These, coming along, yielding sweet milk, / having offspring, glorious, of all forms,

becoming many, being born here— / may Indra make the cows rejoice here!"

With [the verse beginning] "May Mahendra make the cows rejoice here…", he accompanies [the cows] as they come.

1.1.3.s: yavāgvaitām̐ rātrīm̐ yajamāno 'gnihotraṃ juhoti / tasyāḥ piṇḍaṃ nidadhyāt /
1.1.3.d: यवाग्वैताम्̐ रात्रीम्̐ यजमानो ऽग्निहोत्रं जुहोति / तस्याः पिण्डं निदध्यात् /
1.1.3.m: On this night, the sacrificer offers the Agnihotra with barley gruel. He should place down a ball of it.

1.1.3.s: paristṛṇāti pūrvam agnim aparau ca /
1.1.3.d: परिस्तृणाति पूर्वम् अग्निम् अपरौ च /
1.1.3.m: He strews around the eastern fire and the two western fires.

1.1.3.s: uttarato gārhapatyasya sam̐stīrṇe dvedve prayunakti kumbhyau śākhāpavitraṃ nidāne dohanaṃ prokṣaṇīm /
1.1.3.d: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य सम्̐स्तीर्णे द्वेद्वे प्रयुनक्ति कुम्भ्यौ शाखापवित्रं निदाने दोहनं प्रोक्षणीम् /
1.1.3.m: To the north of the gārhapatya fire, on the [grass] spread out, he sets down [the implements] two by two: the two milk-pots, the branch-strainer, the two tethering cords, the milking pail, [and] the sprinkling-water vessel.

1.1.3.s: barhiṣaḥ pavitre kurute prādeśamātre same 'prachinnaprānte //
1.1.3.d: बर्हिषः पवित्रे कुरुते प्रादेशमात्रे समे ऽप्रछिन्नप्रान्ते //
1.1.3.m: From sacrificial grass, he makes two strainers, a span in measure, equal, with unbroken tips.

1.1.3.s: oṣadhyā vaiṣṇave sthas \\ iti chinatti //
1.1.3.d: ओषध्या वैष्णवे स्थस् \\ इति छिनत्ति //
1.1.3.m: "You two belong to the plant, to Viṣṇu!"—with [this] he cuts them.

1.1.3.s: viṣṇor manasā pūte sthas \\ ity adbhis trir anumārṣṭi /
1.1.3.d: विष्णोर् मनसा पूते स्थस् \\ इत्य् अद्भिस् त्रिर् अनुमार्ष्टि /
1.1.3.m: "You two are purified by the mind of Viṣṇu!"—with [this] he wipes them three times with water.

1.1.3.s: apaḥ srucy āsicyottānau pāṇī kṛtvāṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cādāya devo vaḥ savitotpunātu \\ ity etayā paccho 'pa utpunāti //
1.1.3.d: अपः स्रुच्य् आसिच्योत्तानौ पाणी कृत्वाङ्गुष्ठेनोपमध्यमया चादाय देवो वः सवितोत्पुनातु \\ इत्य् एतया पच्छो ऽप उत्पुनाति //
1.1.3.m: Having poured water into the ladle and held his hands face upward, grasping [the two strainers] with the thumb and the ring finger, he purifies the water quarter by quarter with: 'May the god Savitṛ purify you.'

1.1.3.s: śundhadhvam iti pātrāṇi prokṣati /
1.1.3.d: शुन्धध्वम् इति पात्राणि प्रोक्षति /
1.1.3.m: With: 'Be cleansed,' he sprinkles the vessels.

1.1.3.s: dohanaṃ nidāne goduhe pradāya \\ upasṛṣṭāṃ me prabrūtāt \\ vihāraṃ ca gāṃ copasṛṣṭāmantareṇa mā saṃcāriṣur iti brūyāt //
1.1.3.d: दोहनं निदाने गोदुहे प्रदाय \\ उपसृष्टां मे प्रब्रूतात् \\ विहारं च गां चोपसृष्टामन्तरेण मा संचारिषुर् इति ब्रूयात् //
1.1.3.m: Having handed the milking pail and the two tethers to the milker, he should say: 'Report to me [the cow] when she has been allowed to unite [with her calf]; let none walk between the sacrificial enclosure and the cow allowed to unite.'

1.1.3.s:
upasṛjāmi \\ ity ukte poṣāya tvā \\ iti vatsam avasṛjyamānam anumantrayate /
ayakṣmā vaḥ prajayā sam̐sṛjāmi \ rāyaspoṣeṇa bahulā bhavantīḥ /
iti saṃgachamānām adityā rāsnāsi \\ iti nidīyamānām //
1.1.3.d:
उपसृजामि \\ इत्य् उक्ते पोषाय त्वा \\ इति वत्सम् अवसृज्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
अयक्ष्मा वः प्रजया सम्̐सृजामि \ रायस्पोषेण बहुला भवन्तीः /
इति संगछमानाम् अदित्या रास्नासि \\ इति निदीयमानाम् //
1.1.3.m:
When it is said: 'I am allowing [her] to unite,' he accompanies the calf being released with the mantra: 'For nourishment [I release] you.'

'Free from disease, I unite you with your offspring; becoming abundant with increase of wealth'—

with this [mantra he accompanies her] coming together; with: 'You are the girdle of Aditi,' [he accompanies her] being tethered.

1.1.3.s:
upasīdāmi \\ ity ukte
ūrjaṃ payaḥ pinvamānā ghṛtaṃ ca \ jīvā jīvantīr upa vaḥ sadema //
iti japati //
1.1.3.d:
उपसीदामि \\ इत्य् उक्ते
ऊर्जं पयः पिन्वमाना घृतं च \ जीवा जीवन्तीर् उप वः सदेम //
इति जपति //
1.1.3.m: 'Swelling with vigor, milk, and clarified butter, / may we, living, sit down near you who are living'—

1.1.3.s: vasūnāṃ pavitram asi \\ iti śākhāpavitram ādatte / dyaur asi pṛthivy asi \\ ity ukhām //
1.1.3.d: वसूनां पवित्रम् असि \\ इति शाखापवित्रम् आदत्ते / द्यौर् असि पृथिव्य् असि \\ इत्य् उखाम् //
1.1.3.m: With: 'You are the strainer of the Vasus,' he takes the branch-strainer; with: 'You are heaven, you are earth,' the milk-pot.

1.1.3.s: mātariśvano gharmas \\ ity adhiśrayati / pavitram avadadhāti /
1.1.3.d: मातरिश्वनो घर्मस् \\ इत्य् अधिश्रयति / पवित्रम् अवदधाति /
1.1.3.m: With: 'The hot cauldron of Mātariśvan,' he places it on the fire. He inserts the strainer.

1.1.3.s: anvārabhya vācam̐ yachati /
1.1.3.d: अन्वारभ्य वाचम्̐ यछति /
1.1.3.m: Having taken hold [of it], he restrains his speech.

1.1.3.s: prāk sāyaṃ pavitram ādadhāti tiryak prātaḥ /
1.1.3.d: प्राक् सायं पवित्रम् आदधाति तिर्यक् प्रातः /
1.1.3.m: He places the strainer facing eastward in the evening, crosswise in the morning.

1.1.3.s:
utsaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilam \ iḍāṃ dhenuṃ madhumatīm̐ svastaye /
tad indrāgnī pinvatām̐ sūnṛtāvat \ tad yajamānam amṛtatve dadhātu //
iti dhārāghoṣe japati /
1.1.3.d:
उत्सं दुहन्ति कलशं चतुर्बिलम् \ इडां धेनुं मधुमतीम्̐ स्वस्तये /
तद् इन्द्राग्नी पिन्वताम्̐ सूनृतावत् \ तद् यजमानम् अमृतत्वे दधातु //
इति धाराघोषे जपति /
1.1.3.m:
'They milk the fountain, the four-spouted vessel, / the cow Iḍā, full of sweetness, for well-being;

let Indra and Agni make that swell bountifully, / let that place the sacrificer in immortality'—

1.1.3.s: dugdhvānayati kumbhyām //
1.1.3.d: दुग्ध्वानयति कुम्भ्याम् //
1.1.3.m: Having milked, [the milker] brings [the milk] into the pot.

1.1.3.s: dyauś cemam̐ yajñaṃ pṛthivī ca saṃduhātām \\ dhātā somena saha vātena vāyur \ yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu \\ ity āsicyamāne japati //
1.1.3.d: द्यौश् चेमम्̐ यज्ञं पृथिवी च संदुहाताम् \\ धाता सोमेन सह वातेन वायुर् \ यजमानाय द्रविणं दधातु \\ इत्य् आसिच्यमाने जपति //
1.1.3.m: 'May both heaven and earth milk this sacrifice together; / may Dhātṛ together with Soma, [and] Vāyu together with the wind, bestow wealth on the sacrificer'—with this [mantra] he mutters while it is being poured.

1.1.3.s: kām adhukṣas \\ iti pṛchati \\ amūm itītaraḥ //
1.1.3.d: काम् अधुक्षस् \\ इति पृछति \\ अमूम् इतीतरः //
1.1.3.m: 'Which one have you milked?' he asks. 'Such-and-such a one,' the other replies.

1.1.3.s: sā viśvāyur astv asau \\ iti gor nāma gṛhṇāti sā viśvabhūr iti dvitīyasyām \\ sā viśvakarmā \\ iti tṛtīyasyām /
1.1.3.d: सा विश्वायुर् अस्त्व् असौ \\ इति गोर् नाम गृह्णाति सा विश्वभूर् इति द्वितीयस्याम् \\ सा विश्वकर्मा \\ इति तृतीयस्याम् /
1.1.3.m: With: 'May that one, such-and-such, be full life,' he pronounces the cow's name; with: 'May that one be all-sustaining,' at the second; with: 'May that one be all-creating,' at the third.

1.1.3.s: samānaṃ dohanam /
1.1.3.d: समानं दोहनम् /

1.1.3.s: tisṛṣu dugdhāsu bahu dugdhīndrāya devebhyo havir iti trir uktvā vācam̐ visṛjate // mahendrāya \\ iti vā /
1.1.3.d: तिसृषु दुग्धासु बहु दुग्धीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो हविर् इति त्रिर् उक्त्वा वाचम्̐ विसृजते // महेन्द्राय \\ इति वा /
1.1.3.m: When three have been milked, having said three times: 'Milk much oblation for Indra, for the gods!' he releases his speech; or [he says]: 'for Mahendra.'

1.1.3.s: visṛṣṭavāg ananvārabhya tūṣṇīm uttarās tisro dohayati //
1.1.3.d: विसृष्टवाग् अनन्वारभ्य तूष्णीम् उत्तरास् तिस्रो दोहयति //
1.1.3.m: Having released his speech, without holding on, he silently causes the remaining three to be milked.

1.1.3.s: hutaḥ stokas \\ iti // sarvāsu dugdhāsu japati /
1.1.3.d: हुतः स्तोकस् \\ इति // सर्वासु दुग्धासु जपति /
1.1.3.m: With: 'Offered is the drop,' he mutters when all have been milked.

1.1.3.s:
saṃpṛcyadhvam ṛtāvarīr \ ūrmiṇā madhumattamāḥ /
pṛñcatīḥ payasā payas\ mandrā dhanasya sātaye //
iti dohanasaṃkṣālanaṃ kumbhyām ānayati //
1.1.3.d:
संपृच्यध्वम् ऋतावरीर् \ ऊर्मिणा मधुमत्तमाः /
पृञ्चतीः पयसा पयस्\ मन्द्रा धनस्य सातये //
इति दोहनसंक्षालनं कुम्भ्याम् आनयति //

1.1.3.s: dṛm̐ha gās \\ dṛm̐ha gopatim \\ mā vo yajñapatī riṣat \\ ity udag vāsayati vartma kurvan /
1.1.3.d: दृम्̐ह गास् \\ दृम्̐ह गोपतिम् \\ मा वो यज्ञपती रिषत् \\ इत्य् उदग् वासयति वर्त्म कुर्वन् /
1.1.3.m: With: 'Strengthen the cows, strengthen the lord of cows, let not your master of sacrifice suffer harm,' he takes it off toward the north, making a path [through the ashes].

1.1.3.s: śītībhūtam agnihotroccheṣeṇa dadhnā \\ indrāya tvā bhāgam̐ somenātanacmi \\ ity ātanakti // mahendrāya \\ iti vā //
1.1.3.d: शीतीभूतम् अग्निहोत्रोच्छेषेण दध्ना \\ इन्द्राय त्वा भागम्̐ सोमेनातनच्मि \\ इत्य् आतनक्ति // महेन्द्राय \\ इति वा //
1.1.3.m: When it has cooled down, with the residue of the agnihotra curd, he curdles it with: 'I curdle you as a portion for Indra with Soma,' or: 'for Mahendra.'

1.1.3.s: adastam asi viṣṇave tvā \\ iti yavāgvāḥ piṇḍam avadadhāti //
1.1.3.d: अदस्तम् असि विष्णवे त्वा \\ इति यवाग्वाः पिण्डम् अवदधाति //
1.1.3.m: With: 'You are unconsumed, for Viṣṇu [I place] you,' he drops in a ball of barley gruel.

1.1.3.s: viṣṇo havyam̐ rakṣasva \\ ity uparyādadhāti //
1.1.3.d: विष्णो हव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इत्य् उपर्यादधाति //
1.1.3.m: With: 'O Viṣṇu, guard the offering,' he places [the branch-strainer] on top.

1.1.3.s: āpo jāgṛta \\ iti modakenāpidadhāti dārupātreṇāyaspātreṇa vā / yadi mṛnmayam̐ syāt tṛṇaṃ dāru vāntardadhyāt /
1.1.3.d: आपो जागृत \\ इति मोदकेनापिदधाति दारुपात्रेणायस्पात्रेण वा / यदि मृन्मयम्̐ स्यात् तृणं दारु वान्तर्दध्यात् /
1.1.3.m: With: 'O waters, be watchful,' he covers it with a cake, or with a wooden vessel, or with an iron vessel; if it should be earthen, he should place grass or wood in between.

1.1.3.s: prātardohāya vatsān apākaroti /
1.1.3.d: प्रातर्दोहाय वत्सान् अपाकरोति /
1.1.3.m: He separates the calves for the morning milking.

1.1.3.s: upasarjanaprabhṛti samānam odvāsanāt /
1.1.3.d: उपसर्जनप्रभृति समानम् ओद्वासनात् /
1.1.3.m: From the letting loose [of the calf] onward, [the ritual] is the same up to the taking off from the fire.

1.1.3.s: gārhapatye havīm̐ṣi śrapayaty āhavanīye juhoti /
1.1.3.d: गार्हपत्ये हवीम्̐षि श्रपयत्य् आहवनीये जुहोति /
1.1.3.m: He cooks the oblations on the gārhapatya; he offers on the āhavanīya.

1.1.3.s: nāgnibhyo vyāvartetā vipariharan kuryāt /
1.1.3.d: नाग्निभ्यो व्यावर्तेता विपरिहरन् कुर्यात् /
1.1.3.m: He should not turn his back to the fires; he should perform [rites] without walking around [them in reverse].

1.1.3.s: śulbārthe prādakṣiṇam̐ śulbam̐ rajjvarthe pradakṣiṇā rajjuḥ /
1.1.3.d: शुल्बार्थे प्रादक्षिणम्̐ शुल्बम्̐ रज्ज्वर्थे प्रदक्षिणा रज्जुः /
1.1.3.m: In the case of a cord, it is twisted clockwise; in the case of a rope, it is twisted clockwise.

1.1.3.s: prokṣaṇam utpavanam̐ saṃmārjanam iti triḥ /
1.1.3.d: प्रोक्षणम् उत्पवनम्̐ संमार्जनम् इति त्रिः /
1.1.3.m: Sprinkling, purifying, and sweeping are done three times each.

1.1.3.s: darbhaiḥ kuryād vaihārikāṇi vaihārikāṇi /
1.1.3.d: दर्भैः कुर्याद् वैहारिकाणि वैहारिकाणि /
1.1.3.m: With darbha grass he should perform the actions belonging to the sacrificial enclosure, one after another.

1.2.1.s: śvobhūte paścād gārhapatyasyodīca uddhūya sam̐stṛṇāti /
1.2.1.d: श्वोभूते पश्चाद् गार्हपत्यस्योदीच उद्धूय सम्̐स्तृणाति /
1.2.1.m: On the next day, having swept westward behind the gārhapatya, he strews [grass] northward.

1.2.1.s: saṃtatām ulaparājim̐ stṛṇāti dakṣiṇena vihāram āhavanīyasya pūrvārdhād dvitīyām uttareṇa vihāram agreṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇair uttarān avastṛṇāti /
1.2.1.d: संतताम् उलपराजिम्̐ स्तृणाति दक्षिणेन विहारम् आहवनीयस्य पूर्वार्धाद् द्वितीयाम् उत्तरेण विहारम् अग्रेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणैर् उत्तरान् अवस्तृणाति /
1.2.1.m: He strews a continuous line of reed-grass to the south of the sacrificial enclosure from the eastern half of the āhavanīya; a second [line] to the north of the sacrificial enclosure; in front of the āhavanīya, he covers the northern [grass-blades] with the southern ones.

1.2.1.s: dakṣiṇā vedyam̐sād brahmaṇe sam̐stṛṇāty aparam̐ yajamānāya paścārdhe patnyai /
1.2.1.d: दक्षिणा वेद्यम्̐साद् ब्रह्मणे सम्̐स्तृणात्य् अपरम्̐ यजमानाय पश्चार्धे पत्न्यै /
1.2.1.m: To the south from the shoulder of the altar he strews [a seat] for the brahman priest, another for the sacrificer, [and] on the western side for the wife.

1.2.1.s: uttarataḥ sam̐stīrṇād dakṣiṇā pavitracamasasphyakapālāgnihotrahavaṇīśūrpakṛṣṇājinaśamyolūkhalamusaladṛṣadupalavedakuṭarusruvajuhūpabhṛddhruvāprāśitraharaṇeḍāpātryājyadhānapātrīsam̐vapanapātrīḥ prakṣālya sam̐stīrṇe dvedve prayunakti / kuṭarvantāny aparāṇi /
1.2.1.d: उत्तरतः सम्̐स्तीर्णाद् दक्षिणा पवित्रचमसस्फ्यकपालाग्निहोत्रहवणीशूर्पकृष्णाजिनशम्योलूखलमुसलदृषदुपलवेदकुटरुस्रुवजुहूपभृद्ध्रुवाप्राशित्रहरणेडापात्र्याज्यधानपात्रीसम्̐वपनपात्रीः प्रक्षाल्य सम्̐स्तीर्णे द्वेद्वे प्रयुनक्ति / कुटर्वन्तान्य् अपराणि /
1.2.1.m: To the south of what has been strewn in the north, having washed the strainer, the drinking cup, the wooden sword, the potsherds, the agnihotra-ladle, the winnowing basket, the black antelope skin, the yoke-pin, the mortar, the pestle, the lower and upper millstones, the grass-brush, the axe, the dipping-spoon, the juhū ladle, the upabhṛt ladle, the dhruvā ladle, the vessel for taking the prāśitra portion, the iḍā plate, the clarified-butter container, and the mixing bowl, he arranges them two by two on the strewn [grass]; the subsequent ones terminate with the axe.

1.2.1.s: khādiram̐ sphyasruvaṃ pālāśī juhūr āśvatthy upabhṛd vaikaṅkatī dhruvā /
1.2.1.d: खादिरम्̐ स्फ्यस्रुवं पालाशी जुहूर् आश्वत्थ्य् उपभृद् वैकङ्कती ध्रुवा /
1.2.1.m: The wooden sword and the dipping-spoon are of khadira wood, the juhū of palāśa wood, the upabhṛt of aśvattha wood, the dhruvā of vikaṅkata wood.

1.2.1.s: mūlato 'ratnimātradaṇḍāḥ pāṇitalamātrapuṣkarās tvacobilā dvyaṅgulakhātāś caturaṅgulocchrayāḥ / prādeśamātrāṇi prasravaṇāni / [ sarvā aratnimātrā vā ] /
1.2.1.d: मूलतो ऽरत्निमात्रदण्डाः पाणितलमात्रपुष्करास् त्वचोबिला द्व्यङ्गुलखाताश् चतुरङ्गुलोच्छ्रयाः / प्रादेशमात्राणि प्रस्रवणानि / [ सर्वा अरत्निमात्रा वा ] /
1.2.1.m: Their handles from the base are a cubit in measure, their bowls the size of the palm of the hand, their cavities along the bark, excavated two finger-breadths deep and four finger-breadths high; their spouts are a span in length; [or they are all a cubit in measure].

1.2.1.s: sphyo bhṛṣṭilo / varaṇasya śamyā //
1.2.1.d: स्फ्यो भृष्टिलो / वरणस्य शम्या //
1.2.1.m: The wooden sword has notched edges. The yoke-pin is of varaṇa wood.

1.2.1.s: vepāya vām iti pāṇī prakṣālya camasenāpaḥ praṇayati / kām̐syena brahmavarcasakāmasya godohanena paśukāmasya mārttikena puṣṭikāmasya pratiṣṭhākāmasya vā //
1.2.1.d: वेपाय वाम् इति पाणी प्रक्षाल्य चमसेनापः प्रणयति / काम्̐स्येन ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य गोदोहनेन पशुकामस्य मार्त्तिकेन पुष्टिकामस्य प्रतिष्ठाकामस्य वा //
1.2.1.m: Having washed his hands with: 'For trembling [I wash] you both,' he brings forward the waters with the drinking cup; with a bronze vessel for one desiring spiritual brilliance, with a milking pail for one desiring cattle, with an earthen vessel for one desiring nourishment or for one desiring stability.

1.2.1.s: vānaspatyo 'si \\ iti camasam ādatte bārhaspatyam asi \\ iti kām̐syaṃ pārthivam asi \\ iti mārttikaṃca //
1.2.1.d: वानस्पत्यो ऽसि \\ इति चमसम् आदत्ते बार्हस्पत्यम् असि \\ इति काम्̐स्यं पार्थिवम् असि \\ इति मार्त्तिकंच //
1.2.1.m: With: 'You are made of wood,' he takes the drinking cup; with: 'You belong to Bṛhaspati,' the bronze vessel; with: 'You are made of earth,' the earthen vessel.

1.2.1.s: devebhyaḥ śundhasva \\ iti camasaṃ prakṣālayati devebhyaḥ śumbhasva \\ iti kām̐syaṃ mārttikaṃ ca /
1.2.1.d: देवेभ्यः शुन्धस्व \\ इति चमसं प्रक्षालयति देवेभ्यः शुम्भस्व \\ इति काम्̐स्यं मार्त्तिकं च /
1.2.1.m: With: 'Be cleansed for the gods,' he rinses the drinking cup; with: 'Be adorned for the gods,' the bronze and the earthen vessels.

1.2.1.s:
uttarato gārhapatyasya pavitravati
yad vo revatī revatyam \\ yad vo haviṣyā haviṣyam /
yad va ojo yac ca nṛmṇam \\ tam̐ va ūrmi madhumantam
devayajyāyai juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi \\ ity upabilaṃ camasaṃ pūrayati //
1.2.1.d:
उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य पवित्रवति
यद् वो रेवती रेवत्यम् \\ यद् वो हविष्या हविष्यम् /
यद् व ओजो यच् च नृम्णम् \\ तम्̐ व ऊर्मि मधुमन्तम्
देवयज्यायै जुष्टं गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् उपबिलं चमसं पूरयति //
1.2.1.m: To the north of the gārhapatya, [in a vessel] provided with a strainer, he fills the drinking cup up to the brim with: 'What is wealthy of you, O wealthy waters, what is fit for oblation of you, O oblation-worthy waters, what vigor of you, and what valor, that wave of yours, full of sweetness, acceptable for worship of the gods, I draw.'

1.2.1.s: devīr āpas \\ ity apo 'bhimantrayate //
1.2.1.d: देवीर् आपस् \\ इत्य् अपो ऽभिमन्त्रयते //
1.2.1.m: With: 'O divine waters,' he addresses the waters with the mantra.

1.2.1.s: brahmann apaḥ praṇeṣyāmi \ yajamāna vācam̐ yacha \\ ity uktvā vācam̐ yachati //
1.2.1.d: ब्रह्मन्न् अपः प्रणेष्यामि \ यजमान वाचम्̐ यछ \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा वाचम्̐ यछति //
1.2.1.m: Having said: 'O brahman priest, I shall bring forward the waters; O sacrificer, restrain your speech,' he restrains his speech.

1.2.1.s: ko vaḥ praṇayati sa vaḥ praṇayatu \ kasmai vaḥ praṇayati tasmai vaḥ praṇayatu \ bṛhaspatir vaḥ praṇayatu \\ iti manasā praṇayati /
1.2.1.d: को वः प्रणयति स वः प्रणयतु \ कस्मै वः प्रणयति तस्मै वः प्रणयतु \ बृहस्पतिर् वः प्रणयतु \\ इति मनसा प्रणयति /
1.2.1.m: With: 'Who brings you forward? May he bring you forward! For whom does he bring you forward? For him may he bring you forward! May Bṛhaspati bring you forward!' he mentally brings [them] forward.

1.2.1.s: sphyam upayāmaṃ kṛtvā samaṃ prāṇair dhārayamāṇaḥ ko vo yunakti sa vo yunaktu \ kasmai vo yunakti tasmai vo yunaktu \ bṛhaspatir vo yunaktu \\ iti yunakti //
1.2.1.d: स्फ्यम् उपयामं कृत्वा समं प्राणैर् धारयमाणः को वो युनक्ति स वो युनक्तु \ कस्मै वो युनक्ति तस्मै वो युनक्तु \ बृहस्पतिर् वो युनक्तु \\ इति युनक्ति //
1.2.1.m: Having made the wooden sword an under-support, holding [the cup] level with his vital breaths, he yokes [the waters] with: 'Who yokes you? May he yoke you! For whom does he yoke you? For him may he yoke you! May Bṛhaspati yoke you!'

1.2.1.s: viśvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo devayajyāyai prokṣitāḥ stha \\ ity uttarataḥ pūrvasya sādayati /
1.2.1.d: विश्वेभ्यः कामेभ्यो देवयज्यायै प्रोक्षिताः स्थ \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः पूर्वस्य सादयति /
1.2.1.m: With: 'For all desires, for the worship of the gods, you are sprinkled,' he sets it down to the north of the eastern [fire].

1.2.1.s: ulaparājyāvastṛṇāti //
1.2.1.d: उलपराज्यावस्तृणाति //

1.2.1.s: yajamāne prāṇāpānau dadhāmi \\ ity ādāya pavitre yathāyatanam̐ sphyapavitraṃ nidhāya sam̐sīdantāṃ daivīr viśas \\ iti pātrāṇi sam̐sādayati /
1.2.1.d: यजमाने प्राणापानौ दधामि \\ इत्य् आदाय पवित्रे यथायतनम्̐ स्फ्यपवित्रं निधाय सम्̐सीदन्तां दैवीर् विशस् \\ इति पात्राणि सम्̐सादयति /
1.2.1.m: With: 'I place expiration and inspiration in the sacrificer,' having taken the two strainers [and] having placed the wooden sword and strainer in their proper places, he arranges the vessels with: 'May the divine clans sit down together.'

1.2.1.s: saṃtatām ulaparājim aparasmād adhy ā pūrvasmād yajñasya saṃtatir asi \ yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai stṛṇāmi \\ iti stṛṇāti //
1.2.1.d: संतताम् उलपराजिम् अपरस्माद् अध्य् आ पूर्वस्माद् यज्ञस्य संततिर् असि \ यज्ञस्य त्वा संतत्यै स्तृणामि \\ इति स्तृणाति //
1.2.1.m: He strews a continuous line of reed-grass from the western [fire] to the eastern [fire] with: 'You are the continuity of the sacrifice; for the continuity of the sacrifice I strew you.'

1.2.1.s: vānaspatyāsi \\ iti srucam ādatte // varṣavṛddham asi \\ iti śūrpam //
1.2.1.d: वानस्पत्यासि \\ इति स्रुचम् आदत्ते // वर्षवृद्धम् असि \\ इति शूर्पम् //
1.2.1.m: With 'You are made of wood', he takes the ladling spoon; with 'You are grown by rain', the winnowing basket.

1.2.1.s: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ iti vrajati //
1.2.1.d: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इति व्रजति //
1.2.1.m: With 'Traverse the wide intermediate space', he walks.

1.2.1.s: pratyuṣṭam̐ rakṣaḥ ity āhavanīye niṣṭapati /
1.2.1.d: प्रत्युष्टम्̐ रक्षः इत्य् आहवनीये निष्टपति /
1.2.1.m: With 'Scorched is the demon', he heats [them] over the āhavanīya fire.

1.2.1.s: dakṣiṇataḥpaścād aparasyāgniṣṭhān nirvapati / pātryā vā sphyam upakṛṣyānomantrām̐s tu japet //
1.2.1.d: दक्षिणतःपश्चाद् अपरस्याग्निष्ठान् निर्वपति / पात्र्या वा स्फ्यम् उपकृष्यानोमन्त्राम्̐स् तु जपेत् //
1.2.1.m: To the south-west of the western [fire], he apportions from the cart; or having dragged the wooden sword near with the vessel, he should mutter the mantras for the cart.

1.2.1.s: dhūr asi \\ iti dhuram abhimṛśaty uttarāṃ ca /
1.2.1.d: धूर् असि \\ इति धुरम् अभिमृशत्य् उत्तरां च /
1.2.1.m: With 'You are the yoke-pin', he touches the yoke and the northern [yoke-pin].

1.2.1.s: udaṅṅ atikramya devānām asi \ vahnitamam ity uttarām īṣām ārabhya japati //
1.2.1.d: उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य देवानाम् असि \ वह्नितमम् इत्य् उत्तराम् ईषाम् आरभ्य जपति //
1.2.1.m: Stepping past toward the north, grasping the northern pole, he mutters: 'Of the gods are you, best bearer [of oblations]'.

1.2.1.s: viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇaṃ cakre pādam ādadhāti //
1.2.1.d: विष्णोः क्रमो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणं चक्रे पादम् आदधाति //
1.2.1.m: With 'You are the stride of Viṣṇu', he places his right foot on the wheel.

1.2.1.s: ahrutam asi havirdhānam ity ārohati //
1.2.1.d: अह्रुतम् असि हविर्धानम् इत्य् आरोहति //
1.2.1.m: With 'You are the unswerving receptacle of oblation', he climbs on.

1.2.1.s: uru vātāya \\ ity avasārayati //
1.2.1.d: उरु वाताय \\ इत्य् अवसारयति //
1.2.1.m: With 'Wide [space] for the wind', he pushes [the cover] aside.

1.2.1.s: mitrasya vaś cakṣuṣā prekṣe \\ iti haviṣyān prekṣate vrīhīn yavān vā /
1.2.1.d: मित्रस्य वश् चक्षुषा प्रेक्षे \\ इति हविष्यान् प्रेक्षते व्रीहीन् यवान् वा /
1.2.1.m: With 'I look at you with the eye of Mitra', he looks at the oblation materials—rice or barley.

1.2.1.s: śūrpe srucam ādhāya sruci pavitre [ nidhāya ] yajamāna havir nirvapsyāmi \\ ity uktvā havir nirvapati \\ agne \\ iti pravasataḥ //
1.2.1.d: शूर्पे स्रुचम् आधाय स्रुचि पवित्रे [ निधाय ] यजमान हविर् निर्वप्स्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा हविर् निर्वपति \\ अग्ने \\ इति प्रवसतः //
1.2.1.m: Having placed the ladling spoon in the winnowing basket, [and] having placed the two strainers in the ladling spoon, having said: 'O sacrificer, I shall apportion the oblation', he apportions the oblation; with 'O Agni', if he is away on a journey.

1.2.1.s: devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave \\ ity agnihotrahavaṇyāṃ haviṣyān muṣṭinā trir āvapati tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
1.2.1.d: देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इत्य् अग्निहोत्रहवण्यां हविष्यान् मुष्टिना त्रिर् आवपति तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /
1.2.1.m: With 'At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ...', he pours the oblation materials into the agnihotra-ladle three times with his fist, silently a fourth time.

1.2.1.s: evaṃ dvitīyam agnīṣomīyaṃ paurṇamāsyām aindrāgnam amāvāsyāyām asaṃnayataḥ /
1.2.1.d: एवं द्वितीयम् अग्नीषोमीयं पौर्णमास्याम् ऐन्द्राग्नम् अमावास्यायाम् असंनयतः /
1.2.1.m: In this way the second [oblation] for Agni-Soma on the full-moon day; for Indra-Agni on the new-moon day for one who does not offer the curd and milk offering.

1.2.1.s: saṃnayata indram̐ vā saṃnayata indraṃ mahendram ekeṣām indram̐ yajeta bubhūṣan /
1.2.1.d: संनयत इन्द्रम्̐ वा संनयत इन्द्रं महेन्द्रम् एकेषाम् इन्द्रम्̐ यजेत बुभूषन् /
1.2.1.m: For one offering the curd and milk offering, [it is] for Indra; or for one offering the curd and milk offering, for Indra [or] Mahendra; according to some, one desiring prosperity should sacrifice to Indra.

1.2.1.s: somayājināṃ mahendro devatā / somayājināṃ gataśrīr aurvo gautamo bhāradvājas te mahendram̐ yajeran /
1.2.1.d: सोमयाजिनां महेन्द्रो देवता / सोमयाजिनां गतश्रीर् और्वो गौतमो भारद्वाजस् ते महेन्द्रम्̐ यजेरन् /
1.2.1.m: For Soma-sacrificers, Mahendra is the deity; among Soma-sacrificers, a person of established fortune, a descendant of Urva, of Gautama, [or] of Bharadvāja—these should sacrifice to Mahendra.

1.2.1.s: athetare sam̐vatsaram indram iṣṭvāgnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirupya te mahendram̐ yajeran //
1.2.1.d: अथेतरे सम्̐वत्सरम् इन्द्रम् इष्ट्वाग्नये व्रतपतये ऽष्टाकपालं निरुप्य ते महेन्द्रम्̐ यजेरन् //
1.2.1.m: Then the others, having sacrificed to Indra for a year, having apportioned an eight-potsherd cake to Agni Vratapati, should sacrifice to Mahendra.

1.2.1.s: idaṃ devānām iti niruptān abhimṛśati \\ idam u naḥ saha \\ iti śeṣāny ato 'dhi nirvapati //
1.2.1.d: इदं देवानाम् इति निरुप्तान् अभिमृशति \\ इदम् उ नः सह \\ इति शेषान्य् अतो ऽधि निर्वपति //
1.2.1.m: With 'This belongs to the gods', he touches the apportioned [grains]; with 'And this is together for us', he apportions the remainder beyond this.

1.2.1.s: dṛhantāṃ duryās \\ ity avarohati //
1.2.1.d: दृहन्तां दुर्यास् \\ इत्य् अवरोहति //
1.2.1.m: With 'May the doors be firm', he climbs down.

1.2.1.s: svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām iti japati //
1.2.1.d: स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम् इति जपति //
1.2.1.m: He mutters: 'Svāhā to heaven and earth'.

1.2.1.s: nir varuṇasya pāśāt \\ iti niḥsarpati //
1.2.1.d: निर् वरुणस्य पाशात् \\ इति निःसर्पति //
1.2.1.m: With 'Out of Varuṇa's noose', he creeps out.

1.2.1.s: svar abhivyakśam ity abhivīkṣate 'gnim ādityam̐ vā //
1.2.1.d: स्वर् अभिव्यक्शम् इत्य् अभिवीक्षते ऽग्निम् आदित्यम्̐ वा //
1.2.1.m: With 'May I look upon the light', he looks toward the fire or the sun.

1.2.1.s: urv antarikṣam̐ vīhi \\ ity eti //
1.2.1.d: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम्̐ वीहि \\ इत्य् एति //
1.2.1.m: With 'Traverse the wide intermediate space', he goes.

1.2.1.s: adityā va upasthe sādayāmi \\ iti paścād aparasya sādayati /
1.2.1.d: अदित्या व उपस्थे सादयामि \\ इति पश्चाद् अपरस्य सादयति /
1.2.1.m: With 'I place you in the lap of Aditi', he places [the basket] west of the western [fire].

1.2.2.s: anirmṛṣṭāyām āsicya viṣṇor manasā pūte sthas \\ itiprabhṛtibhir vyākhyātam utpavanam /
1.2.2.d: अनिर्मृष्टायाम् आसिच्य विष्णोर् मनसा पूते स्थस् \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् व्याख्यातम् उत्पवनम् /
1.2.2.m: Having poured water into an unwiped vessel, the straining is explained with the formulas beginning with 'You two are purified by the mind of Viṣṇu'.

1.2.2.s: utpūya \\ agnaye vo juṣṭān prokṣāmi \\ iti yathādevatam̐ haviṣyān prokṣaty anabhiprokṣann aparam //
1.2.2.d: उत्पूय \\ अग्नये वो जुष्टान् प्रोक्षामि \\ इति यथादेवतम्̐ हविष्यान् प्रोक्षत्य् अनभिप्रोक्षन्न् अपरम् //
1.2.2.m: Having strained [the water], with 'For Agni I sprinkle you, acceptable', he sprinkles the oblation materials according to the deity, not sprinkling upon the western fire.

1.2.2.s: agne havyam̐ rakṣasva \\ ity agreṇāparam̐ haviṣyān upsādayati //
1.2.2.d: अग्ने हव्यम्̐ रक्षस्व \\ इत्य् अग्रेणापरम्̐ हविष्यान् उप्सादयति //
1.2.2.m: With 'O Agni, protect the oblation', he sets down the oblation materials in front of the western fire.

1.2.2.s: yad vo 'śuddhas \\ iti pātrāṇi prokṣati /
1.2.2.d: यद् वो ऽशुद्धस् \\ इति पात्राणि प्रोक्षति /
1.2.2.m: With 'Whatever of you is impure...', he sprinkles the vessels.

1.2.2.s: uttānāni paryāvṛtya prokṣya pūrvāṇi pratiparyāvṛtyāsaṃcare srucaṃ nidhāya \\ adityās tvag asi \\ iti kṛṣṇājinam ādatte grīvātaḥ //
1.2.2.d: उत्तानानि पर्यावृत्य प्रोक्ष्य पूर्वाणि प्रतिपर्यावृत्यासंचरे स्रुचं निधाय \\ अदित्यास् त्वग् असि \\ इति कृष्णाजिनम् आदत्ते ग्रीवातः //
1.2.2.m: Having turned them face upward and sprinkled them, having turned the previous ones back, having set down the ladling spoon in the space not walked upon, he takes the black antelope skin by the neck with 'You are the skin of Aditi'.

1.2.2.s: avadhūtam̐ rakṣas \\ ity udakśasanam utkare trir avadhūnoti //
1.2.2.d: अवधूतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् उदक्शसनम् उत्करे त्रिर् अवधूनोति //
1.2.2.m: With 'Shaken off is the demon', he shakes it out three times toward the north at the rubbish heap.

1.2.2.s: adityās tvag asi \\ iti paścād utkarasyāstṛṇāti pratyaggrīvam uttaralomam /
1.2.2.d: अदित्यास् त्वग् असि \\ इति पश्चाद् उत्करस्यास्तृणाति प्रत्यग्ग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमम् /
1.2.2.m: With 'You are the skin of Aditi', he spreads it west of the rubbish heap with its neck to the west and its hairy side turned up.

1.2.2.s: pratīcīṃ bhasadaṃ pratyasyati /
1.2.2.d: प्रतीचीं भसदं प्रत्यस्यति /
1.2.2.m: He turns the hind part westward.

1.2.2.s: na riktam avasṛjati //
1.2.2.d: न रिक्तम् अवसृजति //

1.2.2.s: pṛthugrāvāsi \\ ity ulūkhalam ādadhāti //
1.2.2.d: पृथुग्रावासि \\ इत्य् उलूखलम् आदधाति //
1.2.2.m: With 'You are a broad stone', he sets down the mortar.

1.2.2.s: agner jihvāsi \\ iti haviṣyān muṣṭinā trir āvapati tūṣṇīṃ caturtham //
1.2.2.d: अग्नेर् जिह्वासि \\ इति हविष्यान् मुष्टिना त्रिर् आवपति तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् //
1.2.2.m: With 'You are the tongue of Agni', he pours the oblation materials [into it] three times with his fist, silently a fourth time.

1.2.2.s: bṛhadgrāvāsi \\ iti musalam ādatte /
1.2.2.d: बृहद्ग्रावासि \\ इति मुसलम् आदत्ते /
1.2.2.m: With 'You are a large stone', he takes the pestle.

1.2.2.s: haviṣkṛtā trir avaghnann āhvayati /
1.2.2.d: हविष्कृता त्रिर् अवघ्नन्न् आह्वयति /
1.2.2.m: Beating three times with the oblation-preparer [pestle], he summons [the preparer of the oblation].

1.2.2.s: vācam̐ visṛjate yajamānaś ca //
1.2.2.d: वाचम्̐ विसृजते यजमानश् च //
1.2.2.m: He releases speech, and the sacrificer also.

1.2.2.s: haviṣkṛd ehi \\ iti brāhmaṇasya haviṣkṛd āgahi \\ iti rājanyasya haviṣkṛd ādrava \\ iti vaiśyasya /
1.2.2.d: हविष्कृद् एहि \\ इति ब्राह्मणस्य हविष्कृद् आगहि \\ इति राजन्यस्य हविष्कृद् आद्रव \\ इति वैश्यस्य /
1.2.2.m: 'Come, preparer of the oblation' for a brāhmaṇa; 'Arrive, preparer of the oblation' for a rājanya; 'Hasten, preparer of the oblation' for a vaiśya.

1.2.2.s: patny avahanti pinaṣṭi ca /
1.2.2.d: पत्न्य् अवहन्ति पिनष्टि च /
1.2.2.m: The wife pounds and grinds.

1.2.2.s: āgnīdhro dṛṣadupalam̐ samāhanti // kuṭarur asi \\ ity aśmānam ādatta // iṣam āvada \\ iti pūrvārdhe \\ ūrjam āvada \\ iti paścārdhe rāyaspoṣam āvada \\ ity upalām evaṃ navakṛtvaḥ saṃpātayati /
1.2.2.d: आग्नीध्रो दृषदुपलम्̐ समाहन्ति // कुटरुर् असि \\ इत्य् अश्मानम् आदत्त // इषम् आवद \\ इति पूर्वार्धे \\ ऊर्जम् आवद \\ इति पश्चार्धे रायस्पोषम् आवद \\ इत्य् उपलाम् एवं नवकृत्वः संपातयति /
1.2.2.m: The āgnīdhra priest strikes together the lower and upper mill-stones. With 'You are an axe', he takes the stone. With 'Sound out food', on the eastern half, with 'Sound out strength', on the western half, with 'Sound out abundance of wealth', he thus brings the upper mill-stone down nine times.

1.2.2.s: jātatuṣeṣu varṣavṛddham asi \\ iti purastātpratyak śūrpam upohati //
1.2.2.d: जाततुषेषु वर्षवृद्धम् असि \\ इति पुरस्तात्प्रत्यक् शूर्पम् उपोहति //
1.2.2.m: When the chaff has appeared, with 'You are grown by rain', he pushes the winnowing basket under from east to west.

1.2.2.s: prati tvā varṣavṛddham̐ vettu \\ ity udvapati //
1.2.2.d: प्रति त्वा वर्षवृद्धम्̐ वेत्तु \\ इत्य् उद्वपति //
1.2.2.m: With 'May the one grown by rain recognise you', he pours [the grains] out [into it].

1.2.2.s: parāpūtam̐ rakṣas \\ ity utkare niṣpunāti //
1.2.2.d: परापूतम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् उत्करे निष्पुनाति //
1.2.2.m: With 'Winnowed away is the demon', he winnows at the rubbish heap.

1.2.2.s: praviddho rakṣasāṃ bhāgas \\ iti tuṣān pravidhyate /
1.2.2.d: प्रविद्धो रक्षसां भागस् \\ इति तुषान् प्रविध्यते /
1.2.2.m: With 'Thrown away is the share of the demons', he throws away the chaff.

1.2.2.s: puroḍāśakapāle tuṣān opya \\ idam aham̐ rakṣo 'vabādhe \\ idam ahaṃ rakṣo 'dhamaṃ tamo nayāmi \\ ity adhastāt kṛṣṇājinasyopavapati //
1.2.2.d: पुरोडाशकपाले तुषान् ओप्य \\ इदम् अहम्̐ रक्षो ऽवबाधे \\ इदम् अहं रक्षो ऽधमं तमो नयामि \\ इत्य् अधस्तात् कृष्णाजिनस्योपवपति //
1.2.2.m: Having poured the chaff into a sacrificial cake potsherd, with 'Here do I beat down the demon, here do I lead the demon into the lowest darkness', he scatters it beneath the black antelope skin.

1.2.2.s: vāyur va iṣa ūrje vivinaktu \\ iti vivinakti //
1.2.2.d: वायुर् व इष ऊर्जे विविनक्तु \\ इति विविनक्ति //
1.2.2.m: With 'May Vāyu separate you for food, for strength', he separates [the grains].

1.2.2.s: devebhyaḥ śundhadhvam iti triḥ phalīkaroti /
1.2.2.d: देवेभ्यः शुन्धध्वम् इति त्रिः फलीकरोति /
1.2.2.m: With 'Cleanse yourselves for the gods', he husks them three times.

1.2.2.s: ādānātprabhṛti kṛṣṇājinasya samānam āstaraṇān na bhasadaṃ pratyasyati /
1.2.2.d: आदानात्प्रभृति कृष्णाजिनस्य समानम् आस्तरणान् न भसदं प्रत्यस्यति /
1.2.2.m: From the taking of the black antelope skin onward, [the procedure is] the same up to the spreading; he does not turn the hind part westward.

1.2.2.s: na riktam avasṛjati // dhiṣaṇāsi pārvatī \\ iti kṛṣṇājine dṛṣadam ādadhāti / [ na riktam avasṛjati ] // dhiṣaṇāsi pārvatī \ prati tvā pārvatī vettu \\ iti dṛṣady upalām [ ādadhāti ] //
1.2.2.d: न रिक्तम् अवसृजति // धिषणासि पार्वती \\ इति कृष्णाजिने दृषदम् आदधाति / [ न रिक्तम् अवसृजति ] // धिषणासि पार्वती \ प्रति त्वा पार्वती वेत्तु \\ इति दृषद्य् उपलाम् [ आदधाति ] //
1.2.2.m: He does not leave [the skin] empty. With 'You are Dhiṣaṇā, belonging to the mountains', he places the lower mill-stone on the black antelope skin; [he does not leave it empty]; with 'You are Dhiṣaṇā, belonging to the mountains; may she belonging to the mountains recognise you', [he places] the upper mill-stone on the lower mill-stone.

1.2.2.s: adityāḥ skambho 'si \\ ity udakśīrṣṇī śamyām̐ paścād upakarṣati //
1.2.2.d: अदित्याः स्कम्भो ऽसि \\ इत्य् उदक्शीर्ष्णी शम्याम्̐ पश्चाद् उपकर्षति //
1.2.2.m: With 'You are the support of Aditi', he draws the yoke-pin northward with its head to the north.

1.2.2.s: dhānyam asi dhinuhi devān iti trir adhivapati //
1.2.2.d: धान्यम् असि धिनुहि देवान् इति त्रिर् अधिवपति //
1.2.2.m: With 'You are grain; gladden the gods', he pours [grains] onto [the stone] three times.

1.2.2.s: prāṇāya tvā \\ iti prācīm upalāṃ prohati \\ apānāya tvā \\ iti pratīcīṃ pratikarṣati // vyānāya tvā \\ iti madhyadeśe vyavagṛhṇāti //
1.2.2.d: प्राणाय त्वा \\ इति प्राचीम् उपलां प्रोहति \\ अपानाय त्वा \\ इति प्रतीचीं प्रतिकर्षति // व्यानाय त्वा \\ इति मध्यदेशे व्यवगृह्णाति //
1.2.2.m: With 'For out-breath, you', he pushes the upper mill-stone eastward; with 'For in-breath, you', he pulls it back westward; with 'For diffused breath, you', he separates [them] in the middle.

1.2.2.s: dīrghām anu prasṛtim iti saṃtataṃ prāñcaṃ dīrghaṃ pinaṣṭi //
1.2.2.d: दीर्घाम् अनु प्रसृतिम् इति संततं प्राञ्चं दीर्घं पिनष्टि //
1.2.2.m: With 'Along a long expanse', he grinds continuously, eastward, long.

1.2.2.s: mitrasya vaś cakṣuṣāvekṣe \\ iti piṣṭāny avekṣate //
1.2.2.d: मित्रस्य वश् चक्षुषावेक्षे \\ इति पिष्टान्य् अवेक्षते //
1.2.2.m: With 'I look at you with the eye of Mitra', he looks at the flour.

1.2.2.s: devo vaḥ savitā hiraṇyapāṇir upagṛhṇātu \\ iti piṣṭāny avaśīryamāṇāny anumantrayate //
1.2.2.d: देवो वः सविता हिरण्यपाणिर् उपगृह्णातु \\ इति पिष्टान्य् अवशीर्यमाणान्य् अनुमन्त्रयते //
1.2.2.m: With 'May the divine Savitṛ of golden hands gather you up', he accompanies the flour being scattered with a mantra.

1.2.2.s: aṇūni kurutāt \\ iti preṣyati //
1.2.2.d: अणूनि कुरुतात् \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
1.2.2.m: 'Make [it] fine', he directs.

1.2.2.s: dhṛṣṭir asi \\ ity upaveṣam ādatte /
1.2.2.d: धृष्टिर् असि \\ इत्य् उपवेषम् आदत्ते /
1.2.2.m: With 'You are the bold one', he takes the fire-stirrer.

1.2.3.s: nirdagdham̐ rakṣas \\ ity aṅgāram avasthāpayati //
1.2.3.d: निर्दग्धम्̐ रक्षस् \\ इत्य् अङ्गारम् अवस्थापयति //
1.2.3.m: With 'Burnt out is the demon', he places a burning coal aside.

1.2.3.s: dhruvam asi \ pṛthivīṃ dṛm̐ha \\ iti tasmin kapālam upadhāyānvārabhya \\ apāgne 'gnim āmādaṃ jahi \\ ity aṅgāraṃ bahirbhasma nirasyati //
1.2.3.d: ध्रुवम् असि \ पृथिवीं दृम्̐ह \\ इति तस्मिन् कपालम् उपधायान्वारभ्य \\ अपाग्ने ऽग्निम् आमादं जहि \\ इत्य् अङ्गारं बहिर्भस्म निरस्यति //
1.2.3.m: With 'You are firm; make the earth firm', having placed the potsherd upon it and touched it, with 'O Agni, drive away the flesh-devouring fire', he throws the coal outside the ashes.

1.2.3.s: agne devayajanam̐ vaha \\ ity anyam adhikṛtyotsṛjati //
1.2.3.d: अग्ने देवयजनम्̐ वह \\ इत्य् अन्यम् अधिकृत्योत्सृजति //
1.2.3.m: With 'O Agni, bear the sacrifice to the gods', having placed another in charge, he lets go.

1.2.3.s: dharuṇam asi \\ antarikṣaṃ dṛm̐ha \\ iti pūrvaṃ \\ dhartram asi \ divam̐ dṛm̐ha \\ iti pūrvārdhaṃ dharmāsi \ viśvā viśvāni dṛm̐ha \\ iti madhyamād dakṣiṇaṃ cid asi \\ iti paścārdhād uttaramadhyardhaṃ paricid asi \\ iti pūrvārdhād dakṣiṇam \\ viśvāsu dikṣu sīda \\ iti paścārdhād dakṣiṇam \\ sajātān asmai yajamānāya pariveśaya \\ iti pūrvārdhād uttaramadhyardham /
1.2.3.d: धरुणम् असि \\ अन्तरिक्षं दृम्̐ह \\ इति पूर्वं \\ धर्त्रम् असि \ दिवम्̐ दृम्̐ह \\ इति पूर्वार्धं धर्मासि \ विश्वा विश्वानि दृम्̐ह \\ इति मध्यमाद् दक्षिणं चिद् असि \\ इति पश्चार्धाद् उत्तरमध्यर्धं परिचिद् असि \\ इति पूर्वार्धाद् दक्षिणम् \\ विश्वासु दिक्षु सीद \\ इति पश्चार्धाद् दक्षिणम् \\ सजातान् अस्मै यजमानाय परिवेशय \\ इति पूर्वार्धाद् उत्तरमध्यर्धम् /
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “You are a support, make firm the mid-space,” [he places a potsherd] to the east; with: “You are a holder, make firm the sky,” to the eastern half; with: “You are a maintainer, make firm all things,” to the south of the middle one; with: “You are a layer,” from the western half to the north-middle; with: “You are a surrounding layer,” from the eastern half to the south; with: “Sit in all quarters,” from the western half to the south; with: “Make [his] kinsmen serve this sacrificer,” from the eastern half to the north-middle.

1.2.3.s: evam ekādaśakapālasya samānaṃ trayāṇām upadhānam /
1.2.3.d: एवम् एकादशकपालस्य समानं त्रयाणाम् उपधानम् /
1.2.3.m: In this manner, the placement of the [first] three is identical for [a cake on] eleven potsherds.

1.2.3.s: ekamātre madhyamād dakṣiṇe tathottare /
1.2.3.d: एकमात्रे मध्यमाद् दक्षिणे तथोत्तरे /
1.2.3.m: Of the same measure, [there are two] to the south of the middle one, and likewise [two] to the north.

1.2.3.s: caturthena mantreṇa dakṣiṇayoḥ pūrvam upadadhāti pañcamenottarayor aparam̐ ṣaṣṭhena dakṣiṇayor aparam̐ saptamenottarayoḥ pūrvam uttamena śeṣāni kuṣṭāsu pradakṣiṇam //
1.2.3.d: चतुर्थेन मन्त्रेण दक्षिणयोः पूर्वम् उपदधाति पञ्चमेनोत्तरयोर् अपरम्̐ षष्ठेन दक्षिणयोर् अपरम्̐ सप्तमेनोत्तरयोः पूर्वम् उत्तमेन शेषानि कुष्टासु प्रदक्षिणम् //
1.2.3.m: With the fourth mantra he places the eastern of the two southern ones; with the fifth, the western of the two northern ones; with the sixth, the western of the two southern ones; with the seventh, the eastern of the two northern ones; with the last [mantra], the remaining ones in the corners clockwise.

1.2.3.s: vasūnām̐ rudrāṇām > ity aṅgārān abhyūhati // tapyethām iti dve tapyasva \\ ity ekam /
1.2.3.d: वसूनाम्̐ रुद्राणाम् > इत्य् अङ्गारान् अभ्यूहति // तप्येथाम् इति द्वे तप्यस्व \\ इत्य् एकम् /
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “[Of the] Vasus, [of the] Rudras,” he heaps coals over [them]; with: “May both of you be heated,” [over] two; with: “Be heated,” [over] one.

1.2.3.s: taptābhyo 'dhiśritya prātardohaṃ dohayati /
1.2.3.d: तप्ताभ्यो ऽधिश्रित्य प्रातर्दोहं दोहयति /
1.2.3.m: Having put [the milk-pot] on the fire for the heated [milk], he has the morning milking performed.

1.2.3.s: niṣṭapyopyamānāyāṃ pātryām avadhāya pavitre devasya vaḥ savituḥ prasave \\ iti piṣṭāni triḥ sam̐vapati tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
1.2.3.d: निष्टप्योप्यमानायां पात्र्याम् अवधाय पवित्रे देवस्य वः सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति पिष्टानि त्रिः सम्̐वपति तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /
1.2.3.m: Having placed the two strainers into the pan while it is being heated over the fire, with the mantra: “At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, of you,” he pours out the flour three times; silently the fourth time.

1.2.3.s: vācam̐ yachaty ābhivāsanāt //
1.2.3.d: वाचम्̐ यछत्य् आभिवासनात् //
1.2.3.m: He restrains his speech until the covering [of the cake with ash].

1.2.3.s: piṣṭalepaṃ nidhāyotpūya taptā haryoṣ ṭvā vārābhyām utpunāmi \\ iti piṣṭāny utpunāti /
1.2.3.d: पिष्टलेपं निधायोत्पूय तप्ता हर्योष् ट्वा वाराभ्याम् उत्पुनामि \\ इति पिष्टान्य् उत्पुनाति /
1.2.3.m: Having set aside the dough residue and purified [the water], with the mantra: “Heated, with the tail-hairs of the two bays I purify you,” he purifies the flour.

1.2.3.s: vedopayāmaḥ sruveṇa praṇītānām āharati // sam āpā oṣadhībhir ity āsiñcati taptāś ca //
1.2.3.d: वेदोपयामः स्रुवेण प्रणीतानाम् आहरति // सम् आपा ओषधीभिर् इत्य् आसिञ्चति तप्ताश् च //
1.2.3.m: Holding the broom as an under-support, he brings up [water] from the praṇītā-water with the dipping ladle; with the mantra: “The waters together with the plants,” he pours it in, and also the heated [water].

1.2.3.s: adbhyaḥ pari prajātāḥ stha \ sam adbhiḥ pṛcyadhvam iti taptāḥ parisārayati //
1.2.3.d: अद्भ्यः परि प्रजाताः स्थ \ सम् अद्भिः पृच्यध्वम् इति तप्ताः परिसारयति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “You are born from the waters; blend together with the waters,” he spreads out the heated [water around].

1.2.3.s: sīdantu viśas \\ iti piṣṭāni saṃnayati //
1.2.3.d: सीदन्तु विशस् \\ इति पिष्टानि संनयति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “May the subjects settle,” he kneads the flour.

1.2.3.s: makhasya śiro 'si \\ iti piṇḍam abhimṛśati //
1.2.3.d: मखस्य शिरो ऽसि \\ इति पिण्डम् अभिमृशति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “You are the head of Makha,” he touches the dough-ball.

1.2.3.s: pūṣā vām̐ viśvavedā vibhajatu \\ iti samau vibhajati //
1.2.3.d: पूषा वाम्̐ विश्ववेदा विभजतु \\ इति समौ विभजति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “May Pūṣan, who knows all, divide you two,” he divides it into two equal parts.

1.2.3.s: agnaye tvā \\ iti dakṣiṇaṃ puroḍāśam abhimṛśati yathādevatam uttaram //
1.2.3.d: अग्नये त्वा \\ इति दक्षिणं पुरोडाशम् अभिमृशति यथादेवतम् उत्तरम् //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “For Agni, you,” he touches the southern sacrificial cake; the northern one according to its deity.

1.2.3.s: idam aham̐ senāyā abhītvaryā mukhamapohāmi \\ iti vedena kapālebhyo bhasmāpohati //
1.2.3.d: इदम् अहम्̐ सेनाया अभीत्वर्या मुखमपोहामि \\ इति वेदेन कपालेभ्यो भस्मापोहति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “Here I brush away the face of the attacking army,” he sweeps away the ash from the potsherds with the broom.

1.2.3.s: gharmo 'si viśvāyur ity adhiśrayaty evam uttaram /
1.2.3.d: घर्मो ऽसि विश्वायुर् इत्य् अधिश्रयत्य् एवम् उत्तरम् /
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “You are the caldron, having all life,” he places [the cake] on the fire; likewise the northern one.

1.2.3.s: ekaikaṃ karmobhayoḥ kuryāt //
1.2.3.d: एकैकं कर्मोभयोः कुर्यात् //
1.2.3.m: He should perform each rite for both.

1.2.3.s: uru prathasva \\ iti yāvatkapālaṃ puroḍāśaṃ kūrmākṛtiṃ prathayati //
1.2.3.d: उरु प्रथस्व \\ इति यावत्कपालं पुरोडाशं कूर्माकृतिं प्रथयति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “Spread wide,” he spreads the sacrificial cake to the size of the potsherds, in the form of a tortoise.

1.2.3.s: saṃ te tanvā tanvaḥ pṛcyantām iti piṣṭalepenāvikṣārayam̐s triḥ primārṣṭi /
1.2.3.d: सं ते तन्वा तन्वः पृच्यन्ताम् इति पिष्टलेपेनाविक्षारयम्̐स् त्रिः प्रिमार्ष्टि /
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “May your bodies blend together with body,” he smooths it three times with the dough residue, not letting it drip off.

1.2.3.s: dakṣiṇāgnāv ājyam̐ vilāpya gārhapatya upādhiśritya saṃpūya vedopayāmas \\ aditir aśanāchinnapatrā \\ ity ājyasthālīm ādatte /
1.2.3.d: दक्षिणाग्नाव् आज्यम्̐ विलाप्य गार्हपत्य उपाधिश्रित्य संपूय वेदोपयामस् \\ अदितिर् अशनाछिन्नपत्रा \\ इत्य् आज्यस्थालीम् आदत्ते /
1.2.3.m: Having melted clarified butter on the southern fire, placed it near the gārhapatya fire, and purified it, holding the broom as an under-support, he takes the clarified butter pot with the mantra: “Aditi, whose wings are uncut by hunger.”

1.2.3.s: dakṣiṇā gārhapatyāt pavitravati pṛśnyāḥ payo 'sy agreguvas \ tasya te 'kṣīyamāṇasya pinvamānasya pinvamānaṃ nirvapāmi \\ ity ājyasthālyām̐ pavitravati nirvapati //
1.2.3.d: दक्षिणा गार्हपत्यात् पवित्रवति पृश्न्याः पयो ऽस्य् अग्रेगुवस् \ तस्य ते ऽक्षीयमाणस्य पिन्वमानस्य पिन्वमानं निर्वपामि \\ इत्य् आज्यस्थाल्याम्̐ पवित्रवति निर्वपति //
1.2.3.m: To the south of the gārhapatya fire, into [the vessel] containing a strainer, with the mantra: “You are the milk of Pṛśni, moving in front; of you, unfailing and swelling, I apportion the swelling [butter],” he apportions into the clarified butter pot containing a strainer.

1.2.3.s: pari vājapatir iti havīm̐ṣi triḥ paryagniṃ karoti //
1.2.3.d: परि वाजपतिर् इति हवीम्̐षि त्रिः पर्यग्निं करोति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “The lord of food [walks] round,” he carries fire around the oblations three times.

1.2.3.s: devas tvā savitā śrapayatu \\ ity ulmukenābhitāpayati piṣṭalepaṃ ca //
1.2.3.d: देवस् त्वा सविता श्रपयतु \\ इत्य् उल्मुकेनाभितापयति पिष्टलेपं च //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “May the divine Savitṛ bake you,” he heats [the cake] with a firebrand, and also the dough residue.

1.2.3.s: agniṣ ṭe tanvaṃ mā vinait \\ iti darbhais tvacaṃ grāhayati /
1.2.3.d: अग्निष् टे तन्वं मा विनैत् \\ इति दर्भैस् त्वचं ग्राहयति /
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “May Agni not injure your body,” he causes a crust to form with darbha grass.

1.2.3.s: na jvālān apohati //
1.2.3.d: न ज्वालान् अपोहति //

1.2.3.s: agne brahma gṛhṇīṣva \\ iti vedena sāṅgāraṃ bhasmanābhyūhati //
1.2.3.d: अग्ने ब्रह्म गृह्णीष्व \\ इति वेदेन साङ्गारं भस्मनाभ्यूहति //
1.2.3.m: With the mantra: “Agni, receive the sacred word,” he heaps [it] over with ash containing live coals, using the broom.

1.2.3.s: avidahantaḥ śrapayata \\ iti preṣyati /
1.2.3.d: अविदहन्तः श्रपयत \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.2.3.m: He summons: “Bake [it] without burning.”

1.2.3.s: vācam̐ viṣṛjate yajamānaś ca /
1.2.3.d: वाचम्̐ विषृजते यजमानश् च /
1.2.3.m: He releases his speech, and the sacrificer as well.

1.2.4.s: paścād āhavanīyasya yajamānamātrīm̐ vediṃ manasā parimimīte yathā havīm̐ṣi saṃbhaveyus tathā tiraścy aṇīyasīṃ purastāt /
1.2.4.d: पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्य यजमानमात्रीम्̐ वेदिं मनसा परिमिमीते यथा हवीम्̐षि संभवेयुस् तथा तिरश्च्य् अणीयसीं पुरस्तात् /
1.2.4.m: Behind the āhavanīya fire, he mentally measures out the altar as long as the sacrificer, in such a way that the oblations may fit, narrower in width in the eastern part.

1.2.4.s: pūrvārdhe vedyā vitṛtīyamātre prāgudīcīḥ sphyena tisro lekhā likhati //
1.2.4.d: पूर्वार्धे वेद्या वितृतीयमात्रे प्रागुदीचीः स्फ्येन तिस्रो लेखा लिखति //
1.2.4.m: In the eastern half of the altar, at the measure of one-third, he draws three lines towards the north-east with the wooden sword.

1.2.4.s: ekatāya svāhā \ dvitāya svāhā \ tritāya svāhā \\ ity etair asam̐syandayaṃl lekhāsu piṣṭalepaṃ ninayati /
1.2.4.d: एकताय स्वाहा \ द्विताय स्वाहा \ त्रिताय स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एतैर् असम्̐स्यन्दयंल् लेखासु पिष्टलेपं निनयति /
1.2.4.m: With these mantras: “To Ekata, svāhā! To Dvita, svāhā! To Trita, svāhā!” he pours out the dough residue into the lines, not letting it overflow.

1.2.4.s:
ayam̐ vedaḥ pṛthivīm anvavindat \ guhāhitāṃ nihitāṃ gahvareṣu /
sa mahyaṃ lokam̐ yajamānāya vindatu\ achidram̐ yajñaṃ bhūriretāḥ kṛṇotu //
iti vedam ādatte /
1.2.4.d:
अयम्̐ वेदः पृथिवीम् अन्वविन्दत् \ गुहाहितां निहितां गह्वरेषु /
स मह्यं लोकम्̐ यजमानाय विन्दतु\ अछिद्रम्̐ यज्ञं भूरिरेताः कृणोतु //
इति वेदम् आदत्ते /
1.2.4.m:
“This broom found the earth, / deposited in secret, hidden in caverns;

May it find a place for me, the sacrificer; / may it, rich in seed, make the sacrifice without flaw.”

1.2.4.s:
vedena vedim̐ vividuḥ pṛthivīm \ sā paprathe pṛthivī pārthivāya /
garbhaṃ bibharti bhuvaneṣv antas \ tato yajñas tāyate viśvadānīm //
iti vedena vediṃ prācīṃ triḥ samunmārṣṭi /
1.2.4.d:
वेदेन वेदिम्̐ विविदुः पृथिवीम् \ सा पप्रथे पृथिवी पार्थिवाय /
गर्भं बिभर्ति भुवनेष्व् अन्तस् \ ततो यज्ञस् तायते विश्वदानीम् //
इति वेदेन वेदिं प्राचीं त्रिः समुन्मार्ष्टि /

1.2.4.s: uttarato gārhapatyasya devasya tvā savituḥ prasave \\ iti sphyam ādatte //
1.2.4.d: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे \\ इति स्फ्यम् आदत्ते //
1.2.4.m: North of the gārhapatya fire, with the mantra: “At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, you,” he takes up the wooden sword.

1.2.4.s: indrasya bāhur asi \\ ity oṣadhyānumārṣṭi / nāgraṃ pratyabhimṛśati /
1.2.4.d: इन्द्रस्य बाहुर् असि \\ इत्य् ओषध्यानुमार्ष्टि / नाग्रं प्रत्यभिमृशति /
1.2.4.m: With the mantra: “You are Indra's arm,” he wipes it along with a plant; he does not touch its tip in return.

1.2.4.s: uttarato lekhānām āgnīdhraḥ prakramamātra utkare pāṇikoṣṭhaṃ kṛtvopaviśati //
1.2.4.d: उत्तरतो लेखानाम् आग्नीध्रः प्रक्रममात्र उत्करे पाणिकोष्ठं कृत्वोपविशति //
1.2.4.m: North of the lines, at the distance of one stride, the āgnīdhra priest sits down at the rubbish heap, making a hollow with his hands.

1.2.4.s: pṛthvyā varmāsi \\ iti lekhānte tṛṇaṃ tiryag nidadhāti //
1.2.4.d: पृथ्व्या वर्मासि \\ इति लेखान्ते तृणं तिर्यग् निदधाति //
1.2.4.m: With the mantra: “You are the armour of the earth,” he lays down a grass blade crosswise at the end of the line.

1.2.4.s: pṛthivi devayajani \\ iti sphyena tiryak chinatti //
1.2.4.d: पृथिवि देवयजनि \\ इति स्फ्येन तिर्यक् छिनत्ति //
1.2.4.m: With the mantra: “Earth, place of divine worship,” he cuts crosswise with the wooden sword.

1.2.4.s: vrajaṃ gacha gosthānam iti satṛṇān pām̐sūn apādatte //
1.2.4.d: व्रजं गछ गोस्थानम् इति सतृणान् पाम्̐सून् अपादत्ते //
1.2.4.m: With the mantra: “Go to the pen, the cow-stall,” he takes up the loose earth together with the grass.

1.2.4.s: varṣatu te parjanyas \\ iti vedim̐ yajamānaṃ ca prekṣate //
1.2.4.d: वर्षतु ते पर्जन्यस् \\ इति वेदिम्̐ यजमानं च प्रेक्षते //
1.2.4.m: With the mantra: “May Parjanya rain for you,” he looks at the altar and at the sacrificer.

1.2.4.s: vadhāna deva savitar iti pāṇikoṣṭhe nivapati //
1.2.4.d: वधान देव सवितर् इति पाणिकोष्ठे निवपति //
1.2.4.m: With the mantra: “Bind, divine Savitṛ,” he pours it into the [āgnīdhra's] hollowed hands.

1.2.4.s: mā vaḥ śivā oṣadhayas \\ iti dvitīyaṃ drapsas te \\ iti tṛtīyam̐ / samānam anyat tūṣṇīṃ caturtham /
1.2.4.d: मा वः शिवा ओषधयस् \\ इति द्वितीयं द्रप्सस् ते \\ इति तृतीयम्̐ / समानम् अन्यत् तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् /
1.2.4.m: With: “May the plants be propitious to you,” [he cuts] the second; with: “Your drop,” the third; the rest is the same; silently the fourth time.

1.2.4.s: sphyena vediṃ parigṛhṇāti vasavas tvā parigṛhṇantu \\ iti dakṣiṇatas \\ rudrās tvā \\ iti paścāt \\ ādityās tvā \\ ity uttarataḥ //
1.2.4.d: स्फ्येन वेदिं परिगृह्णाति वसवस् त्वा परिगृह्णन्तु \\ इति दक्षिणतस् \\ रुद्रास् त्वा \\ इति पश्चात् \\ आदित्यास् त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरतः //
1.2.4.m: With the wooden sword he outlines the altar: with the mantra: “May the Vasus enclose you,” on the south; with: “May the Rudras you,” on the west; with: “May the Ādityas you,” on the north.

1.2.4.s: apāraruṃ pṛthivyās \\ iti khanati dvyaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulam̐ vā /
1.2.4.d: अपाररुं पृथिव्यास् \\ इति खनति द्व्यङ्गुलं चतुरङ्गुलम्̐ वा /
1.2.4.m: With the mantra: “The non-injuring one of the earth,” he digs two finger-breadths or four finger-breadths deep.

1.2.4.s: uddhatād āgnīdhras trir harati /
1.2.4.d: उद्धताद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरति /
