1.4.1.m: The sacrificer has his hair and beard shaved, the hair beginning from the right.

1.4.1.s: savyopakramān nakhān adhyātmaṃ kaniṣṭhikātaḥ kārayate / na kakṣau /
1.4.1.d: सव्योपक्रमान् नखान् अध्यात्मं कनिष्ठिकातः कारयते / न कक्षौ /
1.4.1.m: He has his nails pared toward himself beginning from the left, from the little finger; not the armpits.

1.4.1.s: patnī nakhām̐ś ca kārayīta /
1.4.1.d: पत्नी नखाम्̐श् च कारयीत /
1.4.1.m: The wife should also have her nails pared.

1.4.1.s:
payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ \ payasvad vīrudhāṃ payaḥ /
apāṃ payaso yat payas \ tena mām indra sam̐sṛjasva //
iti pāṇī prakṣālyopavatsv aśanam aśnīto 'nyan māṣebhyo mām̐sāc ca sarpiṣmat /
1.4.1.d:
पयस्वतीर् ओषधयः \ पयस्वद् वीरुधां पयः /
अपां पयसो यत् पयस् \ तेन माम् इन्द्र सम्̐सृजस्व //
इति पाणी प्रक्षाल्योपवत्स्व् अशनम् अश्नीतो ऽन्यन् माषेभ्यो माम्̐साच् च सर्पिष्मत् /
1.4.1.m:
"Rich in sap are the plants, / rich in sap is the sap of the herbs.

What is the sap of the sap of waters, / with that, O Indra, unite me!"

Having washed their hands with this [mantra], the two fasting ones should eat food with clarified butter, other than māṣa beans and meat.

1.4.1.s: paurṇamāsyāṃ bhuktvāmāvāsyāyāṃ na suhitau syātām //
1.4.1.d: पौर्णमास्यां भुक्त्वामावास्यायां न सुहितौ स्याताम् //
1.4.1.m: Having eaten on the full-moon day, they should not be fully sated on the new-moon day.

1.4.1.s: mamāgne varcas \\ ity āhavanīye samidham ādadhāti purastāt pratyaṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭham̐s tūṣṇīm aparayoḥ /
1.4.1.d: ममाग्ने वर्चस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये समिधम् आदधाति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठम्̐स् तूष्णीम् अपरयोः /
1.4.1.m: With: "Mine, O Agni, is luster..." he places a kindling-stick on the āhavanīya in front, facing west, standing upright; silently on the two other [fires].

1.4.1.s: hastā avanijya dakṣiṇato vratam upaiti //
1.4.1.d: हस्ता अवनिज्य दक्षिणतो व्रतम् उपैति //
1.4.1.m: Having washed his hands, he enters upon the vow from the south.

1.4.1.s: agne vratapate vratam ālapsye \\ ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate // samrāḍ asi \ vratapā asi \ vratapatir asi \\ ity ādityam [ upatiṣṭhate ] / yady astamitaḥ syād āhavanīyam /
1.4.1.d: अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतम् आलप्स्ये \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते // सम्राड् असि \ व्रतपा असि \ व्रतपतिर् असि \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् [ उपतिष्ठते ] / यद्य् अस्तमितः स्याद् आहवनीयम् /
1.4.1.m: With: "O Agni, lord of vows, I shall take up the vow..." he attends the āhavanīya. With: "You are the sovereign; you are the guardian of the vow; you are the lord of vows," [he attends] the sun; if it has set, the āhavanīya.

1.4.1.s: vāse prāśnīyātām āraṇyasya / yasya ca śvo yakṣyamāṇaḥ syān na tasya sāyam aśnīyāt /
1.4.1.d: वासे प्राश्नीयाताम् आरण्यस्य / यस्य च श्वो यक्ष्यमाणः स्यान् न तस्य सायम् अश्नीयात् /
1.4.1.m: In the dwelling they both may eat [food] from the forest. And he on whose behalf the sacrifice is to be performed tomorrow should not eat in the evening.

1.4.1.s: vratacāryāhavanīyāgāre 'dhaḥ śayīta gārhapatyāgāre patnī //
1.4.1.d: व्रतचार्याहवनीयागारे ऽधः शयीत गार्हपत्यागारे पत्नी //
1.4.1.m: Observing the vow, he should sleep on the ground in the āhavanīya hut, the wife in the gārhapatya hut.

1.4.1.s: iyam̐ vaḥ pātram anayā vo gṛhṇāmi \\ iti praṇītāsu gṛhyamāṇāsv imāṃ manasā dhyāyet //
1.4.1.d: इयम्̐ वः पात्रम् अनया वो गृह्णामि \\ इति प्रणीतासु गृह्यमाणास्व् इमां मनसा ध्यायेत् //
1.4.1.m: With: "This is your vessel, with this I take you," while the praṇītā waters are being drawn, he should mentally meditate on this [earth].

1.4.1.s: agnim̐ hotāram upa tam̐ huve \\ iti nirvapasyamāne srucam̐ śūrpaṃ cābhimṛśet kriyamāṇe kriyamāṇe //
1.4.1.d: अग्निम्̐ होतारम् उप तम्̐ हुवे \\ इति निर्वपस्यमाने स्रुचम्̐ शूर्पं चाभिमृशेत् क्रियमाणे क्रियमाणे //
1.4.1.m: With: "I invoke Agni, that hotṛ..." while the apportionment is being made, he should touch the ladle and the winnowing basket as each [act] is performed.

1.4.1.s: yajñasya tvā pramayābhimayā \\ iti vedyāṃ parigṛhyamāṇāyāṃ japati //
1.4.1.d: यज्ञस्य त्वा प्रमयाभिमया \\ इति वेद्यां परिगृह्यमाणायां जपति //
1.4.1.m: With: "By the measure and counter-measure of the sacrifice..." he whispers while the sacrificial altar is being outlined.

1.4.1.s: pañcānāṃ tvā vātānāṃ dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi \\ ity ājyeṣu gṛhyamāṇesv āntād anuvākasya //
1.4.1.d: पञ्चानां त्वा वातानां धर्त्राय गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् आज्येषु गृह्यमाणेस्व् आन्ताद् अनुवाकस्य //
1.4.1.m: With: "I take you for the support of the five winds..." while the clarified butter is being taken, up to the end of the section.

1.4.1.s: yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena \\ iti paridhiṣu paridhīyamāneṣu /
1.4.1.d: युनज्मि त्वा ब्रह्मणा दैव्येन \\ इति परिधिषु परिधीयमानेषु /
1.4.1.m: With: "I harness you with divine holy power..." while the enclosing sticks are being laid round.

1.4.1.s: caturhotrā vihavyena ca havīm̐ṣy āsannāny abhimṛśet /
1.4.1.d: चतुर्होत्रा विहव्येन च हवीम्̐ष्य् आसन्नान्य् अभिमृशेत् /
1.4.1.m: He should touch the oblations that have been set down with the caturhotṛ formula and the vihavya hymn.

1.4.1.s: agreṇa sruco 'ntarvedi dakṣiṇaṃ jānvācyādhyañjalau vedam ādāya vedo 'si \ vedo mā ābhara \\ iti japati //
1.4.1.d: अग्रेण स्रुचो ऽन्तर्वेदि दक्षिणं जान्वाच्याध्यञ्जलौ वेदम् आदाय वेदो ऽसि \ वेदो मा आभर \\ इति जपति //
1.4.1.m: In front of the ladles inside the sacrificial altar, having bent his right knee and taken the veda into his cupped hands, he whispers: "You are the veda; bring me knowledge (or wealth)!"

1.4.1.s: tṛpto 'ham \\ tṛptas tvam iti pratigṛhṇāti /
1.4.1.d: तृप्तो ऽहम् \\ तृप्तस् त्वम् इति प्रतिगृह्णाति /
1.4.1.m: He receives it with: "I am satisfied, you are satisfied."

1.4.1.s: daśahotāraṃ japet purastāt sāmidhenīnām /
1.4.1.d: दशहोतारं जपेत् पुरस्तात् सामिधेनीनाम् /
1.4.1.m: He should whisper the daśahotṛ formula before the kindling verses.

1.4.1.s:
samiddho agnir āhutaḥ \ svāhākṛtaḥ pipartu naḥ /
iti samiddhe //
1.4.1.d:
समिद्धो अग्निर् आहुतः \ स्वाहाकृतः पिपर्तु नः /
इति समिद्धे //
1.4.1.m: "May Agni, kindled, offered unto, / and addressed with 'svāhā', carry us across!"

1.4.1.s: mano 'si prājāpatyam \\ manasā mā bhūtenāviśa \\ iti sruveṇāghāryamāṇe //
1.4.1.d: मनो ऽसि प्राजापत्यम् \\ मनसा मा भूतेनाविश \\ इति स्रुवेणाघार्यमाणे //
1.4.1.m: With: "You are the mind belonging to Prajāpati; enter me with mind, with reality," while the pouring with the sruva is being performed.

1.4.1.s: vāg asy aindrī sapatnakṣayaṇī \ vācā mendriyeṇāviśa \\ iti srauce //
1.4.1.d: वाग् अस्य् ऐन्द्री सपत्नक्षयणी \ वाचा मेन्द्रियेणाविश \\ इति स्रौचे //
1.4.1.m: With: "You are speech belonging to Indra, destroying rivals; enter me with speech, with faculty of sense," while the pouring with the sruc is being performed.

1.4.1.s: devāḥ pitaras \\ iti pravare pravaryamāṇe prāg itikaraṇāt /
1.4.1.d: देवाः पितरस् \\ इति प्रवरे प्रवर्यमाणे प्राग् इतिकरणात् /
1.4.1.m: With: "O gods, O fathers..." while the choice of the hotṛ is being made, before the word 'iti'.

1.4.1.s: caturhotāraṃ japet purastāt prayājānām /
1.4.1.d: चतुर्होतारं जपेत् पुरस्तात् प्रयाजानाम् /
1.4.1.m: He should whisper the caturhotṛ formula before the fore-offerings.

1.4.1.s: āśrāvite mahyaṃ devān iti brūyāt pratyāśrute mahyaṃ devam̐ yaja \\ ity ukte yathābhāgaṃ devatāḥ prati mātiṣṭhipan \\ iti / vaṣaṭkṛte svarge loke \\ iti /
1.4.1.d: आश्राविते मह्यं देवान् इति ब्रूयात् प्रत्याश्रुते मह्यं देवम्̐ यज \\ इत्य् उक्ते यथाभागं देवताः प्रति मातिष्ठिपन् \\ इति / वषट्कृते स्वर्गे लोके \\ इति /
1.4.1.m: When the call is uttered, he should say: "To me the gods!"; when the response is uttered: "Sacrifice to the god for me!"; when it is said: "According to their portions the deities have established me,"; when the vaṣaṭ is uttered: "in the heavenly world!"

1.4.1.s: prayājeṣu vasantam ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi \ sa mā prītaḥ prīṇātu \ vasantasyāhaṃ devayajyayā tejasvān payasvān bhūyāsaṃ // \ grīṣmam ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi \ sa mā prītaḥ prīṇātu \ grīṣmasyāhaṃ devayajyayaujasvān vīryavān bhūyāsam // \ varṣā ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi \ tā mā prītāḥ prīṇantu \ varṣāṇām ahaṃ devayajyayā puṣṭimān paśumān bhūyāsam // \ śaradam ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi \ sā mā prītā prīṇātu \ śarado 'haṃ devayajyayānnavān varcasvān bhūyāsam // \ hemantaśiśirāv ṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi \ tau mā prītau prīṇītām \\ hemantaśiśirayor ahaṃ devayajyayā sahasvām̐s tapasvān bhūyāsam ity ekaikena paryāyeṇa pṛthakpṛthak prayājān anumantrayate /
1.4.1.d: प्रयाजेषु वसन्तम् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि \ स मा प्रीतः प्रीणातु \ वसन्तस्याहं देवयज्यया तेजस्वान् पयस्वान् भूयासं // \ ग्रीष्मम् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि \ स मा प्रीतः प्रीणातु \ ग्रीष्मस्याहं देवयज्ययौजस्वान् वीर्यवान् भूयासम् // \ वर्षा ऋतूनां प्रीणामि \ ता मा प्रीताः प्रीणन्तु \ वर्षाणाम् अहं देवयज्यया पुष्टिमान् पशुमान् भूयासम् // \ शरदम् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि \ सा मा प्रीता प्रीणातु \ शरदो ऽहं देवयज्ययान्नवान् वर्चस्वान् भूयासम् // \ हेमन्तशिशिराव् ऋतूनां प्रीणामि \ तौ मा प्रीतौ प्रीणीताम् \\ हेमन्तशिशिरयोर् अहं देवयज्यया सहस्वाम्̐स् तपस्वान् भूयासम् इत्य् एकैकेन पर्यायेण पृथक्पृथक् प्रयाजान् अनुमन्त्रयते /
1.4.1.m: At the fore-offerings he accompanies each fore-offering individually with one turn: "I please Spring of the seasons; pleased, may it please me; through the sacrifice to the gods of Spring may I be endowed with splendor, endowed with vigor!" "I please Summer of the seasons; pleased, may it please me; through the sacrifice to the gods of Summer may I be endowed with power, endowed with virility!" "I please the Rains of the seasons; pleased, may they please me; through the sacrifice to the gods of the Rains may I be endowed with nourishment, endowed with cattle!" "I please Autumn of the seasons; pleased, may it please me; through the sacrifice to the gods of Autumn may I be endowed with food, endowed with luster!" "I please Winter and Dewy seasons of the seasons; pleased, may the two please me; through the sacrifice to the gods of Winter and Dewy seasons may I be victorious, endowed with ascetic heat!"

1.4.1.s: prayājānuyājavivṛddhau sarvān abhyasyed api vopottamamuttamam antataḥ /
1.4.1.d: प्रयाजानुयाजविवृद्धौ सर्वान् अभ्यस्येद् अपि वोपोत्तममुत्तमम् अन्ततः /
1.4.1.m: In case of an increase in the number of fore-offerings or after-offerings, he should repeat all of them, or the penultimate one, or the last one at the end.

1.4.2.s: agninā yajñaś cakṣuṣmān agner ahaṃ devayajyayā cakṣuṣā cakṣuṣmān bhūyāsam ity ājyabhāgam anumantrayate // somena yajñaś cakṣuṣmān somasyāhaṃ devayajyayā cakṣuṣā cakṣuṣmān bhūyāsam iti dvitīyam /
1.4.2.d: अग्निना यज्ञश् चक्षुष्मान् अग्नेर् अहं देवयज्यया चक्षुषा चक्षुष्मान् भूयासम् इत्य् आज्यभागम् अनुमन्त्रयते // सोमेन यज्ञश् चक्षुष्मान् सोमस्याहं देवयज्यया चक्षुषा चक्षुष्मान् भूयासम् इति द्वितीयम् /
1.4.2.m: With the formula, 'Through Agni the sacrifice is endowed with sight; through sacrifice to the god Agni may I be endowed with sight by sight,' he accompanies the [first] clarified butter portion with a mantra. With the formula, 'Through Soma the sacrifice is endowed with sight; through sacrifice to the god Soma may I be endowed with sight by sight,' [he accompanies] the second.

1.4.2.s: pañcahotāraṃ japet purastād dhaviṣām //
1.4.2.d: पञ्चहोतारं जपेत् पुरस्ताद् धविषाम् //
1.4.2.m: He should murmur the Pañcahotṛ formula before the oblations.

1.4.2.s: agnir annādo 'gner ahaṃ devayajyayānnādo bhūyāsam iti havirāhutim //
1.4.2.d: अग्निर् अन्नादो ऽग्नेर् अहं देवयज्ययान्नादो भूयासम् इति हविराहुतिम् //
1.4.2.m: [He accompanies] the offering of the oblation with the formula, 'Agni is the eater of food; through sacrifice to the god Agni may I become an eater of food.'

1.4.2.s: dabdhir nāmāsi \\ adabdho 'haṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ dabheyam ity upām̐śuyājau //
1.4.2.d: दब्धिर् नामासि \\ अदब्धो ऽहं भ्रातृव्यं दभेयम् इत्य् उपाम्̐शुयाजौ //
1.4.2.m: [He accompanies] the two whispered offerings with the formula, 'You are named Dabdhi; unharmed, may I harm my rival.'

1.4.2.s: agnīṣomau vṛtrahaṇāv agnīṣomayor ahaṃ devayajyayā vṛtrahā bhūyāsam ity agnīṣomīyam //
1.4.2.d: अग्नीषोमौ वृत्रहणाव् अग्नीषोमयोर् अहं देवयज्यया वृत्रहा भूयासम् इत्य् अग्नीषोमीयम् //
1.4.2.m: [He accompanies] the offering to Agni-Soma with the formula, 'Agni and Soma are slayers of Vṛtra; through sacrifice to the gods Agni and Soma may I become a slayer of Vṛtra.'

1.4.2.s: indrāgnyor ahaṃ devayajyayendriyavān vīryavān bhūyāsam \ indrasyāhaṃ devayajyayendriyavān bhūyāsam // \\ mahendrasyāhaṃ devayajyayā jemānaṃ mahimānaṃ gameyam \ indrasya vaimṛdhasyāhaṃ devayajyayāsapatno bhūyāsam // \\ savitur ahaṃ devayajyayā savitṛprasūto bhūyāsam // \\ sarasvatyā ahaṃ devayajyayā vācam annādyaṃ puṣeyam // \\ pūṣṇo 'haṃ devayajyayā puṣṭimān paśumān bhūyāsam \ agnīndrayor ahaṃ devayajyayā vīryavān indriyavān bhūyāsam // \\ viśveṣāṃ devānām ahaṃ devayajyayā prajātiṃ bhūmānaṃ gameyam // \\ dyāvāpṛthivyor ahaṃ devayajyayā prajaniṣīya prajayā paśubhir \ vanaspater ahaṃ devayajyayāsya yajñasyāgura udṛcam aśīya \\ asya yajñasyāgura udṛcam aśīya \\ ity anāmnāteṣu //
1.4.2.d: इन्द्राग्न्योर् अहं देवयज्ययेन्द्रियवान् वीर्यवान् भूयासम् \ इन्द्रस्याहं देवयज्ययेन्द्रियवान् भूयासम् // \\ महेन्द्रस्याहं देवयज्यया जेमानं महिमानं गमेयम् \ इन्द्रस्य वैमृधस्याहं देवयज्ययासपत्नो भूयासम् // \\ सवितुर् अहं देवयज्यया सवितृप्रसूतो भूयासम् // \\ सरस्वत्या अहं देवयज्यया वाचम् अन्नाद्यं पुषेयम् // \\ पूष्णो ऽहं देवयज्यया पुष्टिमान् पशुमान् भूयासम् \ अग्नीन्द्रयोर् अहं देवयज्यया वीर्यवान् इन्द्रियवान् भूयासम् // \\ विश्वेषां देवानाम् अहं देवयज्यया प्रजातिं भूमानं गमेयम् // \\ द्यावापृथिव्योर् अहं देवयज्यया प्रजनिषीय प्रजया पशुभिर् \ वनस्पतेर् अहं देवयज्ययास्य यज्ञस्यागुर उदृचम् अशीय \\ अस्य यज्ञस्यागुर उदृचम् अशीय \\ इत्य् अनाम्नातेषु //
1.4.2.m: In the case of [deities] not handed down in the text [he uses]: 'Through sacrifice to the gods Indra and Agni may I be endowed with power and vigor.' 'Through sacrifice to the god Indra may I be endowed with power.' 'Through sacrifice to the god Mahendra may I attain victory and greatness.' 'Through sacrifice to the god Indra Vaimṛdha may I be free from rivals.' 'Through sacrifice to the god Savitṛ may I be impelled by Savitṛ.' 'Through sacrifice to the goddess Sarasvatī may I nourish speech and the eating of food.' 'Through sacrifice to the god Pūṣan may I be thriving and rich in cattle.' 'Through sacrifice to the gods Agni and Indra may I be vigorous and endowed with power.' 'Through sacrifice to the All-gods may I attain procreation and abundance.' 'Through sacrifice to the gods Heaven and Earth may I be propagated with offspring and cattle.' 'Through sacrifice to the god Vanaspati may I attain the completion of the beginning of this sacrifice.' 'May I attain the completion of the beginning of this sacrifice.'

1.4.2.s: agniḥ sviṣṭakṛd yajñasya pratiṣṭhā tasyāhaṃ devayajyayā yajñena pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam ity agnim̐ sviṣṭakṛtam //
1.4.2.d: अग्निः स्विष्टकृद् यज्ञस्य प्रतिष्ठा तस्याहं देवयज्यया यज्ञेन प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् इत्य् अग्निम्̐ स्विष्टकृतम् //
1.4.2.m: [He accompanies] the offering to Agni Sviṣṭakṛt with the formula, 'Agni Sviṣṭakṛt is the foundation of the sacrifice; through sacrifice to him as a god, may I attain a foundation through the sacrifice.'

1.4.2.s: agnir mā duriṣṭāt pātu savitāghaśam̐sāt \\ yo no anti śapati tam etena jeṣam iti prāśitram avadīyamānam anumantrayate /
1.4.2.d: अग्निर् मा दुरिष्टात् पातु सविताघशम्̐सात् \\ यो नो अन्ति शपति तम् एतेन जेषम् इति प्राशित्रम् अवदीयमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
1.4.2.m: While the prāśitra portion is being cut off, he accompanies it with the formula: 'May Agni protect me from bad sacrifice, Savitṛ from evil speech; whoever curses us closely, may I conquer him with this.'

1.4.2.s: iḍāyās tūṣṇīm /
1.4.2.d: इडायास् तूष्णीम् /

1.4.2.s: upahave vasīyasy ehi \ śreyasy ehi \\ iti japati // cid asi \ manāsi \ dhīr asi \\ ity uccair ghṛtena mā samukṣata \\ ity antam asmāsv indra indriyaṃ dadhātu \\ iti ca //
1.4.2.d: उपहवे वसीयस्य् एहि \ श्रेयस्य् एहि \\ इति जपति // चिद् असि \ मनासि \ धीर् असि \\ इत्य् उच्चैर् घृतेन मा समुक्षत \\ इत्य् अन्तम् अस्मास्व् इन्द्र इन्द्रियं दधातु \\ इति च //
1.4.2.m: During the invocation [of the iḍā portion], he murmurs: 'Come, O wealthier one! Come, O better one!' Loudly [he recites]: 'You are thought; you are mind; you are meditation;' ending with 'Anoint me with clarified butter,' and 'May Indra place power in us.'

1.4.2.s: bradhna pāhi \\ iti catur antam abhimṛśati //
1.4.2.d: ब्रध्न पाहि \\ इति चतुर् अन्तम् अभिमृशति //
1.4.2.m: Ending with 'Protect, O ruddy one!' he touches it four times.

1.4.2.s: prajāpater bhāgo 'sy ūrjasvān payasvān \ prāṇāpānau me pāhi \ samānavyānau me pāhi \\ udānarūpe me pāhi \\ ūrg asi \\ ūrjaṃ mayi dhehi \\ akṣito 'sy akṣityai mā me kṣeṣṭhā amutrāmuṣmiṃlloka iha ca \ prajāpatir ahaṃ tvayā sākṣād ṛdhyāsam ity anvāhāryam āsannam anumantrayate / tad ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt //
1.4.2.d: प्रजापतेर् भागो ऽस्य् ऊर्जस्वान् पयस्वान् \ प्राणापानौ मे पाहि \ समानव्यानौ मे पाहि \\ उदानरूपे मे पाहि \\ ऊर्ग् असि \\ ऊर्जं मयि धेहि \\ अक्षितो ऽस्य् अक्षित्यै मा मे क्षेष्ठा अमुत्रामुष्मिंल्लोक इह च \ प्रजापतिर् अहं त्वया साक्षाद् ऋध्यासम् इत्य् अन्वाहार्यम् आसन्नम् अनुमन्त्रयते / तद् ऋत्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणां दद्यात् //
1.4.2.m: With the formula, 'You are Prajāpati's portion, vigorous, rich in milk; protect my out-breath and in-breath; protect my equal breath and circulating breath; protect my up-breath and physical form; you are vigor, bestow vigor in me; you are undecaying, for undecayingness do not decay for me in that world over there and here; may I, as Prajāpati, prosper directly through you,' he accompanies with a mantra the anvāhārya cooked rice when it has been set down. That he should give to the officiating priests as the sacrificial gift.

1.4.2.s: saṃ me bhadrāḥ saṃnatayaḥ saṃnamantām itīdhmasaṃnahane hute /
1.4.2.d: सं मे भद्राः संनतयः संनमन्ताम् इतीध्मसंनहने हुते /
1.4.2.m: When the tying cord of the sacrificial fuel has been offered, [he murmurs]: 'May auspicious submissions submit to me.'

1.4.2.s: saptahotāraṃ japet purastād anuyājānām //
1.4.2.d: सप्तहोतारं जपेत् पुरस्ताद् अनुयाजानाम् //
1.4.2.m: He should murmur the Saptahotṛ formula before the after-offerings.

1.4.2.s: barhiṣo 'haṃ devayajyayā prajāvān bhūyāsam \\ narāśam̐sasyāhaṃ devayajyayendriyavān bhūyāsam \ agniḥ sviṣṭakṛd yajñasya pratiṣṭhā tasyāhaṃ devayajyayā yajñena pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam ity uttamam //
1.4.2.d: बर्हिषो ऽहं देवयज्यया प्रजावान् भूयासम् \\ नराशम्̐सस्याहं देवयज्ययेन्द्रियवान् भूयासम् \ अग्निः स्विष्टकृद् यज्ञस्य प्रतिष्ठा तस्याहं देवयज्यया यज्ञेन प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् इत्य् उत्तमम् //
1.4.2.m: [He accompanies the first two after-offerings with]: 'Through sacrifice to the sacred grass as a god may I possess offspring;' 'Through sacrifice to the god Narāśaṃsa may I be endowed with power;' and the last with: 'Agni Sviṣṭakṛt is the foundation of the sacrifice; through sacrifice to him as a god may I attain a foundation through the sacrifice.'

1.4.2.s: agner ujjitim anūjjeṣam \\ somasyojjitimanūjjeṣam ity ājyabhāgaprabhṛty ā sviṣṭakṛto 'numantrayate 'nyad upām̐śuyājau sūktavāke //
1.4.2.d: अग्नेर् उज्जितिम् अनूज्जेषम् \\ सोमस्योज्जितिमनूज्जेषम् इत्य् आज्यभागप्रभृत्य् आ स्विष्टकृतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते ऽन्यद् उपाम्̐शुयाजौ सूक्तवाके //
1.4.2.m: Beginning with the clarified butter portions up to the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he accompanies [the deities] with a mantra during the sūktavāka recitation: 'May I conquer after Agni’s conquest;' 'May I conquer after Soma’s conquest'—the rest [as appropriate], and during the two whispered offerings.

1.4.2.s: sā me satyāśīr devān gamayāt \\ iti prastare prahriyamāṇe /
1.4.2.d: सा मे सत्याशीर् देवान् गमयात् \\ इति प्रस्तरे प्रह्रियमाणे /
1.4.2.m: While the sacred grass bundle is being thrown [into the fire], [he murmurs]: 'May that true blessing of mine reach the gods.'

1.4.2.s: tatra yam ichet tam̐ varam̐ vṛṇīte //
1.4.2.d: तत्र यम् इछेत् तम्̐ वरम्̐ वृणीते //
1.4.2.m: There he chooses whatever boon he desires.

1.4.2.s: viṣṇuḥ śam̐yur yajñasya pratiṣṭhā tasyāhaṃ devayajyayā yajñena pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam iti śam̐yorvāke //
1.4.2.d: विष्णुः शम्̐युर् यज्ञस्य प्रतिष्ठा तस्याहं देवयज्यया यज्ञेन प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् इति शम्̐योर्वाके //
1.4.2.m: During the recitation of the Śaṃyu formula [he recites]: 'Viṣṇu is Śaṃyu, the foundation of the sacrifice; through sacrifice to him as a god may I attain a foundation through the sacrifice.'

1.4.2.s: vi te muñcāmi raśanām̐ vi raśmīn iti paridhiṣu prahriyamāṇeṣu //
1.4.2.d: वि ते मुञ्चामि रशनाम्̐ वि रश्मीन् इति परिधिषु प्रह्रियमाणेषु //
1.4.2.m: While the enclosing sticks are being thrown [into the fire], [he recites]: 'I untie your cord, the reins.'

1.4.2.s: iṣṭo yajño bhṛgubhir iti sam̐srāvabhāgeṣu //
1.4.2.d: इष्टो यज्ञो भृगुभिर् इति सम्̐स्रावभागेषु //
1.4.2.m: At the offerings of the remnants [he recites]: 'The sacrifice has been offered by the Bhṛgus.'

1.4.2.s: ado māgachatu \\ ado māgamyāt \\ ity antato varān vṛṇīte //
1.4.2.d: अदो मागछतु \\ अदो मागम्यात् \\ इत्य् अन्ततो वरान् वृणीते //
1.4.2.m: At the end he chooses boons: 'May that come to me; may that reach me.'

1.4.3.s: somasyāhaṃ devayajyayā viśvam̐ reto dheṣīya \ tvaṣṭur ahaṃ devayajyayā sarvāṇi rūpāṇi paśūnāṃ puṣeyam \\ devānāṃ patnīnām ahaṃ devayajyayā prajaniṣīya prajayā paśubhis \\ rākāyā ahaṃ devayajyayā vīrān vindeyam \\ sinīvālyā ahaṃ devayajyayā paśūn vindeyam \\ kuhvā ahaṃ devayajyayā pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam \ agnir gṛhapatir yajñasya pratiṣṭhā tasyāhaṃ devayajyayā yajñena gṛhaiḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ gameyam ity agniṃ gṛhapatim /
1.4.3.d: सोमस्याहं देवयज्यया विश्वम्̐ रेतो धेषीय \ त्वष्टुर् अहं देवयज्यया सर्वाणि रूपाणि पशूनां पुषेयम् \\ देवानां पत्नीनाम् अहं देवयज्यया प्रजनिषीय प्रजया पशुभिस् \\ राकाया अहं देवयज्यया वीरान् विन्देयम् \\ सिनीवाल्या अहं देवयज्यया पशून् विन्देयम् \\ कुह्वा अहं देवयज्यया प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् \ अग्निर् गृहपतिर् यज्ञस्य प्रतिष्ठा तस्याहं देवयज्यया यज्ञेन गृहैः प्रतिष्ठां गमेयम् इत्य् अग्निं गृहपतिम् /
1.4.3.m: [At the patnīsaṃyāja offerings he murmurs]: 'Through sacrifice to the god Soma may I obtain all seed.' 'Through sacrifice to the god Tvaṣṭṛ may I nourish all forms of cattle.' 'Through sacrifice to the wives of the gods may I be propagated with offspring and cattle.' 'Through sacrifice to the goddess Rākā may I obtain heroes.' 'Through sacrifice to the goddess Sinīvālī may I obtain cattle.' 'Through sacrifice to the goddess Kuhū may I attain a foundation.' And to Agni Gṛhapati: 'Agni Gṛhapati is the foundation of the sacrifice; through sacrifice to him as a god may I attain a foundation with household through the sacrifice.'

1.4.3.s:
iḍāsmān anu vastāṃ ghṛtena \ yasyāḥ pade punate devayantaḥ /
vaiśvānarī śakvarī vāvṛdhānā\ upa yajñam astu no vaiśvadevī //
itīḍām //
1.4.3.d:
इडास्मान् अनु वस्तां घृतेन \ यस्याः पदे पुनते देवयन्तः /
वैश्वानरी शक्वरी वावृधाना\ उप यज्ञम् अस्तु नो वैश्वदेवी //
इतीडाम् //
1.4.3.m:
'May the iḍā clothe us with clarified butter, / in whose step those seeking the gods purify themselves;

Belonging to Vaiśvānara, mighty, strengthened, / belonging to the All-gods, may she be near our sacrifice.'

1.4.3.s: yā sarasvatī veśabhagīnā \\ iti mukham̐ vimṛṣṭe //
1.4.3.d: या सरस्वती वेशभगीना \\ इति मुखम्̐ विमृष्टे //
1.4.3.m: With the formula, 'The Sarasvatī who is auspicious for the household,' he wipes his face.

1.4.3.s: nirdviṣantaṃ nir arātiṃ daha \\ iti vedam̐ stīryamāṇam anumantrayate //
1.4.3.d: निर्द्विषन्तं निर् अरातिं दह \\ इति वेदम्̐ स्तीर्यमाणम् अनुमन्त्रयते //
1.4.3.m: With the formula, 'Burn out the enemy, burn out hostility,' he accompanies with a mantra the veda broom being spread.

1.4.3.s: sam̐ yajñapatir āśiṣā \\ iti yajamāno yajamānabhāgaṃ prāśnāti /
1.4.3.d: सम्̐ यज्ञपतिर् आशिषा \\ इति यजमानो यजमानभागं प्राश्नाति /
1.4.3.m: With the formula, 'May the lord of sacrifice [be united] with the blessing,' the sacrificer eats the sacrificer's portion.

1.4.3.s: yadi pravaset samiṣṭayajuṣā saha juhuyāt /
1.4.3.d: यदि प्रवसेत् समिष्टयजुषा सह जुहुयात् /
1.4.3.m: If he should go on a journey, he should offer it together with the samiṣṭayajus offering.

1.4.3.s: paścād veder upaviśya prāṅmukhaḥ sad asi \ san me bhūyās \\ iti praṇītāsv achinnam āsicyamānam anumantrayate //
1.4.3.d: पश्चाद् वेदेर् उपविश्य प्राङ्मुखः सद् असि \ सन् मे भूयास् \\ इति प्रणीतास्व् अछिन्नम् आसिच्यमानम् अनुमन्त्रयते //
1.4.3.m: Sitting down behind the altar facing east, he accompanies with a mantra [the water] being poured continuously into the praṇītā waters: 'You are the seat; may you be being for me.'

1.4.3.s: prācyā diśā devā ṛtvijo mārjayantām iti pratidiśam̐ yathāmnātam /
1.4.3.d: प्राच्या दिशा देवा ऋत्विजो मार्जयन्ताम् इति प्रतिदिशम्̐ यथाम्नातम् /
1.4.3.m: Direction by direction, as handed down in the sacred text: 'Through the eastern quarter may the divine officiating priests cleanse themselves.'

1.4.3.s:
samudram̐ vaḥ prahiṇomi \ svām̐ yonim abhigachata /
ariṣṭā asmākam̐ vīrās\ mā parāseci matpayaḥ /
iti ninītā anumantrayate /
1.4.3.d:
समुद्रम्̐ वः प्रहिणोमि \ स्वाम्̐ योनिम् अभिगछत /
अरिष्टा अस्माकम्̐ वीरास्\ मा परासेचि मत्पयः /
इति निनीता अनुमन्त्रयते /

1.4.3.s:
yad apsu te sarasvati \ goṣv aśveṣu yad vasu /
tena me vājinīvati \ mukham aṅgdhi sarasvati varcasā //
iti mukham̐ vimṛṣṭe /
1.4.3.d:
यद् अप्सु ते सरस्वति \ गोष्व् अश्वेषु यद् वसु /
तेन मे वाजिनीवति \ मुखम् अङ्ग्धि सरस्वति वर्चसा //
इति मुखम्̐ विमृष्टे /
1.4.3.m:
'O Sarasvatī, that wealth of yours which is in the waters, / which is in cattle, in horses,

With that, O bountiful Sarasvatī, / anoint my face with splendor.'

1.4.3.s: dakṣiṇāyā vedeḥ prācīnaṃ dakṣiṇena pādena viṣṇukramān krāmati // viṣṇuḥ pṛthivyām̐ vyakram̐sta \\ iti prathamam \\ viṣṇur antarikṣe vyakram̐sta \\ iti dvitīyam \\ viṣṇur divi vyakram̐sta \\ iti tṛtīyam uttaramuttaraṃ bhūyām̐sam //
1.4.3.d: दक्षिणाया वेदेः प्राचीनं दक्षिणेन पादेन विष्णुक्रमान् क्रामति // विष्णुः पृथिव्याम्̐ व्यक्रम्̐स्त \\ इति प्रथमम् \\ विष्णुर् अन्तरिक्षे व्यक्रम्̐स्त \\ इति द्वितीयम् \\ विष्णुर् दिवि व्यक्रम्̐स्त \\ इति तृतीयम् उत्तरमुत्तरं भूयाम्̐सम् //
1.4.3.m: To the east of the southern altar, he strides the Viṣṇu strides with his right foot: 'Viṣṇu strode across the earth,' is the first; 'Viṣṇu strode across the intermediate space,' is the second; 'Viṣṇu strode across heaven,' is the third, each successive one being greater.

1.4.3.s: idam aham amuṣya prāṇaṃ niveṣṭayāmi \\ iti pārṣṇyā pradakṣiṇam āveṣṭayati /
1.4.3.d: इदम् अहम् अमुष्य प्राणं निवेष्टयामि \\ इति पार्ष्ण्या प्रदक्षिणम् आवेष्टयति /
1.4.3.m: With the formula, 'Here I encompass the breath of that person,' he turns clockwise on his heel.

1.4.3.s: yaṃ dviṣyāt tasya nāma gṛhṇīyāt tūṣṇīm anabhicaran /
1.4.3.d: यं द्विष्यात् तस्य नाम गृह्णीयात् तूष्णीम् अनभिचरन् /
1.4.3.m: He should take the name of the one whom he hates, silently if he is not performing an incantation.

1.4.3.s: savyam anvāvṛtya tejo 'si \\ ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate \\ agne gṛhapate \\ iti gārhapatyam //
1.4.3.d: सव्यम् अन्वावृत्य तेजो ऽसि \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते \\ अग्ने गृहपते \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् //
1.4.3.m: Turning around to the left, he attends upon the āhavanīya fire with, 'You are splendor,' and upon the gārhapatya fire with, 'O Agni, lord of the house.'

1.4.3.s: asā anu mā tanu \\ iti putrasya nāma gṛhṇāti \\ amū anu mā tanutam iti yadi dvau // amī anu mā tanuta \\ iti yadi bahavaḥ /
1.4.3.d: असा अनु मा तनु \\ इति पुत्रस्य नाम गृह्णाति \\ अमू अनु मा तनुतम् इति यदि द्वौ // अमी अनु मा तनुत \\ इति यदि बहवः /
1.4.3.m: With the formula, 'Extend me after that one,' he mentions the name of his son; 'Extend me after those two,' if there are two; 'Extend me after those [sons],' if there are many.

1.4.3.s: atīmokṣair agnīn upatiṣṭhate // ye devāḥ yajñahanaḥ \ pṛthivyām adhyāsate \\ iti gārhapatyam \\ ye devā yajñahano \ antarikṣe adhyāsate \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim \\ ye devā yajñahanas \\ divy adhyāsate \\ ity āhavanīyam //
1.4.3.d: अतीमोक्षैर् अग्नीन् उपतिष्ठते // ये देवाः यज्ञहनः \ पृथिव्याम् अध्यासते \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् \\ ये देवा यज्ञहनो \ अन्तरिक्षे अध्यासते \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् \\ ये देवा यज्ञहनस् \\ दिव्य् अध्यासते \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् //
1.4.3.m: He reveres the fires with the atīmokṣa formulas: he reveres the gārhapatya with, “Which gods, slayers of sacrifice, reside upon the earth”; the southern fire with, “Which gods, slayers of sacrifice, reside in the intermediate space”; the āhavanīya with, “Which gods, slayers of sacrifice, reside in heaven.”

1.4.3.s: agne vratapate vratam acāriṣam \\ tat te prāvocam \\ tad aśakam \\ tenāśakam \\ tenārātsam \\ tan me 'jugupa iti samidho 'gniṣv ādadhad vratam̐ vimuñcati /
1.4.3.d: अग्ने व्रतपते व्रतम् अचारिषम् \\ तत् ते प्रावोचम् \\ तद् अशकम् \\ तेनाशकम् \\ तेनारात्सम् \\ तन् मे ऽजुगुप इति समिधो ऽग्निष्व् आदधद् व्रतम्̐ विमुञ्चति /
1.4.3.m: With, “O Agni, lord of vows, I have kept my vow; that I have declared to you; that I was able to do; by that I have succeeded; by that I have prospered; that you have guarded for me,” placing sacrificial sticks on the fires, he releases his vow.

1.4.3.s:
yajño babhūva sa u vābabhūva \ sa prajajñe sa u vāvṛdhe punaḥ /
sa devānām adhipatir babhūva \ so asmān adhipatīn karotu \ vayam̐ syāma patayo rayīṇām //
iti punarālambhaṃ japati //
1.4.3.d:
यज्ञो बभूव स उ वाबभूव \ स प्रजज्ञे स उ वावृधे पुनः /
स देवानाम् अधिपतिर् बभूव \ सो अस्मान् अधिपतीन् करोतु \ वयम्̐ स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् //
इति पुनरालम्भं जपति //
1.4.3.m:
“Sacrifice has come into being, it has indeed come into being; / it has been born, it has grown again.

It has become the lord of the gods; / let it make us lords; / may we be masters of wealth.”

With this he murmurs the punarālambha formula.

1.4.3.s: gomaṃ agne 'vimaṃ aśvī yajñas \\ iti prāṅ utkramya japati /
1.4.3.d: गोमं अग्ने ऽविमं अश्वी यज्ञस् \\ इति प्राङ् उत्क्रम्य जपति /
1.4.3.m: Stepping forward to the east, he murmurs: “Possessing cattle, O Agni, possessing sheep, possessing horses is the sacrifice…”

1.4.3.s: śam̐yvante prāśnāty ūrdhvam̐ vā samiṣṭayajuṣo yajamāno brāhmaṇaḥ sāṃnāyyasya sāṃnāyyasya /
1.4.3.d: शम्̐य्वन्ते प्राश्नात्य् ऊर्ध्वम्̐ वा समिष्टयजुषो यजमानो ब्राह्मणः सांनाय्यस्य सांनाय्यस्य /
1.4.3.m: At the end of the śaṃyu recitation or after the samiṣṭayajus formulas, the sacrificer, if a brāhmaṇa, eats of each curd and milk offering.

1.5.1.s: agnīn ādadhīta vasante brāhmaṇo grīṣme rājanyaḥ śaradi vaiśyaḥ / śiśiram̐ sarveṣām /
1.5.1.d: अग्नीन् आदधीत वसन्ते ब्राह्मणो ग्रीष्मे राजन्यः शरदि वैश्यः / शिशिरम्̐ सर्वेषाम् /
1.5.1.m: A brāhmaṇa should establish the fires in spring, a rājanya in summer, a vaiśya in autumn; winter is for all.

1.5.1.s: somena yakṣyamāṇasyartāv aniyamo nakṣatre ca /
1.5.1.d: सोमेन यक्ष्यमाणस्यर्ताव् अनियमो नक्षत्रे च /
1.5.1.m: For one who is going to sacrifice with Soma, there is no restriction regarding the season and the lunar mansion.

1.5.1.s: phālgunyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ purastād ekāhe dvyahe vādadhīta /
1.5.1.d: फाल्गुन्यां पौर्णमास्यां पुरस्ताद् एकाहे द्व्यहे वादधीत /
1.5.1.m: He should establish [the fires] on the full-moon day of Phālguna, or one day or two days before it.

1.5.1.s: jātaputro brāhmaṇaḥ kṛttikāsv ādadhīta /
1.5.1.d: जातपुत्रो ब्राह्मणः कृत्तिकास्व् आदधीत /
1.5.1.m: A brāhmaṇa who has begotten a son should establish [the fires] under the Kṛttikās.

1.5.1.s: rohiṇī phalgunyaś citrety āmnātāni /
1.5.1.d: रोहिणी फल्गुन्यश् चित्रेत्य् आम्नातानि /
1.5.1.m: Rohiṇī, the Phalgunīs, and Citrā are handed down in tradition.

1.5.1.s: mṛgaśirasy ādadhīta /
1.5.1.d: मृगशिरस्य् आदधीत /

1.5.1.s: punarvasvoḥ paścā pāpīyān viśākhayoḥ prajātikāmo / 'nurādhāsv ṛddhikāmaḥ / proṣṭhapadāsu pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ /
1.5.1.d: पुनर्वस्वोः पश्चा पापीयान् विशाखयोः प्रजातिकामो / ऽनुराधास्व् ऋद्धिकामः / प्रोष्ठपदासु प्रतिष्ठाकामः /
1.5.1.m: One who has become worse off [should establish them] under the Punarvasūs; one desiring progeny under the Viśākhās; one desiring prosperity under the Anurādhās; one desiring firm standing under the Proṣṭhapadās.

1.5.1.s: paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāyām̐ vādadhīta /
1.5.1.d: पौर्णमास्याम् अमावास्यायाम्̐ वादधीत /
1.5.1.m: He should establish [the fires] on a full-moon day or on a new-moon day.

1.5.1.s:
yo aśvatthaḥ śamīgarbhas\ āruroha tve sacā /
taṃ te harāmi brahmaṇā \ yajñiyaiḥ ketubhiḥ saha //
iti śamyārohasyāśvatthasyāraṇī āharati //
1.5.1.d:
यो अश्वत्थः शमीगर्भस्\ आरुरोह त्वे सचा /
तं ते हरामि ब्रह्मणा \ यज्ञियैः केतुभिः सह //
इति शम्यारोहस्याश्वत्थस्यारणी आहरति //
1.5.1.m:
“The aśvattha tree which, having the śamī in its womb, / mounted together upon you—

that I take for you with sacred formula, / together with the sacrificial banners.”

With this formula he fetches the two fire-drills of an aśvattha grown on a śamī tree.

1.5.1.s: āyur mayi dhehy āyur yajamānāya \\ iti japati /
1.5.1.d: आयुर् मयि धेह्य् आयुर् यजमानाय \\ इति जपति /
1.5.1.m: He murmurs: “Place life in me, life for the sacrificer.”

1.5.1.s: parivāpaṇam̐ yathā darśapaurṇamāsayoḥ /
1.5.1.d: परिवापणम्̐ यथा दर्शपौर्णमासयोः /
1.5.1.m: The shaving of hair is as in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

1.5.1.s: āplutyāhate kṣaume paridhāyopavatsv aśanam aśnītaḥ /
1.5.1.d: आप्लुत्याहते क्षौमे परिधायोपवत्स्व् अशनम् अश्नीतः /
1.5.1.m: Having bathed and put on new linen garments, the two [sacrificer and his wife] eat fasting-food on the eve of the vows.

1.5.1.s: prācīnapravaṇa udagvam̐śaśālāyāṃ prācīnaṃ madhyamād vam̐śād aparāhṇe lakṣaṇaṃ karoti /
1.5.1.d: प्राचीनप्रवण उदग्वम्̐शशालायां प्राचीनं मध्यमाद् वम्̐शाद् अपराह्णे लक्षणं करोति /
1.5.1.m: In a hall with its beams pointing north, which slopes to the east, he makes a mark east of the central beam in the afternoon.

1.5.1.s: uddhatyāvokṣya tasminn aupāsanīyaṃ brāhmaudanikam ādadhāti śālāgniṃ nirmanthyam̐ vā /
1.5.1.d: उद्धत्यावोक्ष्य तस्मिन्न् औपासनीयं ब्राह्मौदनिकम् आदधाति शालाग्निं निर्मन्थ्यम्̐ वा /
1.5.1.m: Having dug up and sprinkled [the ground], he places on it the aupāsana fire, the fire for the brahmaudana boiled-rice, the hall fire, or [a fire produced] by churning.

1.5.1.s: prāgabhihavād ṛtvijo vṛṇīte /
1.5.1.d: प्रागभिहवाद् ऋत्विजो वृणीते /
1.5.1.m: Before the primary libation he chooses the officiating priests.

1.5.1.s:
pra vedhase kavaye medhyāya \ vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe /
yato bhayam abhayaṃ tan no astu\ ava devānām̐ yaje heḍyāni / svāhā //
ity abhijuhoti /
1.5.1.d:
प्र वेधसे कवये मेध्याय \ वचो वन्दारु वृषभाय वृष्णे /
यतो भयम् अभयं तन् नो अस्तु\ अव देवानाम्̐ यजे हेड्यानि / स्वाहा //
इत्य् अभिजुहोति /
1.5.1.m:
“For the dispenser, the sage, worthy of sacrifice, / a praising word for the bull, the virile one.

Where fear [comes from], let there be fearlessness for us thence; / I appease the angers of the gods; svāhā!”

1.5.1.s: catuḥśarāvam̐ rohite carmaṇy ānaḍuhe prāggrīve lomato nirupya mām̐sato 'vahanti /
1.5.1.d: चतुःशरावम्̐ रोहिते चर्मण्य् आनडुहे प्राग्ग्रीवे लोमतो निरुप्य माम्̐सतो ऽवहन्ति /
1.5.1.m: Having poured out four śarāva measures [of grain] on a red bull's hide with its neck to the east, upon the hair side, he pounds it on the flesh side.

1.5.1.s: niśāyāṃ parīndhīta /
1.5.1.d: निशायां परीन्धीत /

1.5.1.s: brahmaudanaṃ jīvataṇḍulam̐ śrapayati /
1.5.1.d: ब्रह्मौदनं जीवतण्डुलम्̐ श्रपयति /
1.5.1.m: He cooks the brahmaudana boiled-rice using whole grains.

1.5.1.s: ghṛtenānutpūtena navanītena votpūtena śṛtam abhighāryottarata udvāsayati /
1.5.1.d: घृतेनानुत्पूतेन नवनीतेन वोत्पूतेन शृतम् अभिघार्योत्तरत उद्वासयति /
1.5.1.m: Having basted the cooked [mess] with unpurified clarified butter or with purified fresh butter, he takes it off the fire toward the north.

1.5.1.s: pātryām anyatra voddhṛtya vyuduhya prabhūtam̐ sarpir āsicyābhito brahmaudanam ṛtvija ārṣeyā vṛtāḥ paryupaviśanti dakṣiṇato brahmā paścād dhotottarata udgātā purastād adhvaryuḥ /
1.5.1.d: पात्र्याम् अन्यत्र वोद्धृत्य व्युदुह्य प्रभूतम्̐ सर्पिर् आसिच्याभितो ब्रह्मौदनम् ऋत्विज आर्षेया वृताः पर्युपविशन्ति दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा पश्चाद् धोतोत्तरत उद्गाता पुरस्ताद् अध्वर्युः /
1.5.1.m: Having taken it out into a vessel or elsewhere and swept it up, and having poured abundant clarified butter on it, the chosen officiating priests of ṛṣi descent sit around the brahmaudana: the brahman to the south, the hotṛ to the west, the udgātṛ to the north, and the adhvaryu to the east.

1.5.1.s:
piṇḍān ādāya sarpiṣi paryasyāvasṛpya prāśnanti /
tebhyo dhenuṃ dadāti /
1.5.1.d:
पिण्डान् आदाय सर्पिषि पर्यस्यावसृप्य प्राश्नन्ति /
तेभ्यो धेनुं ददाति /
1.5.1.m: Taking balls [of the boiled-rice] and rolling them in the clarified butter, having crept near, they eat [them]. / He gives them a milch-cow.

1.5.1.s: caityasyāśvatthasyārdrās tisraḥ samidhaḥ stibhigavatīḥ sahapalāśāḥ prādeśamātrīḥ sarpiṣmaty odane paryasya pra vo vājā abhidyavas \\ ity etābhis tisṛbhiḥ svāhākārāntābhir ādadhāti gāyatrībhir brāhmaṇasya \\ abodhy agnir iti triṣṭubbhī rājanyasya janasya gopās \\ iti jagatībhir vaiśyasya /
1.5.1.d: चैत्यस्याश्वत्थस्यार्द्रास् तिस्रः समिधः स्तिभिगवतीः सहपलाशाः प्रादेशमात्रीः सर्पिष्मत्य् ओदने पर्यस्य प्र वो वाजा अभिद्यवस् \\ इत्य् एताभिस् तिसृभिः स्वाहाकारान्ताभिर् आदधाति गायत्रीभिर् ब्राह्मणस्य \\ अबोध्य् अग्निर् इति त्रिष्टुब्भी राजन्यस्य जनस्य गोपास् \\ इति जगतीभिर् वैश्यस्य /
1.5.1.m: Rolling three moist firewood sticks of an aśvattha tree grown on a caitya, with leafy twigs and with foliage, a span in length, into the butter-rich boiled-rice, he places them [on the fire] with these three [verses] ending in the svāhā-call: with gāyatrī verses, “Forward your victuals, reaching to heaven…”, in the case of a brāhmaṇa; with triṣṭubh verses, “Agni has been awakened…”, in the case of a rājanya; with jagatī verses, “Protector of the people…”, in the case of a vaiśya.

1.5.1.s: ajuhvat sam̐vatsaram ajasram agnim indhīta dvādaśarātraṃ trirātram ekarātram̐ vā /
1.5.1.d: अजुह्वत् सम्̐वत्सरम् अजस्रम् अग्निम् इन्धीत द्वादशरात्रं त्रिरात्रम् एकरात्रम्̐ वा /
1.5.1.m: Without offering oblations, he should keep the fire burning continuously for a year, or twelve nights, or three nights, or one night.

1.5.1.s: nāsyāgniṃ gṛhād dhareyur nānyata āhareyuḥ /
1.5.1.d: नास्याग्निं गृहाद् धरेयुर् नान्यत आहरेयुः /
1.5.1.m: They should not take fire away from his house, nor bring [fire] from anywhere else.

1.5.1.s: na prayāyāt /
1.5.1.d: न प्रयायात् /

1.5.1.s: nānṛtam̐ vadet /
1.5.1.d: नानृतम्̐ वदेत् /

1.5.1.s: na mām̐sam aśnīyāt /
1.5.1.d: न माम्̐सम् अश्नीयात् /

1.5.1.s: na striyam upeyāt /
1.5.1.d: न स्त्रियम् उपेयात् /

1.5.1.s: śvo 'gnīn ādhāsyamāna upavaset pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm uttarām amāvāsyāṃ / nakṣatre ca /
1.5.1.d: श्वो ऽग्नीन् आधास्यमान उपवसेत् पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उत्तराम् अमावास्यां / नक्षत्रे च /
1.5.1.m: Intending to establish the fires on the following day, he should fast on the prior full-moon day or on the later new-moon day, and under the [prescribed] lunar mansion.

1.5.1.s: vratacāriṇa ṛtvijaḥ saha sam̐vasanti //
1.5.1.d: व्रतचारिण ऋत्विजः सह सम्̐वसन्ति //
1.5.1.m: Observing the vow, the officiating priests dwell together.

1.5.1.s: prajā agne sam̐vāsaya \\ ity uttarapūrvasyāṃ diśi vāse kalmāṣam ajaṃ badhnāti /
1.5.1.d: प्रजा अग्ने सम्̐वासय \\ इत्य् उत्तरपूर्वस्यां दिशि वासे कल्माषम् अजं बध्नाति /
1.5.1.m: With, “O Agni, make the offspring dwell together,” he ties a spotted he-goat in the dwelling in the north-eastern direction.

1.5.2.s:
śalkairagnimindhānas\ ubhau lokau sanomy aham /
ubhayor lokayor ṛdhnomi \ mṛtyuṃ tarāmy aham //
iti śalkair agnim indhate /
1.5.2.d:
शल्कैरग्निमिन्धानस्\ उभौ लोकौ सनोम्य् अहम् /
उभयोर् लोकयोर् ऋध्नोमि \ मृत्युं तराम्य् अहम् //
इति शल्कैर् अग्निम् इन्धते /
1.5.2.m:
“Kindling the fire with chips of wood, / I win both worlds.

In both worlds I prosper; / I cross over death.”

With this they kindle the fire with wood chips.

1.5.2.s: yajamānāyāraṇī prayachati /
1.5.2.d: यजमानायारणी प्रयछति /
1.5.2.m: He hands over the two fire-drills to the sacrificer.

1.5.2.s:
mahī viśpatnī sadane ṛtasya\ arvācī etaṃ dharuṇe rayīṇām /
antarvatī janyaṃ jātavedasam \ adhvarāṇāṃ janayataṃ purogām //
iti pratigṛhṇāti //
1.5.2.d:
मही विश्पत्नी सदने ऋतस्य\ अर्वाची एतं धरुणे रयीणाम् /
अन्तर्वती जन्यं जातवेदसम् \ अध्वराणां जनयतं पुरोगाम् //
इति प्रतिगृह्णाति //
1.5.2.m:
“The two great mistresses of the people, in the seat of truth, / come hither in the foundation of wealth.

Pregnant, generate the human Jātavedas, / the leader of the sacrifices!”

1.5.2.s: ṛtviyavatī stho 'gniretasau \ reto dhattaṃ puṣṭyai prajananaṃ // \ tat satyam̐ yad vīraṃ vibhṛtas \\ vīraṃ janayiṣyatas \ te mat prātaḥ prajanayiṣyete \ te mā prajāte prajanayiṣyataḥ \ prajayā paśubhir \ idam aham anṛtāt satyam upaimi \ mānuṣād daivam \\ daivīm̐ vācam̐ yachāmi \\ ity uktvā vācam̐ yachati /
1.5.2.d: ऋत्वियवती स्थो ऽग्निरेतसौ \ रेतो धत्तं पुष्ट्यै प्रजननं // \ तत् सत्यम्̐ यद् वीरं विभृतस् \\ वीरं जनयिष्यतस् \ ते मत् प्रातः प्रजनयिष्येते \ ते मा प्रजाते प्रजनयिष्यतः \ प्रजया पशुभिर् \ इदम् अहम् अनृतात् सत्यम् उपैमि \ मानुषाद् दैवम् \\ दैवीम्̐ वाचम्̐ यछामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा वाचम्̐ यछति /
1.5.2.m: “You two are fertile, having Agni's seed; / place seed for nourishment and procreation. / That is true that you two bear a hero, / you will give birth to a hero. / You two shall be born from me in the morning; / born, you shall generate me / with offspring and cattle. / Here I pass from untruth to truth, / from the human to the divine. / I restrain divine speech”—having said this, he restrains his speech.

1.5.2.s: dakṣiṇāgner araṇī patnī pāṇau kurute /
1.5.2.d: दक्षिणाग्नेर् अरणी पत्नी पाणौ कुरुते /
1.5.2.m: The wife takes into her hand the two fire-drills for the southern fire.

1.5.2.s: vāgyatāv araṇipāṇī jāgṛtaḥ /
1.5.2.d: वाग्यताव् अरणिपाणी जागृतः /
1.5.2.m: With speech restrained, holding the fire-drills in hand, the two keep awake.

1.5.2.s: upavyuṣaṃ brāhmaudanike araṇī niṣṭapati //
1.5.2.d: उपव्युषं ब्राह्मौदनिके अरणी निष्टपति //
1.5.2.m: Toward dawn, he heats the two fire-drills over the fire for the brahmaudana boiled-rice.

1.5.2.s: ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyas \\ ity araṇyoḥ samāropayati /
1.5.2.d: अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् अरण्योः समारोपयति /
1.5.2.m: With, “This is your seasonal womb,” he deposits [the fire] into the two fire-drills.

1.5.2.s: anugamayyoduhya bhasma gārhapatyāya lakṣaṇaṃ karoty uddhatyāvokṣya dakṣiṇataḥpurastād dakṣiṇāgner vitṛtīyamātre gārhapatyalakṣaṇasya nedīyasi samaṃ prati purastād āhavanīyāya /
1.5.2.d: अनुगमय्योदुह्य भस्म गार्हपत्याय लक्षणं करोत्य् उद्धत्यावोक्ष्य दक्षिणतःपुरस्ताद् दक्षिणाग्नेर् वितृतीयमात्रे गार्हपत्यलक्षणस्य नेदीयसि समं प्रति पुरस्ताद् आहवनीयाय /
1.5.2.m: Having caused [the fire] to go out and having swept aside the ashes, he makes the mark for the gārhapatya; having dug up and sprinkled [the ground], to the south-east [he makes the mark] for the southern fire at a distance of about one-third [of the distance between gārhapatya and āhavanīya], closer to the mark of the gārhapatya, and directly opposite [the gārhapatya] to the east for the āhavanīya.

1.5.2.s: lakṣaṇānupūrvān saṃbhārān nivapati /
1.5.2.d: लक्षणानुपूर्वान् संभारान् निवपति /
1.5.2.m: He scatters the materials in the order of the marks.

1.5.2.s:
ut samudrān madhumām̐ ūrmir āgāt \ sāmrājyāya prataraṃ dadhānaḥ /
amī ye maghavāno vayaṃ ca\ iṣam ūrjaṃ madhumat saṃbharema //
ity apo 'nupadāsukā upasṛjati //
1.5.2.d:
उत् समुद्रान् मधुमाम्̐ ऊर्मिर् आगात् \ साम्राज्याय प्रतरं दधानः /
अमी ये मघवानो वयं च\ इषम् ऊर्जं मधुमत् संभरेम //
इत्य् अपो ऽनुपदासुका उपसृजति //
1.5.2.m:
“From the ocean the honey-sweet wave has arisen, / bestowing further for sovereign rule.

May those bountiful patrons and we / gather together refreshment, vigor, sweet [drink]!”

With this he pours out water that does not fail.

1.5.2.s:
iyaty agra āsīt /
ato devī prathamānā pṛthag yat\ devair nyuptā mahitvā //
iti varāhavihataṃ ca nyupya tūṣṇīm̐ valmīkavapāṃ nivapati /
1.5.2.d:
इयत्य् अग्र आसीत् /
अतो देवी प्रथमाना पृथग् यत्\ देवैर् न्युप्ता महित्वा //
इति वराहविहतं च न्युप्य तूष्णीम्̐ वल्मीकवपां निवपति /
1.5.2.m:
"Hence the goddess, spreading abroad, going apart, / strewn down by the gods in greatness—"

With this [mantra], having poured down earth dug up by a boar, he silently pours down an anthill-core.

1.5.2.s:
yad ado divo yad idaṃ pṛthivyāḥ \ samānam̐ yonim abhisaṃbabhūva /
tasya pṛṣṭhe sīdatu jātavedāḥ \ śivaḥ prajābhya iha rayir no astu //
ity ūṣān nivapan \\ candramasi kṛṣṇaṃ tad iheraya \\ itīmāṃ manasā dhyāyet /
1.5.2.d:
यद् अदो दिवो यद् इदं पृथिव्याः \ समानम्̐ योनिम् अभिसंबभूव /
तस्य पृष्ठे सीदतु जातवेदाः \ शिवः प्रजाभ्य इह रयिर् नो अस्तु //
इत्य् ऊषान् निवपन् \\ चन्द्रमसि कृष्णं तद् इहेरय \\ इतीमां मनसा ध्यायेत् /
1.5.2.m:
"What of yonder sky, what of this earth, / came together into a common womb,

upon its back let Jātavedas sit; / kindly to offspring, may there be wealth for us here."

Pouring down saline soil with this [mantra], with "Send that black spot which is in the moon here," he should mentally meditate upon this [earth].

1.5.2.s:
candram agniṃ candraratham̐ harivṛtam\ vaiśvānaram apsuṣadam̐ svarvidam /
vigāhaṃ tūrṇiṃ taviṣībhir āvṛtam\ bhūrṇiṃ devāsa iha suśriyaṃ dadhuḥ //
iti sikatā vipeśalā nivapati /
1.5.2.d:
चन्द्रम् अग्निं चन्द्ररथम्̐ हरिवृतम्\ वैश्वानरम् अप्सुषदम्̐ स्वर्विदम् /
विगाहं तूर्णिं तविषीभिर् आवृतम्\ भूर्णिं देवास इह सुश्रियं दधुः //
इति सिकता विपेशला निवपति /
1.5.2.m:
"The delightful Agni of delightful chariot, surrounded by bay steeds, / Vaiśvānara, sitting in the waters, finding the sun,

plunging, swift, wrapped in powers, / active, the gods have set here endowed with good fortune."

With this [mantra], he pours down multi-coloured gravel.

1.5.2.s:
adṛm̐hathāḥ śarkarābhis tribhṛṣṭibhir \ ajayo lokān pradiśaś catasraḥ /
iti babhrūḥ śarkarā nivapati /
1.5.2.d:
अदृम्̐हथाः शर्कराभिस् त्रिभृष्टिभिर् \ अजयो लोकान् प्रदिशश् चतस्रः /
इति बभ्रूः शर्करा निवपति /
1.5.2.m:
"You stood firm with three-cornered pebbles; / you conquered the worlds, the four quarters."

With this [mantra], he pours down brown pebbles.

1.5.2.s: yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ manasā dhyāyet /
1.5.2.d: यं द्विष्यात् तं मनसा ध्यायेत् /
1.5.2.m: Whomever he might hate, upon him he should mentally meditate.

1.5.2.s:
udehy agne adhi mātuḥ pṛthivyās\ viśa āviśa mahataḥ sadhastāt /
āśuṃ tvājau dadhire devayantas\ havyavāhaṃ bhuvanasya gopām //
ity ākhukiriṃ nivapati /
1.5.2.d:
उदेह्य् अग्ने अधि मातुः पृथिव्यास्\ विश आविश महतः सधस्तात् /
आशुं त्वाजौ दधिरे देवयन्तस्\ हव्यवाहं भुवनस्य गोपाम् //
इत्य् आखुकिरिं निवपति /
1.5.2.m:
"Rise up, O Agni, from mother earth; / enter the clans from the great common abode.

Swift in battle, the god-fearing have established you, / the carrier of oblations, the protector of the world."

With this [mantra], he pours down the earth thrown up by a rat.

1.5.2.s: tūṣṇīṃ puṣkarapalāśam audumbaram̐ vikaṅkatam̐ śamīm aśvatthaṃ palāśam aśanihataṃ ca saptamam /
1.5.2.d: तूष्णीं पुष्करपलाशम् औदुम्बरम्̐ विकङ्कतम्̐ शमीम् अश्वत्थं पलाशम् अशनिहतं च सप्तमम् /
1.5.2.m: Silently [he places] a lotus-leaf, [wood of] udumbara, vikaṅkata, śamī, aśvattha, palāśa, and, as seventh, [wood of a tree] struck by lightning.

1.5.2.s:
sam̐ vaḥ sṛjāmi hṛdayāni vaḥ \ sam̐sṛṣṭaṃ mano astu vaḥ /
sam̐sṛṣṭaḥ prāṇo astu vaḥ \ sam̐sṛṣṭās tanvaḥ santu vaḥ //
iti saṃbhārān sam̐sṛjati //
1.5.2.d:
सम्̐ वः सृजामि हृदयानि वः \ सम्̐सृष्टं मनो अस्तु वः /
सम्̐सृष्टः प्राणो अस्तु वः \ सम्̐सृष्टास् तन्वः सन्तु वः //
इति संभारान् सम्̐सृजति //

1.5.2.s: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīt \\ iti gārhapatyalakṣaṇe saṃbhārān abhimṛśati \\ antaś carati \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnes trim̐śad dhāma \\ ity āhavanīyasya /
1.5.2.d: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीत् \\ इति गार्हपत्यलक्षणे संभारान् अभिमृशति \\ अन्तश् चरति \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नेस् त्रिम्̐शद् धाम \\ इत्य् आहवनीयस्य /
1.5.2.m: With "This speckled bull has stepped forward," he touches the materials at the marker of the gārhapatya; with "It moves within," those of the southern fire; with "Thirty abodes," those of the āhavanīya.

1.5.2.s: ājāneyam aśvaṃ purastāt pratyaṅmukham avasthāpayati /
1.5.2.d: आजानेयम् अश्वं पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुखम् अवस्थापयति /
1.5.2.m: He makes a thoroughbred horse stand in front, facing west.

1.5.3.s: gārhapatyalakṣaṇasya paścān muñjāvalopān anyad vā kṣiprāgniṃ nidhāya vṛṣaṇau sthas \\ iti tatra prāñcāv aprachinnaprāntau darbhau \\ urvaśy asi \\ iti tayor udaktūlām adharāraṇiṃ paścāt prajananāṃ mūlata uttarāraṇiṃ daśahotrāvadhāya caturhotṝn yajamānam̐ vācayati //
1.5.3.d: गार्हपत्यलक्षणस्य पश्चान् मुञ्जावलोपान् अन्यद् वा क्षिप्राग्निं निधाय वृषणौ स्थस् \\ इति तत्र प्राञ्चाव् अप्रछिन्नप्रान्तौ दर्भौ \\ उर्वश्य् असि \\ इति तयोर् उदक्तूलाम् अधरारणिं पश्चात् प्रजननां मूलत उत्तरारणिं दशहोत्रावधाय चतुर्होतॄन् यजमानम्̐ वाचयति //
1.5.3.m: Having placed tufts of muñja grass or another quickly catchable fire behind the marker of the gārhapatya, with "You two are virile bulls," [he places] there two eastward-pointing darbha blades with uncut tips; with "You are Urvaśī," [he places] upon them the lower kindling stick with its tip pointing north and the generation hole behind, [places] the upper kindling stick from its base, recites the daśahotṛ formula, and makes the sacrificer recite the caturhotṛ formulas.

1.5.3.s: agniṃ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor ity etasyām \\ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati /
1.5.3.d: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिर् अरण्योर् इत्य् एतस्याम् \\ साम गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.5.3.m: Upon [the verse], "Men with their reflections [kindle] Agni from the two kindling sticks," he urges, "Sing the sāman!"
When the two [sticks] are brought together, with "Hence was born," he churns.

1.5.3.s: tveṣas te dhūma ṛṇvati \\ iti dhūme jāte //
1.5.3.d: त्वेषस् ते धूम ऋण्वति \\ इति धूमे जाते //
1.5.3.m: With "Your vehement smoke rises," when smoke has arisen;
with "He has been seen, best finder of the way," when [the fire] is born.

1.5.3.s: prajāpateṣ ṭvā prāṇenābhiprāṇimi pūṣṇaḥ poṣāya mahyaṃ dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya \\ iti jātam abhiprāṇiti //
1.5.3.d: प्रजापतेष् ट्वा प्राणेनाभिप्राणिमि पूष्णः पोषाय मह्यं दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय \\ इति जातम् अभिप्राणिति //
1.5.3.m: With "With the breath of Prajāpati I breathe upon you for the nourishment of Pūṣan, for long life for me, lasting a hundred autumns," he breathes upon the born [fire].

1.5.3.s: yo no agniḥ pitaras \\ iti hṛdayadeśam ārabhya japati yajamānaś copodyamya triḥ pūrṇamukhenopadhamati /
1.5.3.d: यो नो अग्निः पितरस् \\ इति हृदयदेशम् आरभ्य जपति यजमानश् चोपोद्यम्य त्रिः पूर्णमुखेनोपधमति /
1.5.3.m: With "Whatever Agni of ours, O fathers," beginning by touching the region of the heart, he mutters, and the sacrificer, stepping up, blows upon [it] three times with a full mouth.

1.5.3.s:
yat pṛthivyā anāmṛtam\ saṃbabhūva tve sacā /
tad agnir agnaye dadat \ tasminn ādhīyatām ayam //
iti dakṣiṇata āsīno brahmā sauvarṇam̐ śakalam ādhāsyamāne saṃbhāreṣūpāsyet /
1.5.3.d:
यत् पृथिव्या अनामृतम्\ संबभूव त्वे सचा /
तद् अग्निर् अग्नये ददत् \ तस्मिन्न् आधीयताम् अयम् //
इति दक्षिणत आसीनो ब्रह्मा सौवर्णम्̐ शकलम् आधास्यमाने संभारेषूपास्येत् /
1.5.3.m:
"What immortal part of the earth / came into being along with you,

that let Agni, giving to Agni, / upon that let this [fire] be established."

With this [mantra], the brahman seated to the south should throw a chip of gold upon the materials where [the fire] is to be established.

1.5.3.d: प्रयछेद् यजमानो द्वेष्याय रजतम् अविद्यमाने ऽपविध्येत् //
1.5.3.m: The sacrificer should give a piece of silver to an enemy; if none is present, he should cast it away.

1.5.3.s: yad antarikṣasya \\ iti dakṣiṇāgner yad divas \\ ity āhavanīyasya //
1.5.3.d: यद् अन्तरिक्षस्य \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नेर् यद् दिवस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयस्य //
1.5.3.m: "What of the intermediate space," [is recited] for the southern fire; "What of heaven," for the āhavanīya.

1.5.3.s: dohyā ca te dugdhabhṛc ca \\ iti japati //
1.5.3.d: दोह्या च ते दुग्धभृच् च \\ इति जपति //
1.5.3.m: With "Both your milch cow and milk-bearer," he mutters.
He makes the sacrificer recite, "The cauldron is the head."

1.5.3.s: mayi gṛhṇāmi \\ iti hṛdayam̐ saṃkalpayato 'dhvaryur yajamānaś ca //
1.5.3.d: मयि गृह्णामि \\ इति हृदयम्̐ संकल्पयतो ऽध्वर्युर् यजमानश् च //
1.5.3.m: With "Into myself I take," the adhvaryu and the sacrificer focus in their hearts.

1.5.3.s: bhūr bhuvas \\ aṅgirasāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratenādadhe \\ ity āṅgirasasyādadhyāt \\ angeṣ ṭvā \\ ity anyeṣām indrasya tvā \\ iti rājanyasya manoṣ ṭvā \\ iti vaiśyasya \\ āchadi tvā \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
1.5.3.d: भूर् भुवस् \\ अङ्गिरसां त्वा देवानां व्रतेनादधे \\ इत्य् आङ्गिरसस्यादध्यात् \\ अन्गेष् ट्वा \\ इत्य् अन्येषाम् इन्द्रस्य त्वा \\ इति राजन्यस्य मनोष् ट्वा \\ इति वैश्यस्य \\ आछदि त्वा \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
1.5.3.m: With "Bhūr bhuvaḥ! By the vow of the divine Aṅgirases I establish you," he should establish [the fire] for a descendant of Aṅgiras; with "In the limbs I establish you," for others; with "Of Indra I [establish] you," for a kṣatriya; with "Of Manu I [establish] you," for a vaiśya; everywhere he annexes: "I cover you."
Sitting with folded legs, with "Bhūḥ!" he establishes the flaming [fire].
He follows [the act] while it is sung around with the Vāravantīya [sāman].

1.5.3.s: agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase \\ agnir ṛṣir \ agne pavasva \\ ity etābhir āśvatthīs tisraḥ samidha ādadhāti śamīmayīs tisra ekām audumbarīm /
1.5.3.d: अग्न आयूम्̐षि पवसे \\ अग्निर् ऋषिर् \ अग्ने पवस्व \\ इत्य् एताभिर् आश्वत्थीस् तिस्रः समिध आदधाति शमीमयीस् तिस्र एकाम् औदुम्बरीम् /
1.5.3.m: With these [verses], "O Agni, you purify our life-spans," "Agni the seer," and "O Agni, purify yourself," he places three fuel sticks of aśvattha, three made of śamī, and one of udumbara.

1.5.3.s: aktānām agnaye svāhā \\ ity ekaikām ādadhāti /
1.5.3.d: अक्तानाम् अग्नये स्वाहा \\ इत्य् एकैकाम् आदधाति /
1.5.3.m: With "To the Agni of the anointed ones, svāhā!" he places them one by one.
Having placed the fire-carrying utensils on the gārhapatya,

1.5.4.s: yā vājinn agner ity aśvam abhimantrayate //
1.5.4.d: या वाजिन्न् अग्नेर् इत्य् अश्वम् अभिमन्त्रयते //
1.5.4.m: with "Which, O courser, of Agni," he addresses the horse with a mantra.

1.5.4.s: yad akrandas \\ ity aśvasya dakṣiṇe karṇe yajamāno japati /
1.5.4.d: यद् अक्रन्दस् \\ इत्य् अश्वस्य दक्षिणे कर्णे यजमानो जपति /
1.5.4.m: With "When you neighed," the sacrificer mutters into the right ear of the horse.

1.5.4.s: saṃbhāraśeṣam upayamanīḥ kṛtvā \\ ojase balāya tvā \\ ity agnim udyachati /
1.5.4.d: संभारशेषम् उपयमनीः कृत्वा \\ ओजसे बलाय त्वा \\ इत्य् अग्निम् उद्यछति /
1.5.4.m: Having made the remainder of the materials the underlayer, with "For vigor, for strength, you!" he lifts up the fire.

1.5.4.s: āgnīdhrāya pradāyodaṅmukho dakṣiṇāgniṃ manthati / bhraṣṭrād gārhapatyād vā praṇayet //
1.5.4.d: आग्नीध्राय प्रदायोदङ्मुखो दक्षिणाग्निं मन्थति / भ्रष्ट्राद् गार्हपत्याद् वा प्रणयेत् //
1.5.4.m: Having handed it to the āgnīdhra, facing north, he churns the southern fire; or he should bring it forward from a roasting pan or from the gārhapatya.

1.5.4.s: bhuvas \\ ity ūrdhvajñur ādadhāti /
1.5.4.d: भुवस् \\ इत्य् ऊर्ध्वज्ञुर् आदधाति /
1.5.4.m: With "Bhuvaḥ!" raising his knee, he establishes [it].

1.5.4.s: vāmadevyena parigītam anusṛjati /
1.5.4.d: वामदेव्येन परिगीतम् अनुसृजति /
1.5.4.m: He follows [the act] while it is sung around with the Vāmadevya [sāman].

1.5.4.s: agnipraṇayanāny ādāya prācīm anu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvān ity aśvaprathamāḥ prāñco 'bhipravrajanti /
1.5.4.d: अग्निप्रणयनान्य् आदाय प्राचीम् अनु प्रदिशं प्रेहि विद्वान् इत्य् अश्वप्रथमाः प्राञ्चो ऽभिप्रव्रजन्ति /
1.5.4.m: Taking the fire-carrying utensils, with "Go forth along the eastern quarter, knowing," led by the horse, they proceed forward towards the east.

1.5.4.s: praṇīyamānasyottarato yajamāno vrajati /
1.5.4.d: प्रणीयमानस्योत्तरतो यजमानो व्रजति /
1.5.4.m: To the north of the [fire] being brought forward, the sacrificer walks.

1.5.4.s: dakṣiṇato brahmā ratham̐ vartayati rathacakram̐ vā //
1.5.4.d: दक्षिणतो ब्रह्मा रथम्̐ वर्तयति रथचक्रम्̐ वा //
1.5.4.m: To the south, the brahman rolls a chariot or a chariot-wheel.

1.5.4.s: nāko 'si bradhno 'si pratiṣṭhāsaṃkramaṇatamam iti samayārdhe hiraṇyaṃ nidhāyāvasthāpya yajamāno varaṃ dadāti /
1.5.4.d: नाको ऽसि ब्रध्नो ऽसि प्रतिष्ठासंक्रमणतमम् इति समयार्धे हिरण्यं निधायावस्थाप्य यजमानो वरं ददाति /
1.5.4.m: With "The firmament are you, the sun are you, the supreme crossing-place of foundation," having laid down a gold piece at the halfway point and having made [the horse] stop, the sacrificer gives a boon.

1.5.4.s: uttareṇa lakṣaṇaṃ parikramya \\ abhyasthām̐ viśvāḥ pṛtanās \\ iti dakṣiṇena pādena pārśvataḥ saṃbhārāṇām aśvam ākramayaty aparyāvartayan parikramayati /
1.5.4.d: उत्तरेण लक्षणं परिक्रम्य \\ अभ्यस्थाम्̐ विश्वाः पृतनास् \\ इति दक्षिणेन पादेन पार्श्वतः संभाराणाम् अश्वम् आक्रमयत्य् अपर्यावर्तयन् परिक्रमयति /
1.5.4.m: Having gone around north of the marker, with "I have overcome all hostile armies," he causes the horse to step with its right foot beside the materials; without turning it around, he leads it around.

1.5.4.s: pratyavanīyāśvaṃ pratilabhyāgnipraṇayanāni kulphadaghnam upaniyamya jānudaghnam udgṛhṇīyān nābhidaghnam am̐sadaghnam /
1.5.4.d: प्रत्यवनीयाश्वं प्रतिलभ्याग्निप्रणयनानि कुल्फदघ्नम् उपनियम्य जानुदघ्नम् उद्गृह्णीयान् नाभिदघ्नम् अम्̐सदघ्नम् /
1.5.4.m: Having led the horse back and taken back the fire-carrying utensils, having lowered [the fire] ankle-high, he should raise it knee-high, navel-high, shoulder-high.

1.5.4.s: karṇadaghnaṃ nātyudgṛhya bhuvaḥ svar > iti yathārṣam ādadhāti // yat te śukra śukraṃ jyotiḥ śukraṃ dhāmājasraṃ tena tvādadhe \\ iḍāyās tvā pade vayam iti ca /
1.5.4.d: कर्णदघ्नं नात्युद्गृह्य भुवः स्वर् > इति यथार्षम् आदधाति // यत् ते शुक्र शुक्रं ज्योतिः शुक्रं धामाजस्रं तेन त्वादधे \\ इडायास् त्वा पदे वयम् इति च /
1.5.4.m: Without raising it too far above ear-height, with "Bhuvaḥ! Svar!" he establishes [it] according to his ṛṣi lineage, and with "What bright, bright light of yours, what bright unceasing abode, therewith I establish you," and "In the footprint of Iḍā, we."

1.5.4.s: purastāt pratyaṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭhann udite pārśvataḥ padasya svar ity ādadhāti /
1.5.4.d: पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन्न् उदिते पार्श्वतः पदस्य स्वर् इत्य् आदधाति /
1.5.4.m: Standing upright in front facing west, when [the sun] has risen, [he establishes it] beside the footprint with "Svar!"

1.5.4.s: yajñāyajñīyena parigītam anusṛjati /
1.5.4.d: यज्ञायज्ञीयेन परिगीतम् अनुसृजति /
1.5.4.m: He follows [the act] while it is sung around with the Yajñāyajñīya [sāman].

1.5.4.s: sapatnavato bhrātṛvyavato vā rathacakram̐ vihāre triḥ parivartayet /
1.5.4.d: सपत्नवतो भ्रातृव्यवतो वा रथचक्रम्̐ विहारे त्रिः परिवर्तयेत् /
1.5.4.m: For one who has rivals or enemies, he should turn a chariot-wheel three times in the sacrificial enclosure.

1.5.4.s: yajamāno 'gnīn upatiṣṭhate samrāṭ ca svarāṭ ca \\ iti gārhapatyam \\ virāṭ ca prabhūś ca \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim \\ vibhūś ca paribhūś ca \\ ity āhavanīyam /
1.5.4.d: यजमानो ऽग्नीन् उपतिष्ठते सम्राट् च स्वराट् च \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् \\ विराट् च प्रभूश् च \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् \\ विभूश् च परिभूश् च \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् /
1.5.4.m: The sacrificer attends upon the fires: the gārhapatya with "Universal ruler and self-ruler;" the southern fire with "Sovereign and mighty;" the āhavanīya with "Pervading and encompassing."

1.5.4.s: agnīn parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya dakṣiṇāgnāv ājyam̐ vilāpya gārhapatya upādhiśritya saṃpūyaivaṃbhūtasyārthān kurvanti /
1.5.4.d: अग्नीन् परिसमुह्य पर्युक्ष्य परिस्तीर्य दक्षिणाग्नाव् आज्यम्̐ विलाप्य गार्हपत्य उपाधिश्रित्य संपूयैवंभूतस्यार्थान् कुर्वन्ति /
1.5.4.m: Having swept around, sprinkled around, and strewn around the fires, having melted clarified butter on the southern fire, having placed it near on the gārhapatya and purified it, they carry out the purposes of one in such a state.

1.5.4.s: śamīmayīs tisro 'ktāḥ samidhaḥ samudrād ūrmir ity etābhis tisṛbhiḥ svāhākārāntābhir ādadhāti // ye agnayaḥ samanasā ity anaktām audumbarīm //
1.5.4.d: शमीमयीस् तिस्रो ऽक्ताः समिधः समुद्राद् ऊर्मिर् इत्य् एताभिस् तिसृभिः स्वाहाकारान्ताभिर् आदधाति // ये अग्नयः समनसा इत्य् अनक्ताम् औदुम्बरीम् //
1.5.4.m: He places three anointed fuel sticks of śamī with these three [verses] ending in the svāhā-call: "From the ocean a wave..."; [he places] an unanointed [fuel stick] of udumbara with "Which fires of like mind..."

1.5.4.s: sapta te agne samidhas \\ iti pūrṇāhutim̐ // ye agnayo divo ye pṛthivyās \\ ity agniviparāṇayanīyāṃ juhoti //
1.5.4.d: सप्त ते अग्ने समिधस् \\ इति पूर्णाहुतिम्̐ // ये अग्नयो दिवो ये पृथिव्यास् \\ इत्य् अग्निविपराणयनीयां जुहोति //
1.5.4.m: [With the mantra,] 'Seven are your kindling sticks, O Agni...', he offers the full-spoon offering; with 'Which fires of heaven, which of earth...', he offers the offering for leading forth the fires.

1.5.4.s: adhvaryave 'śvaṃ dadāmi \\ iti vācam̐ visṛjate yajamāno varaṃ cāpākaroti /
1.5.4.d: अध्वर्यवे ऽश्वं ददामि \\ इति वाचम्̐ विसृजते यजमानो वरं चापाकरोति /
1.5.4.m: The sacrificer releases his speech [with the words], 'I give a horse to the adhvaryu,' and removes the chosen boon.

1.5.5.m: The procedure of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices applies to the [subsequent] animal and vegetable sacrifices.
One should silently indicate the deities according to the traditional text.
The rites connected with the establishment of the sacred fires have their ritual framework; they are to be performed immediately, and all their deities are addressed in a whisper.

1.5.5.s: nirupyāgneyam aṣṭākapālam upasādya prāk prokṣaṇād agner manve \\ ity ajamm̐ vimucyāgreṇāhavanīyam uddhatyāvokṣyāhavanīyāt sabhyam ādadhāti sabhyāt pūrvam āvasathyam /
1.5.5.d: निरुप्याग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् उपसाद्य प्राक् प्रोक्षणाद् अग्नेर् मन्वे \\ इत्य् अजम्म्̐ विमुच्याग्रेणाहवनीयम् उद्धत्यावोक्ष्याहवनीयात् सभ्यम् आदधाति सभ्यात् पूर्वम् आवसथ्यम् /
1.5.5.m: Having apportioned [the oblation] on eight potsherds for Agni, placed it [near the fire], and untied the goat with 'I think of Agni...' before the sprinkling, having raised the ground in front of the āhavanīya and sprinkled it, he establishes the sabhya fire from the āhavanīya, and the āvasathya fire to the east of the sabhya.
Having sprinkled to the north, he strews [grass] for the gaming ground, and to the east for the assembly hall.

1.5.5.s: adhidevane 'hatam̐ vāsa udagdaśam āstīrya tasmim̐ś catuḥśatam akṣān nivapati /
1.5.5.d: अधिदेवने ऽहतम्̐ वास उदग्दशम् आस्तीर्य तस्मिम्̐श् चतुःशतम् अक्षान् निवपति /
1.5.5.m: Having spread on the gaming ground an unwashed garment with fringes facing north, he pours out one hundred and four dice on it.
The noblemen sit around the dice-players.

1.5.5.s: madhye 'dhidevane samuhyākṣān hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya niṣasāda dhṛtavratas \\ ity abhijuhoti /
1.5.5.d: मध्ये ऽधिदेवने समुह्याक्षान् हिरण्यं निधाय निषसाद धृतव्रतस् \\ इत्य् अभिजुहोति /
1.5.5.m: Having gathered the dice in the middle on the gaming ground and placed gold [on them], he offers an oblation over them with 'He sat down, steadfast in his vows...'.

1.5.5.s: vyuhyākṣān rājanyasya \\ uta no 'hir budhnyas \\ iti sabhye juhoti /
1.5.5.d: व्युह्याक्षान् राजन्यस्य \\ उत नो ऽहिर् बुध्न्यस् \\ इति सभ्ये जुहोति /
1.5.5.m: Having pushed aside the dice of the nobleman, he offers into the sabhya fire with 'And to us Ahir Budhnya...'.

1.5.5.s: tasmai śatam akṣān prayachati / tān vicinuyāt /
1.5.5.d: तस्मै शतम् अक्षान् प्रयछति / तान् विचिनुयात् /
1.5.5.m: He hands him a hundred dice; he should pick them out.

1.5.5.s: tān kitavān vijitya yajamānas \\ gāṃ jeteti kuruta \\ iti preṣyati /
1.5.5.d: तान् कितवान् विजित्य यजमानस् \\ गां जेतेति कुरुत \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
1.5.5.m: Having won over those dice-players, the sacrificer sends the order: 'Win the cow! Go on!'

1.5.5.s: tasyāḥ parūm̐ṣi na him̐syur aṅgaśa iva visarjayeyuḥ /
1.5.5.d: तस्याः परूम्̐षि न हिम्̐स्युर् अङ्गश इव विसर्जयेयुः /
1.5.5.m: They should not break its joints, but should divide it as if limb by limb.
Having cooked it, he should serve it to the members of the assembly.

1.5.5.s: tayā yad gṛhṇīyāt tad ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇākāle dadyād ramaṇīyam atraiva mantrayeran //
1.5.5.d: तया यद् गृह्णीयात् तद् ऋत्विग्भ्यो दक्षिणाकाले दद्याद् रमणीयम् अत्रैव मन्त्रयेरन् //
1.5.5.m: What he obtains by means of it, that he should give to the officiating priests at the time of the sacrificial gift; right here they should consult on something pleasant.

1.5.5.s: enā rājan \\ ity āvasathye juhoti // pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatir ity āmantraṇe /
1.5.5.d: एना राजन् \\ इत्य् आवसथ्ये जुहोति // प्र नूनं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर् इत्य् आमन्त्रणे /
1.5.5.m: [With the mantra,] 'With this, O King...', he offers into the āvasathya fire; with 'Now truly Brahmaṇaspati...', into the assembly fire.

1.5.5.s: yajamāno 'gnīn upatiṣṭhate gharmaḥ śiras \\ iti gārhapatyaṃ paścāt prāṅmukhas \\ vātaḥ prāṇas \\ iti dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇāgnim udaṅmukho madhye 'vasthāya kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī \ ye agnayaḥ samanasā \\ ity agnīn /
1.5.5.d: यजमानो ऽग्नीन् उपतिष्ठते घर्मः शिरस् \\ इति गार्हपत्यं पश्चात् प्राङ्मुखस् \\ वातः प्राणस् \\ इति दक्षिणतो दक्षिणाग्निम् उदङ्मुखो मध्ये ऽवस्थाय कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी \ ये अग्नयः समनसा \\ इत्य् अग्नीन् /
1.5.5.m: The sacrificer reveres the fires: facing east behind the gārhapatya with 'The heat is the head...'; facing north to the south of the dakṣiṇāgni with 'The wind is the breath...'; standing in the middle, [he reveres all] the fires with 'May heaven and earth be fit...', 'Which fires are like-minded...'.
Starting with the sprinkling, the sacrifice is accomplished and brought to completion.

1.5.6.m: When it is completed, he should apportion a cake on eight potsherds for Agni Pavamāna.
A piece of gold weighing thirty units is the sacrificial gift.
When it is completed, [he apportions] two cakes on eight potsherds, one for Agni Pāvaka and one for Agni Śuci.
A piece of gold weighing seventy units is the sacrificial gift.

1.5.6.s: sam̐sthitāyām āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālam̐ / viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya tryuddhau ghṛte carum /
1.5.6.d: सम्̐स्थितायाम् आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालम्̐ / विष्णवे शिपिविष्टाय त्र्युद्धौ घृते चरुम् /
1.5.6.m: When it is completed, [he apportions a cake] on eleven potsherds for Agni and Viṣṇu, and a boiled oblation in clarified butter for Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa in three portions.

1.5.6.s: adityai ghṛte caruṃ paśukāmo / 'gnīṣomīyam ekādaśakapālaṃ brāhmaṇa / āvapanaśṛtāv amekṣaṇau /
1.5.6.d: अदित्यै घृते चरुं पशुकामो / ऽग्नीषोमीयम् एकादशकपालं ब्राह्मण / आवपनशृताव् अमेक्षणौ /
1.5.6.m: [He apportions] a boiled oblation in clarified butter for Aditi, if he is desirous of cattle; a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni and Soma if he is a brahmin; both [boiled oblations] are cooked by throwing in [grains] without using a stirring stick.
Along with the brahman's portion and the sacrificer's portion, he hands over the boiled oblation to Aditi to the brahman priest.

1.5.6.s: dakṣiṇākāle 'jam agnīdhe dadāty upabarhaṇaṃ ca sarvasūtram anaḍvāham adhvaryave dhenum̐ hotre / mithunau vatsatarau tayoḥ sāṇḍo dvihāyano ratham̐ yuktam̐ śatamānaṃ ceṣṭyapavarge 'dhvaryave vasane /
1.5.6.d: दक्षिणाकाले ऽजम् अग्नीधे ददात्य् उपबर्हणं च सर्वसूत्रम् अनड्वाहम् अध्वर्यवे धेनुम्̐ होत्रे / मिथुनौ वत्सतरौ तयोः साण्डो द्विहायनो रथम्̐ युक्तम्̐ शतमानं चेष्ट्यपवर्गे ऽध्वर्यवे वसने /
1.5.6.m: At the time of the sacrificial gift, he gives a goat to the āgnīdhra priest, a cushion and an ox with complete trappings to the adhvaryu priest, a milch-cow to the hotṛ priest, a pair of young calves of which the male is a two-year-old uncastrated bull, a yoked chariot, and a piece of gold weighing one hundred units; and at the completion of the sacrifice, two garments to the adhvaryu priest.

1.5.6.s: hute samiṣṭayajuṣy ādityaṃ caruṃ catvāra ṛtvijaḥ prāśnanti / tebhyo muṣkaram̐ vatsataraṃ dadāti /
1.5.6.d: हुते समिष्टयजुष्य् आदित्यं चरुं चत्वार ऋत्विजः प्राश्नन्ति / तेभ्यो मुष्करम्̐ वत्सतरं ददाति /
1.5.6.m: When the samiṣṭayajus formula has been offered, the four officiating priests consume the boiled oblation to Aditi; he gives them an uncastrated young bull.

1.5.6.s: somenāyakṣyamāṇo 'gnīn ādhāya catuḥśarāvaṃ jīvataṇḍulam odanam ṛtvijo bhojayet /
1.5.6.d: सोमेनायक्ष्यमाणो ऽग्नीन् आधाय चतुःशरावं जीवतण्डुलम् ओदनम् ऋत्विजो भोजयेत् /
1.5.6.m: If he does not intend to perform a Soma sacrifice, he should, having established the fires, feed the officiating priests with boiled rice made of four śarāva measures of living husked rice.
He should offer clarified butter to the deities of the sacrifice.
At the end of a year he apportions the oblations.
No brahmin should dwell in his house without eating.
He should not eat what is baked in an oven.

1.5.6.s: yā antar nāvy āpaḥ syur na tāsām ācāmet /
1.5.6.d: या अन्तर् नाव्य् आपः स्युर् न तासाम् आचामेत् /
1.5.6.m: He should not sip water that is inside a boat.
He should not put wet wood on the fire.
He should not encamp in a natural saline wasteland.

1.5.6.s: āmantraṇaṃ nāhūto gached aparāhṇa āmantraṇam̐ vrajet /
1.5.6.d: आमन्त्रणं नाहूतो गछेद् अपराह्ण आमन्त्रणम्̐ व्रजेत् /
1.5.6.m: He should not go uninvited to an assembly; in the afternoon he may go to an assembly.

1.5.6.s: darśapaurṇamāsāv ārapsyamāna ārambhaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapaty āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālam agnaye bhagine 'ṣṭākapālam̐ sarasvatyai caruṃ sarasvate dvādaśakapālam /
1.5.6.d: दर्शपौर्णमासाव् आरप्स्यमान आरम्भणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपत्य् आग्नावैष्णवम् एकादशकपालम् अग्नये भगिने ऽष्टाकपालम्̐ सरस्वत्यै चरुं सरस्वते द्वादशकपालम् /
1.5.6.m: Intending to begin the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, he apportions the initiatory offering: a cake on eleven potsherds for Agni and Viṣṇu, a cake on eight potsherds for Agni the Share-holder, a boiled oblation for Sarasvatī, and a cake on twelve potsherds for Sarasvat.

1.5.6.s: prāk sviṣṭakṛto dvādaśagṛhītaṃ juhvām ādhāya \\ ākūtāya svāhā \ ākūtaye svāhā \\ itiprabhṛtibhir dvādaśabhir vyudgrāhaṃ jayāñ juhoti // prajāpatiḥ prāyachat \\ iti trayodaśīm̐ yadi kāmayeta mukhyo brahmavarcasī syād agne balada \\ iti caturdaśīm̐ yadi kāmayeta citram asyāṃ janatāyām̐ syām iti citram aha tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bhavati śabalaṃ tv asyātmañ jāyata iti /
1.5.6.d: प्राक् स्विष्टकृतो द्वादशगृहीतं जुह्वाम् आधाय \\ आकूताय स्वाहा \ आकूतये स्वाहा \\ इतिप्रभृतिभिर् द्वादशभिर् व्युद्ग्राहं जयाञ् जुहोति // प्रजापतिः प्रायछत् \\ इति त्रयोदशीम्̐ यदि कामयेत मुख्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसी स्याद् अग्ने बलद \\ इति चतुर्दशीम्̐ यदि कामयेत चित्रम् अस्यां जनतायाम्̐ स्याम् इति चित्रम् अह तस्यां जनतायां भवति शबलं त्व् अस्यात्मञ् जायत इति /
1.5.6.m: Before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, having taken twelve ladlings into the offering spoon, he offers the Jaya offerings one after another with the twelve formulas beginning with 'To intention, svāhā! To design, svāhā!'; with 'Prajāpati gave...', he offers the thirteenth, if he should desire, 'May I become pre-eminent and endowed with spiritual lustre'; with 'O Agni, giver of strength...', he offers the fourteenth, if he should desire, 'May I be distinguished among this people'—indeed he becomes distinguished among that people, but a skin-spot appears on his body.
With the stirring stick he cuts off portions from the boiled oblations for the Sviṣṭakṛt offering and for the iḍā portion.
A pair of cattle is the sacrificial gift.
At the recitation of the sūktavāka he throws the stirring stick [into the fire] after [the grass].

1.5.6.s: paurṇamāsyām ādhāya sopavasathām ārambhaṇīyāṃ kṛtvā sadyaskālayā paurṇamāsyā yajeta /
1.5.6.d: पौर्णमास्याम् आधाय सोपवसथाम् आरम्भणीयां कृत्वा सद्यस्कालया पौर्णमास्या यजेत /
1.5.6.m: Having established the fires on a full-moon day and having performed the initiatory offering together with the day of preparation, he should sacrifice with the full-moon sacrifice on the same day.

1.5.6.s: amāvāsyāyām ādhāya nakṣatre vā pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm upoṣyārambhaṇīyāṃ kurvītottarām upoṣya paurṇamāsyā yajeta yajeta /
1.5.6.d: अमावास्यायाम् आधाय नक्षत्रे वा पूर्वां पौर्णमासीम् उपोष्यारम्भणीयां कुर्वीतोत्तराम् उपोष्य पौर्णमास्या यजेत यजेत /
1.5.6.m: Having established the fires on a new-moon day or under a constellation, having observed the fast on the former full-moon day and performed the initiatory offering, he should observe the fast on the latter and sacrifice with the full-moon sacrifice.

1.6.1.s: uddharāhavanīyam ity uktvā gārhapatyād āhavanīyaṃ jvalantaṃ praṇayaty aparahṇe vyuchantyāṃ prātaḥ //
1.6.1.d: उद्धराहवनीयम् इत्य् उक्त्वा गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयं ज्वलन्तं प्रणयत्य् अपरह्णे व्युछन्त्यां प्रातः //
1.6.1.m: Having said, 'Take up the āhavanīya fire!', he brings forward the blazing āhavanīya fire from the gārhapatya in the afternoon, or in the morning at daybreak.

1.6.1.s: vācā tvā hotrā prāṇenodgātrā cakṣuṣādhvaryuṇā manasā brahmaṇā śrotreṇāgnīdhreṇaitais tvā pañcabhir devair ṛtvigbhir uddharāmi \\ ity uddharati /
1.6.1.d: वाचा त्वा होत्रा प्राणेनोद्गात्रा चक्षुषाध्वर्युणा मनसा ब्रह्मणा श्रोत्रेणाग्नीध्रेणैतैस् त्वा पञ्चभिर् देवैर् ऋत्विग्भिर् उद्धरामि \\ इत्य् उद्धरति /
1.6.1.m: [With the mantra,] 'With Speech as hotṛ, with Breath as udgātṛ, with Sight as adhvaryu, with Mind as brahman, with Hearing as āgnīdhra—with these five divine officiating priests I take you up,' he takes it up.

1.6.1.s:
uddhriyamāṇa uddhara pāpmano mām\ yad avidvān yac ca vidvām̐ś cakāra /
ahnā yad enaḥ kṛtam asti pāpam\ sarvasmād uddhṛto muñca tasmāt //
iti harati // rātryā yad enaḥ [ kṛtam asti pāpam ] iti prātaḥ /
1.6.1.d:
उद्ध्रियमाण उद्धर पाप्मनो माम्\ यद् अविद्वान् यच् च विद्वाम्̐श् चकार /
अह्ना यद् एनः कृतम् अस्ति पापम्\ सर्वस्माद् उद्धृतो मुञ्च तस्मात् //
इति हरति // रात्र्या यद् एनः [ कृतम् अस्ति पापम् ] इति प्रातः /

1.6.1.s:
amṛtāhutim amṛtāyāṃ juhomi\ agniṃ pṛthivyām amṛtasya jityai /
tvayāgne kāmam ahaṃ jayāmi \ prajāpatir yaṃ prathamo jigāya\ agnim agnau / svāhā //
iti sāyaṃ nidadhāti // sūryam agnau \\ iti prātaḥ /
1.6.1.d:
अमृताहुतिम् अमृतायां जुहोमि\ अग्निं पृथिव्याम् अमृतस्य जित्यै /
त्वयाग्ने कामम् अहं जयामि \ प्रजापतिर् यं प्रथमो जिगाय\ अग्निम् अग्नौ / स्वाहा //
इति सायं निदधाति // सूर्यम् अग्नौ \\ इति प्रातः /

1.6.1.s: naktaṃ vā gṛhṇīyāt /
1.6.1.d: नक्तं वा गृह्णीयात् /

1.6.1.s: gataśrīḥ śukravān brāhmaṇo grāmaṇī rājanyo bahupuṣṭo vaiśyas teṣāṃ nityadhṛtaḥ /
1.6.1.d: गतश्रीः शुक्रवान् ब्राह्मणो ग्रामणी राजन्यो बहुपुष्टो वैश्यस् तेषां नित्यधृतः /
1.6.1.m: A person of attained prosperity, a resplendent brahmin, a village headman, a nobleman, and a prosperous vaiśya—for these it is perpetually maintained.

1.6.1.s: mahad āhavanīye 'bhyādadhāti /
1.6.1.d: महद् आहवनीये ऽभ्यादधाति /
1.6.1.m: He puts a large piece of wood on the āhavanīya fire.

1.6.1.s: pradoṣam agnihotram̐ hotavyam̐ vyuṣṭāyāṃ prātaḥ //
1.6.1.d: प्रदोषम् अग्निहोत्रम्̐ होतव्यम्̐ व्युष्टायां प्रातः //
1.6.1.m: The agnihotra is to be offered in the evening twilight, and in the morning when it has dawned.

1.6.1.s: agne śundhasva \\ ity āhavanīyaṃ parimārṣṭi \\ agne gṛhapate [ śundhasva ] iti gārhapatyam agne vahne [ śundhasva ] iti dakṣiṇāgnim //
1.6.1.d: अग्ने शुन्धस्व \\ इत्य् आहवनीयं परिमार्ष्टि \\ अग्ने गृहपते [ शुन्धस्व ] इति गार्हपत्यम् अग्ने वह्ने [ शुन्धस्व ] इति दक्षिणाग्निम् //
1.6.1.m: With 'O Agni, purify yourself!', he wipes around the āhavanīya; with 'O Agni, lord of the house, [purify yourself!]', the gārhapatya; with 'O Agni, bearer [of oblations, purify yourself!]', the dakṣiṇāgni.

1.6.1.s: ṛtasatyābhyāṃ tvā paryukṣāmi \\ iti sāyaṃ paryukṣati satyaṛtābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti prātaḥ /
1.6.1.d: ऋतसत्याभ्यां त्वा पर्युक्षामि \\ इति सायं पर्युक्षति सत्यऋताभ्यां त्वा \\ इति प्रातः /
1.6.1.m: With 'I sprinkle around you with truth and order,' he sprinkles around [the fire] in the evening; with '...with order and truth, you,' in the morning.

1.6.1.s: agnīn paristṛṇāti /
1.6.1.d: अग्नीन् परिस्तृणाति /

1.6.1.s: paścād āhavanīyasyodagagrān darbhān stṛṇāti /
1.6.1.d: पश्चाद् आहवनीयस्योदगग्रान् दर्भान् स्तृणाति /
1.6.1.m: To the west of the āhavanīya fire, he strews darbha-grass with tips pointing to the north.

1.6.1.s: uttarato gārhapatyasya saṃstīrṇe samidhaṃ sruvam agnihotrahavanīm āryakṛtīm upasādayati /
1.6.1.d: उत्तरतो गार्हपत्यस्य संस्तीर्णे समिधं स्रुवम् अग्निहोत्रहवनीम् आर्यकृतीम् उपसादयति /
1.6.1.m: To the north of the gārhapatya fire, on the strewn [grass], he places the kindling stick, the dipping spoon, the agnihotra ladle, and a vessel made by an Ārya.

1.6.1.s: uttarato vatsam upasṛjati / prāṅmukhīm upasīdaty āryakṛtyāṃ dohayaty anyac chūdrād udaṅmukhīm̐ vā //
1.6.1.d: उत्तरतो वत्सम् उपसृजति / प्राङ्मुखीम् उपसीदत्य् आर्यकृत्यां दोहयत्य् अन्यच् छूद्राद् उदङ्मुखीम्̐ वा //
1.6.1.m: To the north, he lets the calf loose. Facing east, he sits down by [the cow] and milks her into the vessel made by an Ārya; or someone other than a Śūdra, facing north, [milks her].

1.6.1.s:
apoḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam \ apoḍhāḥ senā abhītvarīr iti gārhapatyād udīco 'ṅgārān apohya
iḍāyās padaṃ ghṛtavac carācaram\ jātavedo havir idaṃ juṣasva /
ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpās \ teṣām̐ saptānām iha puṣṭir astu //
ity adhiśrayati //
1.6.1.d:
अपोढं जन्यं भयम् \ अपोढाः सेना अभीत्वरीर् इति गार्हपत्याद् उदीचो ऽङ्गारान् अपोह्य
इडायास् पदं घृतवच् चराचरम्\ जातवेदो हविर् इदं जुषस्व /
ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपास् \ तेषाम्̐ सप्तानाम् इह पुष्टिर् अस्तु //
इत्य् अधिश्रयति //
1.6.1.m:
Having pushed aside burning embers from the gārhapatya fire towards the north with: 'Removed is the danger from enemies; removed are the attacking armies,'

he sets [the milk] on the fire with: 'The footstep of Iḍā, rich in ghee, moving and unmoving; / O Jātavedas, enjoy this oblation!

Whatever domestic beasts there are of all forms, / let there be nourishment of those seven here!'

1.6.1.s: udbhavaḥ sthas \\ ity avekṣeta //
1.6.1.d: उद्भवः स्थस् \\ इत्य् अवेक्षेत //
1.6.1.m: He should gaze [at it] with: 'You are arising.'

1.6.1.s: ud ahaṃ prajayā paśubhir bhūyāsam ity ulmukenābhitāpayati //
1.6.1.d: उद् अहं प्रजया पशुभिर् भूयासम् इत्य् उल्मुकेनाभितापयति //
1.6.1.m: He heats it around with a burning brand, with: 'May I arise with offspring and cattle!'

1.6.1.s: haras te mā vinaiṣam ity udabindunā samudantaṃ pratinayati //
1.6.1.d: हरस् ते मा विनैषम् इत्य् उदबिन्दुना समुदन्तं प्रतिनयति //
1.6.1.m: With a drop of water, he traces around the edge, with: 'May I not lead away your heat!'

1.6.1.s: viśvajyotir asi \\ iti punar avadīpayati //
1.6.1.d: विश्वज्योतिर् असि \\ इति पुनर् अवदीपयति //
1.6.1.m: He illuminates it again with: 'You are all-light.'

1.6.1.s: antaritam̐ rakṣo \ antaritā arātayas \\ iti tṛṇena triḥ paryagniṃ karoti /
1.6.1.d: अन्तरितम्̐ रक्षो \ अन्तरिता अरातयस् \\ इति तृणेन त्रिः पर्यग्निं करोति /
1.6.1.m: With a blade of grass, he carries fire around it three times, with: 'Warded off is the demon; warded off are the enemies.'

1.6.1.s:
ud ehi vediṃ prajayā vardhayāsmān \ ud asya dveṣo abhayaṃ no astu /
mā no him̐sīḥ śapatho mābhicāraḥ \ śive kṣetre anamitre virāje //
ity udag udvāsayati vartma kurvan //
1.6.1.d:
उद् एहि वेदिं प्रजया वर्धयास्मान् \ उद् अस्य द्वेषो अभयं नो अस्तु /
मा नो हिम्̐सीः शपथो माभिचारः \ शिवे क्षेत्रे अनमित्रे विराजे //
इत्य् उदग् उद्वासयति वर्त्म कुर्वन् //
1.6.1.m:
[Saying:] 'Come up to the vedi, increase us with offspring; / cast away hatred, let there be freedom from danger for us!

May no curse harm us, nor malevolent magic, / in an auspicious, friend-filled, radiant realm!'

—with this he takes it off [the fire] towards the north, making a path.

1.6.1.s: pratyūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam \\ pratyūḍhāḥ senā abhītvarīr ity aṅgārān pratyūhati vartma ca lopayati /
1.6.1.d: प्रत्यूढं जन्यं भयम् \\ प्रत्यूढाः सेना अभीत्वरीर् इत्य् अङ्गारान् प्रत्यूहति वर्त्म च लोपयति /
1.6.1.m: With: 'Repulsed is the danger from enemies; repulsed are the attacking armies,' he shoves the embers back and effaces the path.

1.6.1.s: payasā juhoti dadhnā yavāgvājyena vā /
1.6.1.d: पयसा जुहोति दध्ना यवाग्वाज्येन वा /
1.6.1.m: He offers with milk, curd, barley gruel, or clarified butter.

1.6.1.s: dadhyājyayor adhiśrayaṇaṃ na syād abhitāpanaṃ ca //
1.6.1.d: दध्याज्ययोर् अधिश्रयणं न स्याद् अभितापनं च //
1.6.1.m: For curd and clarified butter there should be neither setting on the fire nor heating around.

1.6.1.s: niṣṭaptam̐ rakṣas \\ niṣṭaptā arātayas \\ iti gārhapatye sruksruvau niṣṭapati /
1.6.1.d: निष्टप्तम्̐ रक्षस् \\ निष्टप्ता अरातयस् \\ इति गार्हपत्ये स्रुक्स्रुवौ निष्टपति /
1.6.1.m: He heats the offering ladle and the dipping spoon over the gārhapatya fire, with: 'Burned away is the demon; burned away are the enemies.'

1.6.1.s: sruve samidham upasaṃyamya \\ unneṣyāmi \\ ity uktvā \\ unnayāmi \\ iti prātar bhūr iḍā \ bhuva iḍā \ svar iḍā \ jana iḍā \\ ity ekaikenonnayaty uttaramuttaraṃ bhūyām̐saṃ pūrṇam uttamam̐ sarvān vā samān //
1.6.1.d: स्रुवे समिधम् उपसंयम्य \\ उन्नेष्यामि \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ उन्नयामि \\ इति प्रातर् भूर् इडा \ भुव इडा \ स्वर् इडा \ जन इडा \\ इत्य् एकैकेनोन्नयत्य् उत्तरमुत्तरं भूयाम्̐सं पूर्णम् उत्तमम्̐ सर्वान् वा समान् //
